src: That is why we could not vote for that report and we call on Mr Schulz to follow the example of the US Congress and the US Senate, where both large parties have jointly initiated a major programme to combat nuclear smuggling, which they designated as the number one threat to the United States, on the basis of a report by the Institute for Strategic Studies which drew on hundreds of cases of nuclear crimes in the territory of the former Soviet Union.
tgt: C'est pourquoi nous n'avons pas pu voter en faveur de ce rapport et nous en appelons à M. Schulz de prendre exemple sur le Congrès et le Sénat américains où les deux grands partis en présence ont décidé de mener ensemble un vaste programme contre le trafic de substances nucléaires, trafic qu'ils s'accordent à décrire comme la principale menace pour les États-Unis, conformément aux conclusions d'un rapport de l'Institut pour les études stratégiques, lequel parle de centaines de cas de criminalité nucléaire au départ du territoire de l'ex-URSS.

previous_src: However, on 10 April Italy made a request for technical experts who could support the country in analysing the stability of buildings damaged by the earthquake.
src: A team of eight national and Commission experts was selected.
tgt: Une équipe de huit experts issus des États membres et de la Commission a été mise sur pied.

previous_src: By building a low-carbon and resource-efficient economy we can give a new impetus to competitiveness.
src: The Eco-design Directive represents a big opportunity for industry to build more competitive businesses based on green technologies.
tgt: Die Ökodesign-Richtlinie bietet der Industrie eine gute Gelegenheit, wettbewerbsfähigere Unternehmen auf der Grundlage grüner Technologien zu schaffen.

previous_src: It contains no comprehensive rules on research using embryos and embryonic stem cells.
src: The Committee on Industry, External Trade, Research and Energy has adopted a whole series of amendments that very definitely do take up a position on research using embryos and embryonic stem cells.
tgt: La commission de l industrie, du commerce extérieur, de la recherche et de l énergie a adopté une série d amendements prenant réellement position sur la recherche sur les cellules souches embryonnaire et sur les embryons.

previous_src: You have insisted on the need to act quickly, and this is our objective.
src: The Czech Presidency, which I would like to thank here for its support, is also committed to allowing the final adoption of the regulations as quickly as possible.
tgt: La Présidence tchèque, que je tiens à remercier ici pour son soutien, s'est également engagée à permettre une adoption définitive des règlements le plus rapidement possible.

previous_src: I think that they have been worthy of the satellites sector, which is an economic sector, but above all they have been worthy of the European citizens who will benefit from mobile satellite services: telephone, Internet, television and also security services, especially in the event of a disaster.
src: Here, therefore, we have a service that is going to be very important for our great Europe.
tgt: Wir haben es hier mit Diensten zu tun, die von höchster Bedeutung für unser großes Europa sein werden.

previous_src: So many of the elements incorporated in the motion for a resolution are already part of the EU's current human rights policy with regard to North Korea.
src: We very much welcome the convergence of views among Members and between the Members of Parliament and the Commission.
tgt: Nous nous réjouissons vivement de la convergence de vues qui existe entre les députés, d'une part, et entre les députés et la Commission, d'autre part.

previous_src: This does not mean that what we are proposing is drastic and immediate action.
src: Rather we are setting ourselves an objective to arrive at maximum sustainable yield (MSY) in a gradual and flexible manner.
tgt: Wir setzen uns vielmehr ein Ziel, in einzelnen Schritten und auf flexible Weise zu einem höchstmöglichen Dauerertrag (MSY) zu gelangen.

previous_src: If the general public throughout the 27 countries are watching, they will have very little respect for this House.
src: There are bigger issues than this, such as high unemployment.
tgt: Il y a d'autres problèmes plus graves que celui -ci, comme par exemple le chômage élevé.

previous_src: Eight days after the September 11 attack, I told a group of thousands of university students in my country that they cannot allow the tragedy of 9 / 11 to end our way of life, because that is exactly what the terrorists sought.
src: I also told them that America cannot prevail in this new struggle by acting alone.
tgt: Ich habe ihnen auch gesagt, dass Amerika diesen neuen Kampf nicht allein führen kann.

previous_src: In order to combat excessive price fluctuations, the bulk of the hop crop in the EU is sold by means of multiannual supply contracts.
src: Technological progress and changes in tastes have in recent years seen demand for varieties with a high alpha acid content predominate; other varieties are no longer marketable.
tgt: Der technische Fortschritt sowie die Trendentwicklung haben in den vergangenen Jahren dazu geführt, daß der Hopfenhandel heute überwiegend Sorten mit einem hohen Alphasäuregehalt nachfragt, andere Sorten sind nicht marktfähig.

previous_src: The first, on which I intend to focus today, is the assassination, on 24 February last, of Hy Vuthy, President of the Free Trade Union of Workers in Cambodia.
src: This assassination is in addition to the murders, in 2004, of Chea Vichea and of Ros Sovannareth, who had been Presidents of the same Union, and in addition to the acts of intimidation and physical attacks of which other trade unionists have been victims in recent years.
tgt: Cet assassinat est à ajouter aux assassinats, en 2004, de Chea Vichea et de Ros Sovannareth, qui avaient été présidents du même syndicat, ainsi qu'aux actes d'intimidation et attaques physiques dont d'autres syndicalistes ont été victimes au cours des dernières années.

previous_src: Those in charge on both sides should be congratulated.
src: Both the pace of internal reform and the EU response should continue to get beyond the point of no return sooner, rather than later.
tgt: Es sollten sich sowohl das Tempo der inneren Reformen als auch die Reaktion der EU fortsetzen, um über den Punkt, an dem es kein Zurück mehr gibt, eher früher als später hinauszukommen.

previous_src: There are some problems we need to be very clear about.
src: We need to establish a common market in the field of defence, to provide for a European budget to cover both the military and the civil aspects of security and to intensify cooperation between the EU Defence Ministers, with the final goal of creating the post of Deputy EU Foreign Minister in charge of the ESDP.
tgt: Wir müssen einen gemeinsamen Markt im Bereich der Verteidigung errichten, einen europäischen Haushalt schaffen, der die militärischen wie die zivilen Sicherheitsaspekte abdeckt, und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen den EU-Verteidigungsministern verstärken, um letztendlich einen stellvertretenden Außenminister der Gemeinschaft ernennen zu können, der für die ESVP zuständig ist.

previous_src: The next day, the council of Trebišov in Slovakia unanimously rejected a plan to build a power plant that would emit 4 million tonnes of carbon dioxide every year, and against which there have been widespread protests for a year and a half, with petitions and fines on both sides of the border.
src: We could say "Hurrah!
tgt: Jetzt könnten wir ausrufen "Hurra!

previous_src: My second is this: Commissioner, the Court of Auditors' report that we discussed today criticises the Commission for the absence of definite criteria in its programmes to reinforce atomic power stations, that is, to increase the safety of their reactors.
src: Are you prepared to consider the possibility that the Commission is not drawing up any criteria, that is to say, any general criteria, but only criteria for checking reactor safety improvement measures, carried out with the support of Commission resources?
tgt: Sind Sie bereit zu überlegen, dass die Kommission keine Kriterien, d. h. keine generellen Kriterien, sondern nur Kriterien zur Überprüfung der Maßnahmen zur Erhöhung der Reaktorsicherheit erarbeitet, die mit Unterstützung durch Kommissionsmittel getroffen werden?

previous_src: I think that this new authority needs to exercise its mandate as soon as it is created.
src: I would like to point out that the decision made by the United States to introduce tighter supervisory regulations has paved the way for global harmonisation.
tgt: Ich möchte darauf hinweisen, dass die Entscheidung der Vereinigten Staaten zur Einführung strengerer aufsichtsrechtlicher Vorschriften den Weg für eine weltweite Harmonisierung geebnet hat.

previous_src: Mr President, first of all, I would like to thank the rapporteur for her commitment and excellent cooperation, as this really is an important subject.
src: As we have said already, human trafficking is perhaps the very worst form of crime.
tgt: Comme nous l'avons déjà dit, la traite des êtres humains représente peut-être la pire forme de criminalité.

previous_src: They are: no more peacekeepers from a neighbouring country as they usually defend particular zones d'état but not peace.
src: The impact of a great power's coercive politics and diplomacy against a small and unsubordinated neighbour should be considered, not to mention eventual loss of important parts of territory through creeping annexation.
tgt: Der Einfluss einer Großmacht und ihre politischen und diplomatischen Zwangsmaßnahmen gegenüber einem kleinen und unterlegenen Nachbarn muss Beachtung finden, ganz abgesehen vom möglichen Verlust großer Teile des Staatsgebiets durch schleichende Annektierung.

previous_src: in writing. - (NL) Two key reasons prevented me from supporting this resolution.
src: First of all, I think we need an absolute ban on enlargement, except for Croatia.
tgt: Zunächst bin ich der Meinung, es sollte überhaupt keine Erweiterung mehr geben, mit Ausnahme von Kroatien.

previous_src: Yet now you want to defend the prerogatives of this House, and why ever not?
src: In any case, the end product of your attitude was a ruling from the Court of Justice of the European Communities which, unfortunately for you, found against you, thus confirming the truth of the Latin dictum, 'Hodie mihi, cras tibi' - my turn today and yours tomorrow.
tgt: Ihre Haltung hat jedoch zu einer Rechtsprechung des Gerichtshofs der Europäischen Gemeinschaften geführt, der - für Sie leider - gegen Sie entschieden hat und damit das lateinische Sprichwort "Hodie mihi, cras tibi" - heute mir, morgen dir - bestätigt.

previous_src: I am also very pleased that the general line proposed by the Commission in the original proposal has been welcomed by both Parliament and the Council.
src: The next Culture Programme will thus promote, firstly, the transnational mobility of people working in the cultural sector, secondly, the transnational circulation of works of art, as well as of artistic and cultural products, and, thirdly, intercultural dialogue.
tgt: Somit wird das nächste Programm "Kultur" erstens die grenzüberschreitende Mobilität von Menschen, die im Kultursektor tätig sind, zweitens die internationale Verbreitung von Kunstwerken und drittens den interkulturellen Dialog fördern.

previous_src: Natural flavourings are wholly made up of natural flavouring agents.
src: The ratio of 90 / 10 proposed by the Commission made it possible to produce a natural flavour with tastes differing according to the products, targets or the culture of Member States.
tgt: Le ratio 90/ 10 proposé par la Commission permettait d'obtenir un arôme naturel avec des goûts différenciés en fonction des produits, des cibles ou encore de la culture des États membres.

previous_src: I shall end, Mr President, by reminding the House that there is a new proposal that might help: the Aosta-Martigny rail link, which starts in Milan, is not one of the European priorities but could be included if France and Italy take the matter up.
src: By the way, I shall close with some news: tomorrow the Italian Minister, Mr Lunardi, and his French counterpart, Mr Gayssot, will be meeting to agree on a date to reopen the Mont Blanc tunnel, which I hope will be very, very soon.
tgt: In diesem Sinne schließe ich mit einer Mitteilung: Morgen werden der italienische Minister Lunardi und sein französischer Amtskollege Gayssot zusammenkommen, um einen Termin für die Wiedereröffnung des Mont-Blanc-Tunnels zu vereinbaren, der, so hoffe ich, in greifbarer Nähe liegt.

previous_src: Today we have a very important debate - a debate on an issue that is one of the most important issues on the agenda of the international community.
src: I would like to make a short statement about it and spend the time necessary to see whether we can together understand - and not only understand but make some progress on the solution of - this very complicated issue that is at the top of the international agenda today.
tgt: Ich möchte eine kurze Erklärung dazu abgeben und so viel Zeit wie nötig darauf verwenden herauszufinden, ob es eine gemeinsame Verständnisgrundlage für dieses sehr komplizierte Thema gibt - und es nicht nur verstehen, sondern auch zu seiner Lösung beitragen -, da es auf der internationalen Tagesordnung heute ganz oben steht.

previous_src: As far as the modification of the Third Community Support Framework is concerned, the Commission has been informed that the Greek Ministry of Finance intends to submit an application in the course of the year.
src: So far, however, the Commission has received no proposals for transfers of funds between programmes.
tgt: Bisher sind bei der Kommission jedoch noch keine Vorschläge für einen Transfer von Mitteln zwischen den Programmen eingegangen.

previous_src: Perhaps they do not debate these issues sufficiently or in time, but it is her problem.
src: As far as Thursday afternoon goes, it is exactly the opposite.
tgt: Pour ce qui est du jeudi après-midi, c'est tout le contraire.

previous_src: Mr President, Mrs Figueiredo deserves a great deal of congratulation for putting together a very large number of arguments and writing a densely-packed report.
src: After listening to the constant talk about competition, economic growth, the free movement of capital, services and goods and so on, it does one good to see Europe, of whose being the Christian West ‘ ’ we hear so much, setting limits to neo-capitalism and focusing attention on our fellow-creatures, our environment and those who will come after us.
tgt: Neben dem ständigen Gerede über Wettbewerb, Wirtschaftswachstum, Freiheit des Kapitals, der Dienstleistungen, der Waren usw. ist es wohltuend, wenn das so oft als christliches Abendland überstrapazierte Europa sich vom Neokapitalismus abgrenzt und Mitwelt, Umwelt und Nachwelt in den Mittelpunkt setzt.

previous_src: I also support the amendments tabled by Mrs Roure and Mrs Lefrançois.
src: The Dublin system and the choice of first-country-of-entry for people entering the EU really need to be evaluated, especially regarding the problems this involves for the countries which receive refugees.
tgt: Sowohl das Dublin-System als auch das Kriterium des ersten Einreisestaates für Personen, die in die EU kommen, müssen wirklich neu bewertet werden, insbesondere im Hinblick auf die Probleme für die Mitgliedstaaten, die Flüchtlinge aufnehmen.

previous_src: It is true that fisheries play a very important role in the economic and social development of remote regions and a system of aid for marketing specific fishery products from these regions was introduced back in 1992.
src: This aid helped producers to offset the additional costs of transporting their products to mainland Europe.
tgt: Mit Hilfe dieser Regelung konnten den Erzeugern die zusätzlichen Kosten für den Transport ihrer Waren auf das europäische Festland ausgeglichen werden.

previous_src: Mr Fabre-Aubrespy, before we reached the original paragraph an amendment was passed which replaced it.
src: So it was not in order to vote on an amendment to it.
tgt: Es besteht also kein Grund für eine Abstimmung über einen Änderungsantrag.

previous_src: As I said, we might be able to send a smaller team of advisers to follow the process under the current circumstances.
src: If not, as I said, the state of emergency would have to be lifted very quickly and civil liberties restored.
tgt: Wenn nicht, wie gesagt, muss der Ausnahmezustand sehr schnell aufgehoben und müssten die bürgerlichen Freiheiten wiederhergestellt werden.

previous_src: Today, more than ever, this policy is essential and must be regarded as a priority.
src: We must continue down this road with greater courage.
tgt: Nous devons poursuivre sur cette voie avec plus de courage.

previous_src: (MT) Thank you, Mr President.
src: The government has adopted as its policy the target of introducing the euro by 1 January 2008.
tgt: Die Regierung hat als ihre Politik das Ziel festgelegt, den Euro zum 1. Januar 2008 einzuführen.

previous_src: I congratulate the rapporteur, Mr Coelho, for the preparation of this report and also agree that it is important to ensure the free movement within the Schengen area of third-country nationals in possession of a long-stay visa who are lawfully present in a Member State as soon as possible.
src: According to the current practice of Member States, for various reasons, it takes rather a long time for third-country nationals to replace a long-stay visa with a residence permit.
tgt: Aus der gegenwärtigen Praxis der Mitgliedstaaten wird ersichtlich, dass diese aus unterschiedlichen Gründen ziemlich viel Zeit dafür benötigen, ein Visum für den längerfristigen Aufenthalt von Drittstaatsangehörigen durch einen Aufenthaltstitel zu ersetzen.

previous_src: I wish to offer my very sincere thanks to the presidency for the draft document for the IGC which is an excellent document.
src: It will be a solid and worthwhile base for continuing discussions in the IGC to conclude at Amsterdam.
tgt: Er wird eine solide und wertvolle Grundlage für eine Fortsetzung der Diskussionen auf der Regierungskonferenz sein, die in Amsterdam ihren Abschluß finden wird.

previous_src: We must not hide behind others, but must fulfil our own obligations.
src: This applies to the funding of AMIS and to support ranging from logistics and military equipment to personnel.
tgt: Dies gilt für die Finanzierung von AMIS, von der Unterstützung von Logistik und militärischen Gütern bis hin zum Personal.

previous_src: The President of the European Parliament is bound by their decisions.
src: I will be inviting the Presidents of all the European Union institutions and all former Presidents of this House to attend on that occasion.
tgt: Ich werde dazu die Präsidenten aller Institutionen der Europäischen Union sowie alle ehemaligen Präsidentinnen und Präsidenten des Europäischen Parlaments einladen.

previous_src: It is a problem of European citizenship.
src: It is a problem of European justice, access to civil justice.
tgt: Es handelt sich um ein Problem der europäischen Justiz, dem Zugang zur Zivilgerichtsbarkeit.

previous_src: The EU has a strong acquis on the fight against racism and xenophobia.
src: Both these phenomena are incompatible with the principles upon which the EU is founded.
tgt: Diese beiden Phänomene sind unvereinbar mit den Prinzipien, auf denen die EU begründet wurde.

previous_src: It is important to remember that President Chavez has, on a number of occasions, declared that he is willing to respect the provisions of the Venezuelan Constitution and to submit to public consultation half way through his mandate.
src: Respecting the political experiment in Venezuela means respecting the dignity of a people that has decided to take its fate into its own hands.
tgt: Die derzeit von Venezuela durchlebten politischen Erfahrungen zu respektieren heißt, die Würde eines Volkes zu respektieren, das beschlossen hat, sein Schicksal in die eigenen Hände zu nehmen.

previous_src: The people have been bypassed, but then the European Union is very good at bypassing the people.
src: Just take a look at what has happened with the Lisbon Treaty.
tgt: Schauen Sie sich an, was mit dem Vertrag von Lissabon geschehen ist.

previous_src: This is good news for consumers, whose rights are strengthened by this legislation.
src: The possibility of moving a telephone number to another network in one day, the increase in transparency of tariffs and the strengthening of personal data protection are some of the many positive results of the package.
tgt: Die Möglichkeit der Nummernübertragung innerhalb eines Tages zu einem anderen Netz, die Verbesserung der Tariftransparenz und die Stärkung des Schutzes personenbezogener Daten sind einige der vielen positiven Ergebnisse des Pakets.

previous_src: The aim of this pilot programme was to fill gaps in the aerial capacity of the Member States, not to replace available national resources.
src: The reserve aircraft chartered were used this year, as I said, in Portugal, in the south of France and Corsica, in Italy and in Greece, in the area of Attica, where we had major fires.
tgt: Comme indiqué précédemment, les avions de réserve affrétés ont été déployés cette année au Portugal, dans le sud de la France et en Corse, en Italie et en Grèce, dans la région de l'Attique, qui a connu des incendies de grande ampleur.

previous_src: There is recognition that non-commercial clinical trials, which industry either cannot or will not support, are nevertheless important and that rules need to be drawn up for them.
src: I am particularly pleased that we have struck a very good compromise on clinical tests on people who are unable to give legal consent themselves.
tgt: Ich bin besonders froh darüber, dass wir zu klinischen Prüfungen an Menschen, die nicht selbst rechtskräftig einwilligen können, einen sehr guten Kompromiss gefunden haben.

previous_src: They must cope with a series of problems, namely increased drug smuggling, organised crime, corruption and human trafficking.
src: Another basic issue should be improved contacts between our citizens, promoting cultural exchange and setting up a special programme of grants for young people to study at European schools, thus becoming familiar with EU values and standards.
tgt: Ein weiteres wichtiges Anliegen sollte darin bestehen, die Kontakte zwischen unseren Bürgern zu intensivieren, den kulturellen Austausch zu fördern oder auch ein spezielles Stipendienprogramm aufzulegen, das es jungen Menschen ermöglicht, an europäischen Schulen zu studieren und sich so mit den Werten und Normen der EU vertraut zu machen.

previous_src: The problem here arose from the market situation, not from the budget.
src: In addition, refunds logically have to be cut in cases where the number of licence applications is so great as to make it impossible to comply with the annual obligations in terms of quantities.
tgt: Darüber hinaus müssen die Erstattungen logischerweise jeweils gekürzt werden, wenn die Anzahl der Lizenzanträge so umfangreich ist, daß es nicht möglich ist, die jährlichen mengenmäßigen Verpflichtungen einzuhalten.

previous_src: There has already been mention of aircraft holding circles and running half-empty aircraft.
src: Surely there is scope for improvement in efficiency in that area.
tgt: In diesem Bereich gibt es noch reichlich Raum für Verbesserungen.

previous_src: Concerning support for the European Union in financing investment, where needs have been estimated at EUR 600 billion for the trans-European transport networks alone, I suggest that a reflection be carried out on the role of the European Union in terms of the development of our territory.
src: The funding allocated by the Member States and the EU is far from able to meet these needs.
tgt: Die von den Mitgliedstaaten und der Europäischen Union bereitgestellten Finanzierungen sind weit davon entfernt, den Bedarf zu decken.

previous_src: GUE / NGL is also opposed to the fact that certain provisions of the Agreement apply exclusively to certain categories or groups of people.
src: This is considered discriminatory and the GUE / NGL Group stresses that the facilitation procedure for access visas should apply and be guaranteed equally to all citizens of the EU Member States and citizens of the Russian Federation.
tgt: Le groupe GUE/ NGL considère que ces dispositions sont discriminatoires et souligne que la procédure destinée à faciliter la délivrance de visas d'accès devrait être appliquée et garantie de manière équitable à tous les citoyens des états membres de l'UE et de la Fédération de Russie.

previous_src: This is an unpleasant and embarrassing matter.
src: Today millions of people are working illegally.
tgt: Millionen Menschen arbeiten heute illegal.

previous_src: You will have realised that I did not welcome to the European Parliament former President of the European Parliament, Hans-Gert Pöttering, because Hans-Gert, you are one of us.
src: You sit here every day and work with us, but we are very glad that we are sitting in your honourable place among us.
tgt: Sie sitzen jeden Tag hier und arbeiten mit uns, aber wir sind sehr froh, dass Sie auf Ihrem Ehrenplatz unter uns sitzen.

previous_src: I am proud to wear the white ribbon to show that I make that stand myself personally.
src: I know I speak for the majority of my colleagues here as well.
tgt: Ich weiß, ich spreche hier auch für die Mehrheit meiner Kollegen.

previous_src: But, again, on the whole, we are a very strong motor and body in this area, and we have to go on working to ensure that the Human Rights Council really works and goes in the right direction.
src: The European Parliament is a very, very strong tool to help us on that path.
tgt: Das Europäische Parlament ist ein überaus leistungsfähiges Instrument, das uns auf diesem Weg hilfreich ist.

previous_src: I agree with the rapporteur that we need to act on the basis of a comprehensive concept of security in today's security environment and that both external and internal security aspects need to be adequately addressed.
src: We need to use all available instruments, be they civilian or military, be they in the hands of Member States or the Union, to achieve our goals in the security sphere.
tgt: Wir müssen uns aller verfügbaren zivilen wie militärischen Instrumente der Mitgliedstaaten oder der Union bedienen, um unsere Zielsetzungen im Sicherheitssektor verwirklichen zu können.

previous_src: During certain periods, the working groups met every day for a number of hours.
src: Everyone had the time and the opportunity to express their opinions and comments.
tgt: Jeder hatte Zeit und Gelegenheit, seinen Standpunkt darzulegen und sich zu äußern.

previous_src: These are careers that could provide many more candidates of both sexes for all kinds of European and international missions and posts.
src: Since 1974, there has been extraordinary progress in the presence of women in these careers, yet this progress does not extend to the top of these fields, for example in government or party political decision-making.
tgt: Depuis 1974, la présence des femmes dans ces carrières a progressé de manière extraordinaire, mais ce progrès ne s'étend pas au sommet dans ces domaines, par exemple à la prise de décisions au niveau du gouvernement ou des partis.

previous_src: They must respect Community law, even if they are related to defence contracts exempted on the basis of Article 296.
src: In other words, offsets are a problem in themselves, even in the area covered by Article 296.
tgt: Das heißt also, Ausgleichsvereinbarungen sind an sich problematisch, selbst in dem von Artikel 296 abgedeckten Bereich.

previous_src: Secondly, the regime for the rating agencies could profit from the rules that have been established for the auditors.
src: The rating agencies and auditors have a lot of responsibility for the good reputation of companies and the proper functioning of the market.
tgt: Die Rating-Agenturen und Rechnungsprüfer tragen ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung für den guten Ruf von Unternehmen und das ordnungsgemäße Funktionieren des Marktes.

previous_src: A list was provided for the debate on the fact-finding mission to Georgia, but names of certain speakers, including mine, have been deleted.
src: I therefore request my speaking time in accordance with what had been arranged until the last minute.
tgt: Ich bitte daher darum, dass meine Redezeit den zuletzt vereinbarten Regelungen entspricht.

previous_src: Under these circumstances, why should they tire themselves out?
src: This attitude says much about the thinking behind an operation which was deceitfully presented as being entirely centred on the improved comfort of citizens.
tgt: Diese Haltung ist recht aufschlussreich für die Philosophie eines Vorhabens, das man fälschlicherweise so hingestellt hat, als sei es ausschließlich darauf gerichtet, das Leben der Bürger angenehmer zu machen.

previous_src: As has already been mentioned, relative stability plays a decisive role for Germany.
src: Of course, we are all convinced of the importance of protecting fish stocks and ensuring that they remain sustainable so that they stay at a level which will guarantee the existence of our fisheries in future.
tgt: Natürlich sind wir alle davon überzeugt, dass wir die Fischbestände schützen und ertragsfähig erhalten müssen, damit sie auf einem Niveau bleiben, das die Existenz unserer Fischer auch in Zukunft sichert.

previous_src: But the ALDE Group was rather surprised by Amendment 45 and finds it a bit casual.
src: Why not settle for the text used in Amendment 16, which everyone was happy with, ourselves included?
tgt: Warum sich nicht mit dem Text in Änderungsantrag 16 begnügen, mit dem jeder, uns eingeschlossen, zufrieden war?

previous_src: I would like to give you an example: what do we do with all the toys containing chips?
src: When children put them in their mouths, chips are a dangerous item.
tgt: Quand les enfants les mettent en bouche, les puces sont des composants dangereux.

previous_src: Does the Commission intend to do something to guarantee equal, fair treatment for the weaker party in this contract?
src: These are the questions, Commissioner, that I would like to you to answer as fully, clearly and precisely as possible.
tgt: Dies sind die Fragen, Herr Kommissar, zu denen ich mir von Ihnen möglichst vollständige, klare und genaue Antworten erhoffe.

previous_src: Those on the receiving end – by which I mean the public to whom legislation applies, the Member States, which have to transpose it and all involved in implementing it at every level – suffer when laws are bad, and so we should stop churning out loads of paper through all the institutions and instead put it to the test by submitting and enacting laws that really are better.

tgt: Ces deux actes devraient constituer un bon point de départ.

tgt: Ich hoffe aufrichtig, dass dieser Bericht ordentlich umgesetzt wird und dazu beiträgt, die soziale und wirtschaftliche Integration der Roma auf unserem Kontinent zu verbessern.

previous_src: Discarding can primarily be reduced, and eventually eliminated, by reducing unwanted by-catch.

previous_src: Today's vote constitutes an unprecedented political rejection of the Commission, even though the majority for censure could not be achieved, although only by a few tens of votes.

tgt: Es ist das erste Mal, daß ein Mißtrauensantrag so viele Stimmen auf sich vereinen konnte.

previous_src: Having said all that, I would like to thank all of those involved.

tgt: Ich möchte der Kommission und den betreffenden Dienststellen danken.

previous_src: We discussed it in the Foreign Affairs Council both in November and in December.

tgt: Nous nous sommes à nouveau mis d'accord sur les conclusions lors du Conseil des affaires étrangères de cette semaine et nous continuerons à surveiller la situation.

previous_src: I am firmly convinced about this report and am therefore positive that we have taken a significant step forwards here in facilitating activities within the European Union.

tgt: Ich hoffe, dass dieses Beispiel auch in anderen Bereichen Schule macht.

previous_src: Alternative methods of financing are also being considered, i.e. new ways of providing the EU with funds.

previous_src: It is absolutely vital that income support continue for decades as regards species that take dozens of years to grow, before which nothing whatsoever is produced.

tgt: Wichtig ist, dass die Hilfen für die Wälder im Süden der iberischen Halbinsel fortgeführt werden und dass sie bei den Alternativen aufgestockt werden.

previous_src: Measures should be the same throughout the EU to ensure no one Member State gets an unfair advantage.
src: Through you I urge the Commission and the Council to reach decisions and take urgent action following the meeting on 14 October.
tgt: Über Sie, Frau Präsidentin, appelliere ich an Kommission und Rat, nach der Sitzung vom 14. Oktober rasch Entscheidungen zu fällen und unverzüglich Maßnahmen zu ergreifen.

previous_src: To Ms Fajon, I want to tell you that, of course the situation of Albania and Bosnia and Herzegovina is another track and we are right now finalising a mission there to evaluate how these two countries are doing according to the criteria.
src: The Commission will very soon, after consultation with Member States and experts, make a report on that and the assessment of that report will be shared with members of the Committee on Civil Liberties, Justice and Home Affairs before we put a possible proposal on the agenda.
tgt: Die Kommission wird sehr bald, nach der Beratung mit den Mitgliedstaaten und Sachverständigen, einen Bericht hierüber verfassen und die Beurteilung dieses Berichts wird mit den Mitgliedern des Ausschusses für bürgerliche Freiheiten, Justiz und Inneres gemeinsam vorgenommen werden, bevor ein möglicher Vorschlag auf die Agenda gesetzt wird.

previous_src: EUR 50 million will be made available from appropriations that were previously earmarked for fishing agreements.
src: It is quite evident that this is additional money that was not available beforehand for other external actions.
tgt: Das ist ganz klar zusätzliches Geld, das vorher überhaupt nicht für andere externe Aktionen zur Verfügung stand.

previous_src: Talking about political parties at European level without talking about funding would be pointless.
src: We must look at how those political parties, so necessary for shaping the people's will, are funded.
tgt: Wir müssen uns darum kümmern, wie diese politischen Parteien, die für die Herausbildung des Volkswillens so notwendig sind, finanziert werden.

previous_src: The situation in Somalia is dramatic.

tgt: Le choléra se répand dans toute la région, plus d'un million et demi de personnes ont besoin d'une aide médicale urgente et des dizaines de milliers d'enfants souffrent de malnutrition.

previous_src: It is only right for the final positions of the Parliamentary committee and the rapporteur to reflect this caution.

tgt: Zudem sollte man ja nicht vergessen, dass die meisten befragten Wirtschaftsakteure Vorbehalte und Bedenken hinsichtlich der Annahme neuer Vorschriften geäußert haben, besonders da die Bestimmungen zum Missbrauch einer beherrschenden Stellung bisher gut funktioniert haben.

previous_src: We need to prioritise research in this field, as it is clear that research of this kind is something very close to the patients.
src: Moreover, we must ensure that parents are able to decide that the cord blood should not simply be thrown away, as it may possibly be valuable in future for other children, or even for their own child.
tgt: En outre, nous devons veiller à ce que les parents puissent décider que le sang de cordon ne puisse tout simplement pas être jeté, car il pourrait s'avérer précieux dans le futur pour d'autres enfants, ou même pour leur propre enfant.

previous_src: I would also call on the Commission, in talks and in trade issues as well, to bring up the issue of human rights too.
src: Paragraph 19 about the institutions and the government of Pakistan is also important, as is the call for recognition of democracy and human rights.
tgt: Absatz 19 über die Institutionen und die Regierung Pakistans ist ebenso wichtig sowie auch die Forderung der Anerkennung von Demokratie und Menschenrechten.

previous_src: The Greens regard the process of creating a constitution in the EU as the greatest political challenge, and we are very sorry that the Intergovernmental Conference is taking no initiatives along these lines.
src: This brings me to a possible objection which has already been mentioned: precisely because the report has such a fundamental constitutional ambition, we believe that it is in fact necessary to seek an amendment to the Treaty, and not to remain outside the Intergovernmental Conference.
tgt: Je répète ici une observation qui a déjà été faite : nous estimons nécessaire d'arriver à une modification du Traité et de ne pas rester en-dehors de la conférence des chefs d'État et de gouvernements parce que ce rapport renferme une ambition profondément constitutionnelle.

previous_src: The May 2005 'Council of Europe Convention on the Action Against trafficking in Human Beings' has only been ratified by nine countries, two thirds of women trafficked for prostitution come from Eastern Europe and yet, countries like the Czech Republic and Estonia have not signed the convention.
src: Apart from the political will not being there, the police will is not there either.
tgt: Mis à part l'absence de volonté politique, la volonté policière fait également défaut.

previous_src: It is exceptionally difficult to avoid irregularities but it is even more important to find them and to prevent them.
src: I am of the opinion that we have successfully carried out this function of monitoring.
tgt: Ich bin der Meinung, dass wir diese Funktion der Überwachung erfolgreich ausgeführt haben.

previous_src: With EULEX, the European Union has set its aspirations high.
src: It is good that the real work has now begun.
tgt: Es ist gut, dass nun die richtige Arbeit begonnen hat.

previous_src: She has an astute mind but I do not know what she was referring to.
src: Perhaps she was referring to the fact that the socialist government, whose party she belongs to, was the one which caused the loss in Spain of 25, 000 coal-mining jobs and the fact that the current Industry Minister is attempting to salvage what he can from the socialist government's disastrous energy policy.
tgt: Peutêtre est -ce le gouvernement socialiste au parti duquel elle appartient qui a provoqué en Espagne la perte de 25.000 emplois dans les mines de charbon et le ministre de l'industrie actuel essaie de sauver ce qui peut être sauvé de ce désastre qu'était la politique énergétique du gouvernement socialiste.

previous_src: We can achieve annual savings of millions of euros by improving cooperation between European institutions.
src: I believe that cooperation with the Inter-Institutional Working Group on multilingualism will enable us to make better use of free capacity in this area.
tgt: Je pense que notre coopération avec le groupe de travail interinstitutionnel sur le multilinguisme nous permettra de mieux utiliser la capacité disponible dans ce domaine.

previous_src: Mr President, quite simply thank you, thank you to Parliament and thank you to its rapporteur, Mrs Hall.
src: I think that they have been worthy of the satellites sector, which is an economic sector, but above all they have been worthy of the European citizens who will benefit from mobile satellite services: telephone, Internet, television and also security services, especially in the event of a disaster.
tgt: Meiner Meinung nach haben sie sich sehr verdient gemacht um den Satellitenfunksektor, einen Wirtschaftssektor, aber vor allem um die europäischen Bürger, die in den Genuss des Zugangs zu mobilen Satellitenfunkdiensten kommen wie Telefon, Internet, Fernsehen sowie auch Sicherheitsdiensten insbesondere im Katastrophenfall.

previous_src: It started around mid-2009, and this led the EU Council of Ministers in November 2009 to request that the Commission formulate a proposal for the so-called 'joint interim plan' in support of reforms to be implemented with Belarus.
src: The Commission's services have prepared a draft of this joint interim plan for reforms.
tgt: Die Kommissionsdienststellen haben einen Entwurf dieses gemeinsamen Interimsplans für Reformen vorbereitet.

previous_src: It did all of this before choosing a new government, because the new era after the end of the Cold War was to be a time of reconciliation, peace and community.
src: This admission of responsibility alone represented the beginning of the work of the only freely elected East German Parliament.
tgt: Dieses Bekenntnis allein steht am Anfang der Arbeit der einzig frei gewählten Volkskammer.

previous_src: Apart from that, we also face the issue of energy security regarding the Nabucco pipeline.
src: It is still a priority for the Commission and we will go on supporting it.
tgt: Dieses Projekt hat immer noch Priorität für die Kommission und wir werden es weiterhin unterstützen.

previous_src: The proposed regulation is undoubtedly a good step in the right direction, but much more may need to be done in the future as more knowledge and experience is gathered on deep-sea marine biology.
src: The application of the precautionary principle, as a basis for formulating some of the parameters of this regulation, is judged to be both necessary and wise.
tgt: Nous estimons à la fois nécessaire et sage de se fonder sur le principe de précaution pour formuler certains des paramètres de ce règlement.

previous_src: The three European citizens who were held hostage in Darfur for several months have been released but, at the same time, we know the situation in Darfur is as it has been previously.

tgt: Wir müssen weiterhin Bemühungen um einen umfassenden und gerechten Frieden in Darfur unterstützen, versuchen dafür zu sorgen, dass der Friedensverhandlungsprozess einen positiven Ausgang nimmt und vor Ort die Bedingungen für einen Darfur-basierten politischen Prozess schaffen.

previous_src: But it is - as the Council also said - a very important part of the negotiation.
src: We will have to find a solution to this, and as regards rectification and access.
tgt: Nous devrons trouver une solution pour ce point, y compris sur les droits à la rectification et à l'accès.

previous_src: In mid-January, several of them were imprisoned for 15 days and then excluded from university.

tgt: Einige der Namen dieser jungen Demokraten will ich hier nennen: Smitser Shalesnitschenka, Anton Kalinuski und Franak Viatschorka.

tgt: Ansonsten ist es Herrn Savary gelungen, einen befriedigenden Ausgleich zwischen den verschiedenen streitigen Interessen herzustellen.

tgt: Un changement est nécessaire, mais le changement est également possible sans imposer aux entreprises et aux ménages des contraintes excessives.

previous_src: We want to see technical neutrality and interoperability.

tgt: Manche beschweren sich sogar darüber, daß die Einkommensteuer im Vereinigten Königreich relativ niedrig ist und daß dies ungerecht sei (dabei wird die erhöhte Steuerlast der britischen Bürger seit dem Wahlsieg der Labour-Regierung übersehen).

tgt: Afin que le poids des inconvénients ne pèse pas lourdement sur les épaules des générations futures, les fonds communautaires, dépensés pour nous, doivent non seulement leur permettent de rester dans le cadre d'une vie qui a un sens, mais aussi continuer à augmenter les perspectives de la compétitivité européenne.

previous_src: Consumers must certainly take responsibility themselves if they are worried about proper nutrition, but they also need a certain level of knowledge to be able to do so.
src: Education on over-nutrition is, to my mind, one aspect of consumer protection that has been little in evidence up to now.
tgt: Selon moi, l'apprentissage en matière d'alimentation est un aspect de la protection des consommateurs qui jusqu'à présent, a été très peu pris en considération.

previous_src: I think that organic farming, in a number of developing countries, is undoubtedly an option, provided that it would be possible to create sectors.
src: However, this is just off the top of my head.
tgt: Doch das ist nur aus dem Stegreif gesprochen.

tgt: Es ist ebenfalls bezeichnend, dass das Europäische Parlament über einen Vertrag abstimmt, obwohl keines seiner Mitglieder die Möglichkeit hatte, eine konsolidierte Fassung zu studieren.

previous_src: Firstly, experience of consolidation in the financial market has been positive.
src: It might, if anything, be said that there is too little cross-border consolidation.
tgt: Wenn überhaupt, kann man vielleicht den Mangel an grenzüberschreitender Konsolidierung beklagen.

previous_src: You can also be assured that our FVO missions to third countries will be very strict.
src: We shall remain vigilant and if something goes wrong, we shall try to put it right.
tgt: Wir müssen wachsam bleiben, und wenn etwas schief läuft, müssen wir das korrigieren.

previous_src: Our colleagues have not sent any official information, but we are expecting some at any moment.

tgt: Nous espérons que ces informations nous apprendront que les élections se sont déroulées de manière équitable et qu'il en sera de même pour le second tour, début février.

previous_src: Firstly, more consideration is to be given to local nutritional customs.

tgt: Zweitens: Die Geberländer können ihre Verpflichtungen nun in Mengen, wertmäßig oder als Kombination von Menge und Wert ausdrücken.

previous_src: I think that your observation concerning the quality of medical care in the various Member States is quite right.

tgt: Wir sind noch weit entfernt von einer Harmonisierung der Qualität des Gesundheitsmanagement als Ganzem.

previous_src: I returned just last Sunday from an official mission to the Democratic Republic of Congo where, in addition to my usual institutional meetings, I wanted to meet representatives of non-governmental organisations operating in the country and visit some of the centres where they work.
src: I must say they really do some great work.
tgt: Ich muss sagen, dass sie wirklich großartige Arbeit leisten.

previous_src: They are collectively inhabited by many thousands of human beings.
src: They have no elected governments and almost all have no law-making elected parliament.
tgt: Es gibt keine gewählten Regierungen, und fast nirgendwo findet man ein gesetzgebendes gewähltes Parlament.

previous_src: My generation has been fortunate enough to be involved in the reconstruction of a united Europe.
src: Young people have the right, representing the Europe of today, but particularly the Europe of tomorrow, to turn it into how they imagine it will be.
tgt: Junge Menschen stehen für das Europa von heute, aber vor allem für das Europa von morgen, und haben daher das Recht, es so zu gestalten wie sie es sich vorstellen.

previous_src: Extending the European Neighbourhood Policy to Armenia, Azerbaijan and Georgia is an important step forward in the Union's engagement with the region.
src: Just the name of the report, 'from promises to actions', however, is enough to encourage the Union to be more actively involved in this region.
tgt: Toutefois, le titre du rapport à lui seul, "des promesses aux actions", est suffisant pour inciter l'Union à s'impliquer plus activement dans cette région.

previous_src: I am sorry, but common sense is nowhere to be seen in this proposal for a directive, which we, too, propose should be rejected in its entirety.
src: If it is not rejected, we are all in danger of exposing ourselves because, if this sort of directive is adopted, it will have exactly the opposite of, what the Council says, are the desired results.
tgt: Wenn wir ihn nicht ablehnen, laufen wir Gefahr, unsere Prinzipien preiszugeben, da eine etwaige Annahme einer solchen Richtlinie genau das Gegenteil dessen bedeuten würde, was der Rat angestrebt hat.

previous_src: We should instead promote economic recovery by investing in renewable energy sources, environmentally friendly transport systems and the development of green technology.
src: Only by making these kinds of investments can we create growth that is sustainable in the long term.
tgt: Seuls de tels investissements nous permettront de générer une croissance durable à long terme.

previous_src: All Member States are now agreed on this and I think it is high time some action was taken.
src: This could mean a CO2 tax, a levy on value added or a tax on speculative capital movements.
tgt: Das bedeutet, es kann eine C02 -Steuer sein, eine Wertschöpfungsabgabe oder auch eine Besteuerung spekulativer Kapitalbewegungen.

previous_src: In the PPE-DE Group we are very pleased to note that the agreement with the rapporteur has worked and that we have been able to secure such a broad consensus within our committee.
src: If I remember rightly, we adopted this report with only one vote against.
tgt: Si mes souvenirs sont bons, nous avons adopté ce rapport par une seule voix contre.

previous_src: About two years ago, I asked the present Macedonian Foreign Minister: 'Why is so much hatred shown towards Macedonians who have taken Bulgarian citizenship?', to which he replied: 'They are vestiges of the past'.
src: As the efforts made by the Bulgarian President and Government have not yielded any result, I appeal to Commissioner Olli Rehn to familiarise himself personally with this blatant case of injustice in a country wishing to start accession negotiations.
tgt: Da die Bemühungen des bulgarischen Präsidenten und der bulgarischen Regierung bisher zu keinem Ergebnis geführt haben, ersuche ich Kommissar Olli Rehn, sich selbst mit diesem haarsträubenden Fall von Ungerechtigkeit in einem Land, das Beitrittsverhandlungen anstrebt, vertraut zu machen.

src: There is a similar trend in some of the old Member States: in Italy and in Ireland.
tgt: Eine ähnliche Entwicklung ist in einigen der alten Mitgliedstaaten, in Italien und Irland, zu beobachten.

previous_src: In view of these new powers - even if they are not really powers - we must take care to ensure that the Assembly has the means to perform its tasks.
src: I wish to say to the Commission and the Commissioner that we shall have to act together to find flexible and effective ways to work jointly on the procedure for the exercise of this new right to examine strategy papers.
tgt: Ich will damit der Kommission und dem Kommissar sagen, dass wir gemeinsam flexible und effiziente Mittel finden müssen, um einvernehmlich an dem Verfahren für das nunmehr geltende Recht auf Prüfung der Strategiedokumente zu arbeiten.

previous_src: Even though none of its representatives is present, I should like to thank the Council.
src: This evening would not have been possible, and we could not have taken all these decisions, if we had not had an active German Council Presidency in recent months.
tgt: Wir hätten den heutigen Abend nicht gestalten und die vielen Beschlüsse nicht fassen können, wenn wir in den letzten Monaten nicht einen aktiven deutschen Rat gehabt hätten.

previous_src: This is the last real dictatorship in Europe.
