tgt: La décision adoptée indique qu une constitution ne représente pas un plus pour la promotion de la démocratie, mais qu un renforcement de la volonté démocratique est nécessaire à cette fin.

previous_src: I am asking you to read my amendment carefully.
src: My group is definitely not about to question the obligatory nature of the system, because that would create unlawful discrimination between Member States and within the European Union itself, although it would not surprise me - and I am not referring to you, Mr Stevenson - that someone who had the gall to reject the Charter of Fundamental Rights in this House today could display equal or greater gall in rejecting the identification of ovine and caprine animals.
tgt: Mon groupe n'est en aucune manière sur le point de remettre en question la nature obligatoire du système, car cela créerait une discrimination illégitime entre les États membres et dans l'Union européenne proprement dite, même si je ne serais pas étonnée si - et je ne parle pas de vous, Monsieur Stevenson - quelqu'un qui a eu l'effronterie de rejeter la Charte des droits fondamentaux dans ce Parlement aujourd'hui devait faire preuve d'une effronterie similaire ou plus grande encore en rejetant l'identification des animaux des espèces ovine et caprine.

previous_src: The Commission has fulfilled its role in negotiating; it is now up to Parliament to accept or not to accept the deal.
src: I strongly recommend you do because it is important for the security of European citizens as well.
tgt: Ich empfehle Ihnen dringend, dies zu tun, denn diese Angelegenheit ist auch für die Sicherheit der europäischen Bürgerinnen und Bürger wichtig.

previous_src: (DE) Madam President, Baroness Ashton, the EU has an extensive range of measures which can be used to improve human rights policy in a number of countries.
src: The EU is a regional power which should be calling in multilateral forums for human rights policies to be implemented and ensuring that there is a greater focus on making progress in this area.
tgt: Die EU ist eine Regionalmacht, die in multilateralen Gremien die Menschenrechtspolitik einfordert und intensiver als bisher vorantreiben sollte.

previous_src: Flying as we do every week to one of the EU's capitals, we should be particularly concerned about making aviation a more environmentally friendly mode of transport.
src: In policies concerning the effect of aviation on climate change, the polluter ‘ pays ’ principle must be upheld.
tgt: Le principe du « pollueur payeur » doit être maintenu dans les politiques relatives à l impact de l aviation sur le changement climatique.

previous_src: In Germany 0.1 nanograms are permitted - I say this to give you an idea of the dimensions, that is those of you who do not work in the environmental field.
src: We could perhaps say that this is our job, but we must show concern for our colleagues so I would politely ask you to write to the authorities in Strasbourg to ask that this waste-incineration plant be closed down immediately, as we have a responsibility towards our colleagues.
tgt: Veiller à nousmêmes, nous pouvons peut-être dire que c'est notre boulot, mais nous devrions veiller à nos collaborateurs et je vous demanderai d'écrire aux autorités municipales de Strasbourg que cet incinérateur doit être arrêté immédiatement, car nous sommes responsables vis-à-vis de nos collaborateurs !

previous_src: It is particularly relevant for Parliament to give its opinion on the future development of these policy areas given that under the British presidency the informal meeting of Ministers in Glasgow chose to devote one whole day to discuss both urban policy and the European spatial planning perspective.
src: I congratulate Parliament's rapporteurs on their work and indeed the quality of both these reports and all of those people who have provided very good opinions to the reports.
tgt: Ich gratuliere den Berichterstattern des Parlaments zu ihrer Arbeit und der Qualität beider Berichte, ebenso wie allen anderen, die sehr gute Beiträge zu diesen Berichten geliefert haben.

previous_src: That means that the old European economic and social model will not work to deliver prosperity, social justice and jobs in the way it used to.
src: This is a big challenge, especially, if I may say so, for the country you represent, and for a number of others on the continent.
tgt: Das stellt eine große Herausforderung dar, insbesondere & #160; wenn ich das sagen darf & #160; für das Land, das Sie vertreten, und einige andere europäische Staaten.

previous_src: The Commission, in coordination with Member States, firmly supports a rights-based approach founded on the Convention of the Rights of the Child.
src: Since 1992, for almost one decade now, all cooperation agreements between the European Union and third countries have incorporated a clause defining human rights as an essential element of the agreement.
tgt: Seit 1992, also fast seit einem Jahrzehnt beinhalten alle Abkommen über Zusammenarbeit zwischen der Europäischen Union und Drittländern eine Klausel, in der die Menschenrechte als wesentliches Element des Abkommens bezeichnet werden.

previous_src: If one thing is clear, it is that our society is extremely vulnerable to crises of this kind.
src: We need a safety net.
tgt: Nous avons besoin d'un filet de sécurité.

previous_src: I believe that there is still a slight difference of opinion within Parliament over one point, and I hope that it can be overcome with tomorrow's vote.
src: It concerns the more or less binding nature that we wish to attribute to the contents of this report, which I would like to make a point of saying was drafted in a context of great understanding and great unanimity.
tgt: Ich meine damit den Grad der Verbindlichkeit, die wir den Inhalten des Berichts verleihen wollen, der, was ich hervorheben möchte, in einem Umfeld großer Einsicht und Einstimmigkeit erarbeitet worden ist.

previous_src: Initially, set-aside fulfilled its purpose as a measure for managing the market.
src: Surpluses were reduced by using them as animal feed and by prompt servicing of the world market.
tgt: Überschüsse wurden abgebaut durch Mehrverfütterung und durch zügige Bedienung des Weltmarktes.

previous_src: The point is that we are working towards 2010 and, if all goes according to plan, we should have a common asylum system up and running by then.
src: I am aware that this is a tricky issue on which a lowest common denominator, 'race to the bottom', strategy has been adopted, which leaves the way open for differences between Member States and for the continuation of so-called 'asylum shopping'.
tgt: Dabei ist mir klar, dass es sich um einen sehr schwierigen und heiklen Bereich handelt, für den die Strategie des kleinsten gemeinsamen Nenners, des "Wettbewerbs um die niedrigsten Standards" beschlossen wurde, was letztendlich zum Fortbestand unterschiedlicher Regelungen zwischen den Mitgliedstaaten und zur Fortsetzung des so genannten Asylshopping führt.

previous_src: We doubt whether this would be the case.
src: It usually depends on how the contributions are paid.
tgt: Es hängt ganz einfach davon ab, wie so ein Beitrag festgesetzt wird.

previous_src: (DE) Mr President, I would like to make an announcement and ask for your support.
src: As you know, our group had decided to hold an Enlarged Bureau meeting in Moscow to discuss the various problems connected with relations between Russia and the European Union with different Russian players - from the government as well as from the opposition.
tgt: Wie Sie wissen, hatte unsere Fraktion beschlossen, eine erweiterte Fraktionsvorstandssitzung in Moskau abzuhalten, um dort über die verschiedenen Probleme in den Beziehungen zwischen Russland und der Europäischen Union mit unterschiedlichen russischen Akteuren - von der Regierung wie auch von der Opposition - zu diskutieren.

previous_src: Are we for a fully integrated Union or are we for a fine running of the present status quo.
src: When citizens see their governments wavering from one to the other, who can blame them if they feel alien to the process itself?
tgt: Wenn die Bürger sehen, dass ihre Regierenden zwischen diesen beiden Optionen ständig hin und her schwanken, wie kann man ihnen dann einen Vorwurf machen, wenn sie dem Integrationsprozess selbst fremd gegenüberstehen?

previous_src: The proposed Reform Treaty is a self-amending Treaty.
src: What little will be left of sovereign power can be transferred to the EU by decisions of the European Council without recourse to Parliament, let alone the people.
tgt: Das bisschen souveräne Macht, das dann noch bleibt, kann durch Entscheidungen des Europäischen Rates auf die EU übertragen werden, ohne das Parlament oder gar das Volk zu befragen.

previous_src: Or is it a community of values, reaching back to common roots and a common cultural heritage?
src: In that case, what are those roots and what is the heritage?
tgt: Dans ce cas, quelles sont ces racines et quelle est la nature de cet héritage ?

previous_src: I would first of all like to express my solidarity with the families of the victims of the violence on the streets.
src: I think that we have here what I would describe as a conventional confrontation between the freedom of expression and association, on the one hand, and the need for the government to maintain public order, on the other.
tgt: Nous nous trouvons, selon moi, devant un dilemme classique entre, d'une part la liberté d'expression et d'association, et d'autre part la nécessité pour le gouvernement de maintenir l'ordre public.

previous_src: Furthermore, thanks to the preparatory action on an EU rapid response capability introduced by the European Parliament in the 2008 and 2009 budgets, the Commission is currently testing, with the Member States, ways to improve the overall immediate response capacity of the EU.
src: Together, these initiatives are contributing to shaping a genuine European disaster management policy for all types of disaster.
tgt: Zusammen tragen diese Initiativen zu der Entwicklung einer echten europäischen Politik für Katastrophenmanagement bei allen Arten von Katastrophen bei.

previous_src: I am counting on the Heads of State or Government to take this matter just as seriously in February as they did before the crisis, as it seems to me that, as things stand, the Member States will not vote for binding targets.
src: They may achieve a majority in Parliament, but the Member States want to work on a voluntary basis and they are still a long way from agreeing to the binding targets decided on two or three years ago.
tgt: Il se peut qu'ils obtiennent la majorité au Parlement, mais les États membres veulent travailler sur une base volontaire et ils sont encore loin d'accepter les objectifs contraignants décidés il y a deux ou trois ans.

previous_src: It is true that dual-denomination notes or coins would have required thought at an earlier stage and for that there would have had to be a real concern to lighten the burden on private individuals.
src: Nothing, though, could be more foreign to the inventors of the single currency.
tgt: Doch nichts liegt den Erfindern der gemeinsamen Währung ferner als das.

previous_src: The fire-fighters are dousing the flames with petrol.
src: It is high time the EU and its Member States put a stop to these deals.
tgt: Il est grand temps que l'UE et ses États membres mettent fin à ces pratiques.

previous_src: It must be fought at all levels using legitimate means.
src: The development of a democratic and open society is the best way of destroying the seedbeds of terrorism.
tgt: Eine demokratische, offene Gesellschaft ist die beste Voraussetzung, um dem Terrorismus den Boden zu entziehen.

previous_src: From what I have read and from what I understand, we would do well to take account of artists views ’ on intellectual property.
src: If we take account of the views of industrialists and consumers, should we not also consider artists, especially as they are always referred to in connection with the need to combat piracy?
tgt: Wenn wir die Stellungnahmen der Unternehmer und der Verbraucher berücksichtigen, sollten wir dann nicht auch die Künstler anhören, insbesondere da sie immer genannt werden, wenn es um die Notwendigkeit der Bekämpfung von Piraterie geht?

previous_src: Many of these challenges ahead are outlined in your report.
src: This is the occasion for Turkey to move even closer towards implementing fully the European Union political criteria.
tgt: C'est l'occasion pour la Turquie de se rapprocher encore plus d'une application intégrale des critères politique de l'Union européenne.

previous_src: On 4 November, two days previously, the Heads of Mission in Islamabad and the High Representative, Javier Solana, had expressed their concern at the course of events.
src: Our words, the words of the EU, were thus added to the many others reiterating how important it is to reinstate the Constitution, restore civil order, guarantee the independence of the judiciary and the freedom of the mass media, release all political prisoners, journalists and defenders of human rights and create the conditions required for the legislative elections to take place as planned, i.e. in January 2008.
tgt: Notre message, le message de l'UE, s'est donc ajouté aux nombreux autres qui réitéraient l'importance de rétablir la Constitution, restaurer l'ordre civil, garantir l'indépendance de la magistrature et la liberté des médias, relâcher tous les prisonniers politiques, les journalistes et les défenseurs des droits de l'homme et créer les conditions nécessaires pour que les élections législatives aient lieu comme prévu, c'est-à-dire en janvier 2008.

previous_src: (DE) Mr President, firstly, I would like to express my surprise that Baroness Ashton is once again not here.
src: However, I am pleased that she is being represented by my friend, Mr Németh.
tgt: Ich freue mich allerdings, dass sie von meinem Freund Zsolt Németh vertreten wird.

previous_src: I strongly request that the Commission and the Council of Ministers declare Iraq to be in an emergency state, to mobilise donor funding and spend it accordingly: housing inside, aid outside.
src: There is a lot that we can do, but we have to look at the situation differently.
tgt: Wir können eine Menge tun, aber wir müssen die Situation aus einem neuen Blickwinkel betrachten.

previous_src: The Member States are both the judge and the defendant, and would rather fail to implement the SGP than impose sanctions on one of their peers.
src: Being responsible for monitoring the process, the Commission must be granted powers to impose sanctions in the event of non-compliance.
tgt: Chargée de surveiller ce processus, la Commission doit se voir investie des pouvoirs lui permettant d imposer des sanctions en cas de non-respect.

previous_src: Mr President, I have a great regard for my colleague Mr Rothley, as he knows.
src: I truly believe that he is a great parliamentarian and a fine lawyer.
tgt: Je crois sincèrement que c'est un grand député et un magnifique juriste.

previous_src: The financial economy is global in nature.
src: The crisis, too, is global.
tgt: La crise aussi est mondiale.

previous_src: Here culture clearly draws the shorter straw and is in a weaker position than European internal market law.
src: Hence the urgent need, and tomorrow Parliament will decide the same way as the Committee on Culture and Education.
tgt: Deshalb ist es dringend notwendig, und das Parlament wird morgen auch so beschließen wie der Kulturausschuss.

previous_src: If the Community is not a party to the disarmament treaties or conventions, it can then legally only encourage partner countries to engage fully in multilateralism, in particular via participation in treaties and conventions.
src: I think our President has said a lot on this already.
tgt: Je pense que notre président en a déjà beaucoup dit à ce sujet.

previous_src: Firstly, I would like to share your concern about the continuing conflict and political instability in Somalia.
src: Somalia remains a context where fundamental rights and respect for basic human dignity continue to be shunned by armed entities perpetrating systematic and widespread attacks against civilians.
tgt: La Somalie est déchirée par des entités armées qui n'ont aucun respect des droits fondamentaux et de la dignité humaine et qui commettent des agressions systématiques et répandues à l'encontre des civils.

previous_src: We have no choice, however, but to point out that the compromise supported by the conservatives and the majority of the liberals does not bring any improvements in this area.
src: It does not apply either to asylum seekers or to those people intercepted at borders.
tgt: Il ne s'applique en effet ni aux demandeurs d'asile, ni aux personnes interceptées à la frontière.

previous_src: In this context, the European Monitoring Centre on Racism and Xenophobia in Vienna will have an important role to play, especially when it comes to cross-border efforts.
src: It may also be noted that, on 28 May, the Council and representatives of Member State governments will adopt a declaration concerning the fight against racism and xenophobia on the Internet.
tgt: Ferner sei daran erinnert, dass der Rat zusammen mit Regierungsvertretern der Mitgliedstaaten am 28. Mai eine Erklärung zum Kampf gegen Rassismus und Fremdenfeindlichkeit im Internet abgeben wird.

previous_src: The conclusions to Mr Decourrière's excellent report present particularly useful channels of thought for the future debate on the revision of the structural funds.
src: It is not enough to consume appropriations, maximum effectiveness in their utilization must be sought, which will require an in-depth re-examination of the objectives of the funds, as well as the modalities of project selection, as a function of a strategy decreed by common accord between the Commission and the public authority responsible.
tgt: Es reicht nämlich nicht aus, Mittel auszugeben; man muß sie möglichst effizient auszugeben trachten, was eine gründliche Überprüfung der Ziele der Fonds erfordern wird sowie Modalitäten für die Auswahl der Projekte, die auf einer von der Kommission und der zuständigen Behörde gemeinsam ausgehandelten Strategie beruhen.

previous_src: There is also something about adverts for sexual services.
src: That is completely beside the point.
tgt: Das gehört nun wahrlich nicht zur Sache.

previous_src: Mr President, Commissioner, I would like to thank the rapporteur very much.
src: As a matter of principle, I believe that we should avoid controlling consumption by means of VAT rates.
tgt: Grundsätzlich denke ich, dass wir verhindern sollten, den Konsum durch Mehrwertsteuersätze zu kontrollieren.

src: I hope, therefore, for European pressure on al-Bashir.
tgt: Ich hoffe daher, dass Europa Druck auf al-Bashir ausübt.

previous_src: We must also call polluters to greater account and strictly apply the 'polluter pays' principle.
src: Using public funds to clean up the damage and to assist people should be a last resort only, under the principle of solidarity.
tgt: Les finances publiques ne peuvent servir à financer la réparation des dégâts et à aider les populations qu'en dernier recours, au nom du principe de solidarité.

tgt: Wenn wir der Flächenstillegungsrate heute zustimmen, wissen die Bauern noch vor der Ernte, was sie nächstes Jahr erwartet, welche Flächen sie stillzulegen haben.

previous_src: First of all, we, as the Commission, are committed to making the EEAS a success.
src: It needs to be a shared enterprise with full buy-in of all the EU institutions and the Member States from the very start.
tgt: Es muss ein gemeinsames Unternehmen sein, an dem sich alle EU-Institutionen und die Mitgliedstaaten von Anfang an voll beteiligen.

previous_src: As I said, we might be able to send a smaller team of advisers to follow the process under the current circumstances.
src: If not, as I said, the state of emergency would have to be lifted very quickly and civil liberties restored.
tgt: Sinon, comme je l'ai indiqué, l'état d'urgence devrait être levé très rapidement et les libertés civiles, restaurées.

previous_src: The energy policy that is being advocated must ensure low carbon emissions and be based on solidarity and sustainability.
src: The reliability of the system is important, as operation must be continuous.
tgt: La fiabilité du système est importante, car il doit pouvoir fonctionner sans interruption.

previous_src: on behalf of the PSE Group. - (DE) Mr President, ladies and gentlemen, I would like to thank Mrs Figueiredo for her work.

tgt: Nous nous opposons à une Europe communiste et dictatoriale, qui efface les peuples en éliminant leurs différences.

src: EU support was aimed merely at contributing to compensation for the early stages of closure.
tgt: L'aide européenne ne devait que contribuer à la compensation des premières étapes de la fermeture.

previous_src: In requiring the parties to observe ‘ the principles upon which the European Union is founded ’, parties which do not subscribe to a particular European doctrine will be barred from receiving any funding.

tgt: Zudem wird diese Nachprüfung vom Parlament selbst eingeleitet und durchgeführt.

previous_src: Yet is it credible to say that we are going to war because there are weapons of mass destruction when in fact there are none and it is a lie?
src: We are not credible.
tgt: Wir sind nicht glaubwürdig.

src: We must encourage the European fisheries sector to become more involved and to take more responsibility, in line with the Dutch model.
tgt: Wir müssen den europäischen Fischereisektor dazu ermutigen, sich mehr zu engagieren und mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen, ganz nach dem Beispiel des dänischen Modells.

previous_src: This somewhat 'impressionist' approach, which has consisted of establishing a frequency plan in small brush strokes, has shown some limitations.

previous_src: UKIP wish to see the common agricultural policy abolished.
src: Therefore, under no circumstances can we vote for a report that gives even more power to a Commission whose legitimacy we do not recognise.
tgt: Aussi ne voterons -nous en aucun cas pour un rapport qui confère davantage de pouvoir encore à une Commission dont nous ne reconnaissons pas la légitimité.

src: Measures concerned with visiting regulations, the operation of institutions, training of staff in the penal system, prisoners' leisure activities or social assistance are and should remain a matter for the Member States, so that they can be adapted and developed in accordance with national and local needs.
tgt: Besuchsregelungen, der Betrieb von Haftanstalten, Ausbildung des Gefängnispersonals, Freizeitaktivitäten oder sozialer Beistand für Häftlinge sind und bleiben Angelegenheiten der Mitgliedstaaten, damit sie entsprechend dem nationalen und lokalen Bedarf angepasst und entwickelt werden können.

previous_src: Following heavy military intervention, the leaders of the demonstrators have surrendered.
src: However, the situation in Bangkok is continuing to escalate.
tgt: La situation à Bangkok continue cependant de s'aggraver.

src: At the weekend, we saw once again where that leads us.
tgt: Ce week-end, nous avons encore vu où cela nous menait.

tgt: Wir sind der Meinung, daß die Ziele für die Reduktion am besten erfüllt werden können, wenn es eine Zusammenarbeit von Politik und Maßnahmen der verschiedenen Richtungen gibt.

tgt: Pourquoi, Monsieur le Président, cette politique de qualité est -elle également importante ?

tgt: In diesem besonderen Fall unterstützt die Kommunistische Partei Griechenlands das Übereinkommen und das Protokoll über die Rechte von Menschen mit Behinderungen und die Verpflichtung der Mitgliedstaaten, es anzuwenden, trotz der Tatsache, dass sich diese Angelegenheit auf die gesamte Politik der kapitalistischen Länder bezieht, die, in Bezug auf Menschen, die besonderer Fürsorge bedürfen, eine unmenschliche Politik betreiben.

tgt: Ich bin der Meinung, dass alle Lösungen, die diese Ungleichgewichte in Bezug auf den Handel mittels des einfachen Vorschlagens von Freihandelsabkommen beheben wollen, nicht auf dem richtigen Weg sind.

src: This assessment will serve as a source of better knowledge and a solid basis for further initiatives in this field, as no systematic and integrated approach towards volunteering has been developed so far at EU level.
tgt: Diese Bewertung soll neue Erkenntnisse liefern und eine solide Basis für weitere Initiativen in diesem Bereich schaffen, da auf EU-Ebene bislang kein systematischer und integrierter Ansatz für die Freiwilligentätigkeit existiert.

previous_src: This may perhaps make sense in their eyes, but as members of the European Parliament, we have to serve the interests of Europeans.

tgt: Et servir les intérêts des Européens n'inclut certainement pas d'assister en permanence des millions de migrants économiques qui, vu leur absence de formation et de qualifications correspondant aux besoins de notre marché du travail, ne nous sont tout simplement pas très utiles.

previous_src: Recently, Germany was allocated 96 seats.

tgt: Unter Berücksichtigung der Statistik im "Stern" wäre es vielleicht klüger gewesen, diesem Land nur drei Sitze zuzuteilen, so dass der Vierte keine Chance hätte!

previous_src: The human rights organisation Odhikar has stated that information about mass arrests and maltreatment has been substantiated.
src: As a member of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) delegation of the European Parliament, I have visited Bangladesh several times.
tgt: Als Mitglied der SAARC-Delegation des Europäischen Parlaments konnte ich Bangladesch einige Male besuchen.

previous_src: Since the stocks are already heavily exploited through fishing for human consumption, the herring stock should be not be burdened by the addition of industrial fisheries.
src: In the Baltic, however, the situation is quite different.
tgt: In der Ostsee allerdings ist die Situation ganz anders.

previous_src: The Commission has withdrawn its proposal and I am very pleased about that.
src: The approach that it favoured was in fact dangerous and had sown seeds of division.
tgt: Der darin zugrunde gelegte Ansatz war gefährlich und führte zu Zwietracht.

previous_src: The Israeli Government talks of more than 1 000 migrants trying to enter their country without papers each month and has started to increase security and monitoring along the border.
src: In addition, a large detention camp has been set up in the Negev Desert.
tgt: Zudem ist ein großes Abschiebelager in der Wüste Negev errichtet worden.

previous_src: We cannot put off indefinitely the necessary process of phasing in the budgetary challenges of the Treaty of Lisbon.
src: I expect the new Commission to begin work very quickly and to make proposals which guarantee the rights of Parliament in every area and which do not attempt to modify individual rights through the back door, as this could be to the disadvantage of Parliament.
tgt: Ich erwarte von der neuen Kommission, dass sie sehr zügig an die Arbeit gehen und Vorschläge machen wird, die in allen Punkten die Rechte des Parlaments gewährleisten und bei denen nicht versucht wird, das eine oder andere durch die Hintertür wieder zu verändern, was dann möglicherweise zu Lasten des Parlaments ginge.

previous_src: Also, dealing with HIV / AIDS in neighbouring countries and in developing countries is not just our moral obligation towards our partner third countries, it is also a self-protection measure.
src: We have to use all practical arguments to convince those who take the decisions.
tgt: Wir müssen alle praktischen Argumente benutzen, um diejenigen, die die Entscheidungen treffen, zu überzeugen.

previous_src: The idea in the Ehler draft resolution to assess and improve the precuationary and early warning measures of the European Union with a view to ensuring the stability of the financial martkets, and the issue of guaranteeing deposits as a traditional form of savings in my country Bulgaria is very timely indeed.
src: In this context, I wish to emphasize that the responsibility of banks to carefully organize their porfolio and effectively manage the resources of their depositors is of paramount importance.
tgt: In diesem Zusammenhang möchte ich betonen, dass die Verantwortung der Banken, ihre Portfolios sorgfältig zu organisieren und die Gelder ihrer Anleger effizient zu verwalten, von herausragender Bedeutung ist.

previous_src: The Commission has brought a case against the Irish authorities and yet, by the time anything happens, there will be a motorway, probably there for already three or four years, and all the destruction will have happened.
src: The Irish people will not get over their disillusionment.
tgt: La population irlandaise ne se remettra pas de cette désillusion.

previous_src: Considering that more than half of the utilised agricultural area in the EU (54%) is classed as less-favoured areas - whether because of orography, climatic conditions or less fertile land - and that such a measure is essential to rural development, we conclude that aid for less-favoured areas must constitute a priority for the Member States.
src: For this reason, the preparation of a comprehensive strategy for less-favoured areas that meets the local needs of the various regions will lead to a reduction in the existing disparity between Member States as regards the aid that is awarded to them.
tgt: Ainsi la préparation d'une stratégie complète pour les zones défavorisées répondant aux besoins locaux des diverses régions mènera à une réduction du fossé qui existe entre les États membres en matière d'aide accordée.

previous_src: That is why the whole area of the prudential supervision of issuing companies is actually a key element without which the realm of electronic money cannot develop in an accountable way.
src: I should also like to remind the House of our urgent need to act in the field of banking supervision too.
tgt: Ich möchte auch daran erinnern, daß wir auch im Bereich der Bankenaufsicht dringenden Handlungsbedarf haben.

previous_src: By building a low-carbon and resource-efficient economy we can give a new impetus to competitiveness.
src: The Eco-design Directive represents a big opportunity for industry to build more competitive businesses based on green technologies.
tgt: La directive sur l'écoconception représente pour l'industrie une excellente opportunité de développer des activités plus concurrentielles basées sur les technologies vertes.

previous_src: As you are more than aware, the recent Commission communication on certain legal aspects related to cinematographic and other audiovisual works that my colleague, Viviane Reding, presented to the Council on 5 November, tackles the issues of the circulation of E-cinema, the tax regime applied to the industry, the protection of European audiovisual heritage, the classification of works and other problems affecting the circulation of films and other audiovisual works.
src: The implementation of the measures set out in this communication, combined with the application of the MEDIA Plus programme (2001-2005) and the joint initiative undertaken by the Commission and the European Investment Bank, i2i Audiovisual, should help to significantly improve the situation of European films.
tgt: La mise en uvre des actions prévues par cette communication, combinée à l'application du programme Media Plus 2001-2005 et à l'initiative conjointe de la Commission et de la Banque européenne d'investissement, i2i Audiovisuel, devrait contribuer à améliorer sensiblement la situation du cinéma européen.

previous_src: I can say the same about Amendments Nos 3 and 5.
src: On 30 January, the Commission transmitted to the Council a proposal relating to an embargo on imports of tuna from Belize and Honduras.
tgt: Ich teile dem Parlament mit, daß die Kommission dem Rat bereits am 30. Januar den Vorschlag über die Verhängung eines Embargos für Thunfischeinfuhren aus Belize und Honduras vorgelegt hat.

previous_src: Today we will identify it as a clear breach of human rights.
src: If even Tony Blair cannot get Israel to allow the import of equipment to stop 40 000 litres of untreated human waste poisoning the water supply, it is time for Europe to act.
tgt: Wenn selbst Tony Blair nicht in der Lage ist, Israel dazu zu bewegen, die Einfuhr von Ausrüstungen zu genehmigen, um damit der Vergiftung der Wasserversorgung durch 40 000 Liter unbehandelter Fäkalien Einhalt zu gebieten, ist es für Europa an der Zeit, zu handeln.

previous_src: Cutbacks are needed if we are to overcome the crisis.
src: The majority of this House should also apply that principle to the European budget.
tgt: Die Mehrheit dieses Hauses sollte diesen Grundsatz auch beim europäischen Haushaltsplan berücksichtigen.

previous_src: Today, more than ever, this policy is essential and must be regarded as a priority.
src: We must continue down this road with greater courage.
tgt: Wir müssen diesen Weg mit größerem Mut weiterverfolgen.

previous_src: (IT) Mr President, ladies and gentlemen, there is no doubt: it is clear that the Italian far left now runs this Parliament in practice.
src: Following a bad practice that is now established, the parliamentarians of the far left and the Greens keep using the Strasbourg Chamber as a vehicle to attack the Italian Government.
tgt: Gemäß einer schlechten Praxis, die sich nun etabliert hat, nutzen die Parlamentarier des ultralinken Flügels sowie die Grünen den Plenarsaal in Straßburg als Mittel, um die italienische Regierung zu attackieren.

previous_src: Greenhouse gas emissions must be analysed across the entire lifecycle and no funding should be provided to projects with an unsatisfactory record on CO2 emissions.
src: This analysis is particularly important for projects that have a biomass component.
tgt: Speziell bei Projekten, wo Biomasse im Spiel ist, muss diese Analyse Anwendung finden.

previous_src: Mr President, as I stated earlier, I wish to put forward an oral amendment, adding a further brief point to the draft legislative resolution.
src: It reads as follows: 'Calls on the Commission to draw up as soon as possible a draft regulation effectively securing free movement of workers in the Member States of the European Union'.
tgt: Der kurze Text lautet wie folgt: "Fordert die Kommission auf, kurzfristig einen Verordnungsvorschlag auszuarbeiten, der die Freizügigkeit der Arbeitnehmer aus den Mitgliedstaaten innerhalb der Europäischen Union wirksam garantiert."

previous_src: My country has recently made huge steps towards improving the asylum situation, with solid assistance from the European Commission.
src: However, this is obviously not enough.
tgt: Il ne fait cependant aucun doute que ce n'est pas suffisant.

previous_src: Whether we like it or not, all human activities have an impact on the environment, and such a provision is disproportionate in this context.
src: Instead, my group believes we need to strike the right balance between encouraging innovation and applying the precautionary principle concerning food safety, consumer and environmental protection and animal welfare.
tgt: Meine Fraktion ist stattdessen der Ansicht, dass wir im Hinblick auf Lebensmittelsicherheit, Verbraucher- und Umweltschutz und Tiergesundheit das richtige Gleichgewicht zwischen Innovationsförderung und der Anwendung des Prinzips der Vorbeugung finden müssen.

previous_src: Secondly, the third line of action -innovation and inclusion of SMEs -has been appreciably extended since the EU has obvious deficiencies in the area of innovation and product development vis-à-vis its international rivals.
src: Since it is often the small and medium-sized businesses who operate in a very innovative way and thereby create new jobs, it seemed important to us to offer a special type of support where the actual development does not quite fit exactly into one of the programmes.
tgt: Da es häufig gerade diese kleineren und mittelständischen Betriebe sind, die hoch innovativ arbeiten und so Arbeitsplätze schaffen, erschien es uns wichtig, eine spezielle Förderung auch dort zu ermöglichen, wo die jeweilige Entwicklung nicht exakt in eines der Programme zu passen scheint.

previous_src: A constitutional amendment bill which aims to limit the immunity of judges is being put before Parliament without inviting prior comments and without having a specialist debate.
src: Slovakia's drift towards a deformation of democracy and the legal state is also evidenced by the fact that the President of the Supreme Court and the President of the Judicial Council have twice been prevented from speaking in a plenary of the National Council during debates on laws concerning the judiciary, including a law on the Judicial Council.
tgt: Das slowakische Abdriften in eine Verzerrung von Demokratie und Rechtsstaatlichkeit wird auch durch die Tatsache deutlich, dass der Präsident des Obersten Gerichtshofs und der Präsident des Obersten Justizrates bereits zwei Mal davon abgehalten wurden, auf einer Plenarsitzung des Nationalrates bei Debatten über die Judikative, einschließlich eines Gesetzes über den Obersten Justizrat, zu sprechen.

previous_src: Mr President, reference was made to me earlier by Mr Matsakis and I wanted to respond to it.
src: I did not want to abuse the catch-the-eye system on a different debate, which was an important issue on the death penalty.
tgt: Je ne veux pas abuser de la procédure "catch the eye" dans un débat différent qui porte sur un sujet aussi important que celui de la peine de mort.

previous_src: Our rapporteur quotes a number of particularly impressive statistics relating to industrial fisheries: 30% of all world catches comes from industrial fisheries.
src: The proportion may be as high as 60% in some seas, such as the North Sea, which is extremely vulnerable, as we all know.
tgt: Dieser Anteil erreicht 60% bei einigen Meeren wie im Falle der Nordsee, obwohl ihr Ökosystem bekanntlich äußerst prekär ist.

previous_src: The report before us – on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down specific measures for agriculture in the outermost regions – forms part of the process of implementing that strategy.
src: The agriculture sector is hugely important to these regions, and this report represents substantial and noteworthy progress in this regard.
tgt: Le secteur de l agriculture est extrêmement important pour ces régions et ce rapport représente un progrès substantiel et notable à cet égard.

previous_src: Of course there was, and is, a winner: Russia.
src: With the help of the Georgian President, the Kremlin is completing, resolutely and by military means, the political annexation of Abkhazia and South Ossetia.
tgt: Avec l'aide du président géorgien, le Kremlin est en train de réaliser, résolument et manu militari, l'annexion politique de l'Abkhazie et de l'Ossétie du Sud.

previous_src: For years, since the 1991 regulation, we have been trying to ban this monstrosity.
src: Every year, the European Commission tells us: "another short delay, Mr Torturer, just a little more time '.
tgt: Jedes Jahr sagt uns die Europäische Kommission: "Einen kleinen Moment noch, sehr geehrter Henker, gleich sind wir so weit."

previous_src: There is currently no one representing our interests on this matter.
src: In this respect, too, I would call on the Commission to finally appoint someone.
tgt: Auch hier ist die Kommission aufgerufen, endlich einmal jemand zu benennen.

previous_src: It offers an alternative to existing national proposals and, to that extent, represents an improvement.
src: However, the proposal is ruined completely by the fact that the Commission also wishes to regulate the taxation of this legal entity at EU level.
tgt: Der Vorschlag wird jedoch völlig durch einen Aspekt ruiniert, nämlich dem, dass die Kommission die Besteuerung dieser juristischen Person auf EU-Ebene regulieren möchte.

previous_src: Of course, we do not think that problems can be solved just by throwing money at them, but in fact there are situations, like the current one, when we believe special attention has to be given to a situation of social urgency.
src: Exceptional measures were needed for what was an unprecedented situation.
tgt: Für diese noch nie dagewesene Situation waren Sondermaßnahmen erforderlich.

previous_src: (HU) In the northern part of Hungary, several tens of thousands of people come across the border from Slovakia to work, while several thousand people have moved and now live in the northern part of Hungary, in Rajka and other villages.
src: Thanks to the excellent infrastructure and the Schengen Agreement, they work in Slovakia and live in Hungary.
tgt: Dank der hervorragenden Infrastruktur und dem Schengener Abkommen arbeiten sie in der Slowakei und leben in Ungarn.

previous_src: Many consultations have already been held since the adoption of the objective of MSY at the Johannesburg Summit.
src: Such consultations involved Member States, scientists and the regional advisory councils, who are studying our proposal as well and who are seeking to advise us on the best way forward.
tgt: De telles consultations réunissaient les États membres, les scientifiques et les conseils régionaux consultatifs qui étudient de même notre proposition et qui s'efforcent de nous orienter vers les meilleurs choix pour avancer.

previous_src: She raised the issue of lithium, along with other MEPs who have spoken about batteries during this debate.
src: Precisely because it recognises the problem, the Commission has decided to include in its work programme - and we also spoke about this during a recent meeting with Mrs Merkies - a communication on the problem of raw materials, which is a priority for us.
tgt: Gerade weil sie sich dieses Problems bewusst ist, hat die Kommission entschieden, eine Mitteilung über das Problem der Rohstoffe, das für uns Priorität hat, in ihr Arbeitsprogramm aufzunehmen - darüber haben wir auch bei einem vor Kurzem stattgefundenen Treffen mit Frau Merkies gesprochen.

previous_src: Unlawfulness and widespread corruption led to the emigration of 300 000 citizens from Russia last year alone.
src: It is hard to envisage both foreign and domestic business investments in such a climate.
tgt: Il est difficile d'envisager des investissements étrangers et nationaux dans un tel climat.

previous_src: I have now determined, for example during my visit to Romania, that at least a third of the total cultivatable land is lying idle, as it always has.
src: We have considerable resources within our Member States.
tgt: Nous disposons de ressources considérables au sein de nos États membres.

previous_src: Unfortunately, we can see that these rules are not complied with in every Member State.
src: This is why I am suggesting to the Commission to propose as its objective to inspect the quality of the national institutions entrusted with enforcing EU regulations on the storage of potentially hazardous industrial waste.
tgt: Deshalb empfehle ich der Kommission, als Ziel eine Qualitätskontrolle der einzelstaatlichen Institutionen vorzuschlagen, die mit der Durchsetzung der EU-Vorschriften über die Lagerung potenziell gefährlicher Industrieabfälle betraut sind.

previous_src: Desertification, the disappearance of fertile layers of soil and vegetation, is taking place all around the world, from the coasts of Spain to the plains of China.
src: Almost a third of the land area of the globe is at risk of desertification.
tgt: Près d'un tiers de la surface terrestre du globe est menacée par la désertification.

previous_src: Sorry, Mr Duff, I know you do not follow Formula One!
src: I should like to make five points.
tgt: Ich möchte fünf Anmerkungen machen.

previous_src: Changing international treaties is difficult and proceeds far too slowly.
src: Progress is made if countries can easily reform their national institutions.
tgt: Les avancées s'obtiennent lorsque les pays sont en mesure de réformer facilement leurs institutions nationales.

previous_src: Its chance of influence is in amending legislation put before us.
src: It seems that, in the way we have interpreted the recast procedures, we have castrated ourselves.
tgt: Es scheint so, als hätten wir uns durch die Art und Weise wie wir die Neufassungsverfahren ausgelegt haben, selbst kastriert.

previous_src: What is the situation like for the consumer?
src: Now, after several weeks during which the price per kilo has remained lower than FRF 6 per kilo of live weight, consumer prices are still the same.
tgt: Aujourd'hui, après plusieurs semaines durant lesquelles le prix au kilo est resté inférieur à six francs/ kg de poids vif, les prix à la consommation restent les mêmes.

previous_src: on behalf of the ECR Group. - Mr President, I would like to congratulate Mr Balz on his report.
src: However, at a time when the euro is facing new crises every day and it is generally accepted that new forms of governance and new rules are required for survival, it is hard for the ECB to weigh in on outside global issues.
tgt: Es ist jedoch für die EZB in einer Zeit, in welcher der Euro jeden Tag eine neue Krise erlebt und es allgemein akzeptiert wird, dass neue Formen der Steuerung und neue Regeln überlebenswichtig sind, schwierig, sich bei äußeren globalen Themen einzubringen.

previous_src: Only then will efficient controls be possible.
src: This serves to protect workers and prevents competition being distorted in a way which benefits those enterprises that wish to grow rich on the backs of illegal workers.
tgt: Dies dient dem Schutz der Arbeitnehmerinnen und Arbeitnehmer und verhindert eine Wettbewerbsverzerrung zugunsten jener Unternehmer, die sich durch illegale Beschäftigte letztlich bereichern wollen.

previous_src: If the European Union is exporting and wishes to export its basic democratic values associated with the protection of human rights and the values of good governance, it must itself become the best example of these values.
src: However, speaking from the perspective of the post-communist new Member States, but also of states aspiring to democracy and states in transition, I must conclude with regret that, due to their limited transparency, European Union institutions are still not the best example to follow.
tgt: Aus der Sicht der postkommunistischen neuen Mitgliedstaaten jedoch, aber auch der Staaten, die nach Demokratie streben und sich in einem Prozess des gesellschaftlichen Wandels befinden, muss ich bedauerlicherweise feststellen, dass die Institutionen der Europäischen Union aufgrund ihrer mangelnden Transparenz nach wie vor nicht das beste Beispiel zur Nachahmung abgeben.

previous_src: We examined the customary documents, Mr & # 160; President, including the declaration on incompatibility and the declaration of financial interests.
src: We unanimously agreed that everything was in order, which means a recommendation can be made to proceed.
tgt: Nous avons décidé à l unanimité que tout était en ordre, ce qui signifie qu une recommandation peut être faite afin de poursuivre la procédure.

previous_src: I wish to highlight just two aspects of this initiative at the moment: European Convention No 116 of the Council of Europe of 24 November 1983 on the compensation of victims of violent crimes.
src: I would like to highlight that, despite its importance and the fact that it is a mandatory point of reference in Europe, the Convention has still not been ratified, as of 18 September 2000, by the following Member States of the European Union: Austria, Belgium, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Portugal and Spain.
tgt: Hier muss hervorgehoben werden, dass das Übereinkommen trotz seiner Bedeutung und trotz der Tatsache, dass es ein in Europa verankerter Eckpfeiler ist, von folgenden Mitgliedstaaten der Europäischen Union immer noch nicht (per 18.9.2000) ratifiziert wurde: Österreich, Belgien, Griechenland, Irland, Italien, Portugal und Spanien.

previous_src: (PT) Commissioner, ladies and gentlemen, given the ethical importance of this issue, the discussion that we are engaged in is of great political relevance.
src: The dichotomy between protecting intellectual property and promoting the health and well-being of the populations of less-developed countries arises out of a conflict of interests that can be resolved only by a comparison of values.
tgt: La dichotomie entre la protection de la propriété intellectuelle et la promotion de la santé et du bien-être des populations des pays moins avancés provient d'un conflit d'intérêts qui ne peut être résolu que par une comparaison de valeurs.

previous_src: Clearly, global competition, as encouraged by the WTO, is the main reason for the widespread impoverishment and lack of dynamism of Europe.
src: The European Union urgently needs to put an end to this madness, and finally to set up Community protection and preference.
tgt: Il est urgent que l'Union européenne arrête cette folie, pour mettre enfin en place protection et préférence communautaires.

previous_src: I want you to understand this.
src: Over the last five years, in order to implement political decisions taken by the Council, for exceptional reasons, and to keep the Palestinian Authority active for political reasons, the Commission has had to finance current expenditure operations that were not included in the economic assistance programme.
tgt: In der Vergangenheit, in den letzten fünf Jahren mußte die Kommission in strikter Erfüllung der im Rat gefaßten politischen Beschlüsse ausnahmsweise und um die palästinensische Verwaltung am Leben zu erhalten, aus politischen Gründen die Operationen der laufenden Ausgaben finanzieren, die nicht im Programm für Wirtschaftshilfe enthalten sind.

previous_src: This document says and shows clearly that the current policies are not sufficient.
src: We must do more to respond to current challenges.
tgt: Wir müssen mehr tun, um die aktuellen Herausforderungen anzugehen.

previous_src: However, the other key limb of our infrastructure is languishing in neglect and resulting decline, namely the link from Belfast to our second city, Londonderry.
src: This is something which I discussed with the Commissioner when he visited Northern Ireland some time ago.
tgt: Über diese Frage habe ich mit dem Kommissar während seines Besuchs in Nordirland vor einiger Zeit gesprochen.

previous_src: Realism must not, however, be confused with ignorance of the difficulties nor with the absence of a framework of values.
src: Although improvements have been made in some areas, today's Russia is far from being a free and open democracy that upholds human rights in full.
tgt: Bien que des améliorations aient été faites dans certains domaines, la Russie d'aujourd'hui est loin d'être une démocratie libre et ouverte qui respecte totalement les droits de l'homme.

previous_src: In that case, of course, decisions need to be taken by consensus.
src: It also strikes us as desirable that along with the Centre s Director ’, the Centre s Chairperson ’ can also be heard by Parliament.
tgt: Außerdem erscheint es uns wünschenswert, dass neben dem Direktor der Beobachtungsstelle auch der Vorsitzende der Beobachtungsstelle vor dem Parlament gehört werden kann.

previous_src: We need to appoint a President and Commissioners who will ensure that social aims take precedence over economic ones.
src: We need to opt for a social Europe in which the fate of working people is deemed to be just as important as profit.
tgt: Nous devons opter pour une Europe sociale dans laquelle le sort des travailleurs est jugé aussi important que le profit.

previous_src: So I would say that the risks here are minimal.
src: Commitment is the starting point and I look on this process as a very positive one.
tgt: L'engagement est le point de départ et je considère que ce processus est très positif.

previous_src: In our education systems, we specialise in the contrary, that is to say self-enclosed educational courses, limited by time and with heavy emphasis upon the final examination.
src: Lifelong learning requires the opposite, namely continuity and courses of long duration.
tgt: L'apprentissage tout au long de la vie exige le contraire : à savoir, une continuité et des cursus de longue durée.

previous_src: (HU) Am I right in understanding then that freedom of assembly, freedom of opinion, human rights and even the European Convention on Human Rights are not, according to what you have said, part of European Union law?
src: Are human rights not part of the European Union's system of values and legal system?
tgt: Sind Menschenrechte nicht Teil des Werte- und Rechtssystems der Europäischen Union?

previous_src: The recent adoption of the proposed directive on retention of data was accompanied by a clear call for adequate guarantees to be adopted as part of this framework decision.
src: As rapporteur on three legislative measures on the creation of the Schengen II information system, I sought to introduce the amendments needed to ensure the adoption of this framework decision.
tgt: Als Berichterstatter zu drei legislativen Maßnahmen zur Schaffung des Schengen-Informationssystems II habe ich versucht, die Änderungen durchzusetzen, die zur Annahme dieses Rahmenbeschlusses notwendig waren.

previous_src: I will end on a positive note.
src: I want to welcome the release of the three Bulgarian hostages who worked for the UN Humanitarian Air Service and were abducted from Darfur in January.
tgt: Je me réjouis de la libération des trois otages bulgares qui travaillaient pour le service aérien humanitaire des Nations unies et qui avaient été enlevés au Darfour en janvier.

previous_src: This is, therefore, highly significant.
src: However, I believe that this report will be all the more significant if Parliament approves its binding character tomorrow.
tgt: Ich denke aber, dass dieser Bericht noch viel bedeutender sein wird, falls das Parlament morgen darüber verbindlich abstimmt.

previous_src: Nevertheless, recent estimates show that the situation is growing worse.
src: In the last two years, more than five million people have been forced to leave their homes.
tgt: Gleichwohl zeigen letzte Schätzungen eine Zuspitzung der Situation.

previous_src: The Commission is prepared to consider all the options, but there is one direction it refuses to take, that of a diluted and distorted reform.
src: This would be contrary to the interests of Europe and its farmers.
tgt: Das würde den Interessen Europas und der Landwirte zuwiderlaufen.

previous_src: Canada justified its move on the grounds that, on the other side of the ocean, Czech citizens, particularly Roma, were applying en masse for asylum.
src: In these circumstances I would like to say that in the Czech Republic, the same conditions apply to everyone, regardless of whether they have Czech, Slovak, Vietnamese or Ukrainian nationality or whether they are of Czech, Afro-American or Roma origin.
tgt: Unter diesen Umständen möchte ich sagen, dass in der Tschechischen Republik für alle dieselben Bedingungen gelten, ob sie nun tschechischer, slowakischer, vietnamesischer oder ukrainischer Nationalität oder Tschechen, Afroamerikaner oder Roma sind.

previous_src: Colleagues have spoken about the unprecedented flooding that took place in Ireland at the weekend.

tgt: Ich war und bin immer noch der Meinung, dass dieser Grundsatz, wie in Verordnung (EG) Nr. 883 verankert, Ausgangspunkt für uns sein muss für die kombinierte Erlaubnis.

previous_src: If these reports show that the summer time arrangements need to be altered, the Commission could then bring forward appropriate proposals.

tgt: Der erste Bericht ist bis spätestens zum 30. April 2007 vorzulegen.

previous_src: Well that was a most diplomatically crafted answer, but perhaps I could try again in a slightly different context.

tgt: Wie ich sehe, wird in der Zeitung heute gemeldet, dass ein gewisses Nahrungsmittelverarbeitungsunternehmen Schutz gegen Einfuhren von Zuckermais aus Thailand fordert.

previous_src: The aim of today's plenary debate is to discuss the issue with all the Members of this House, and also with the Council and the Commission.
src: It is also very important that I take away from today's debate some suggestions and comments for the coming talks with the German Presidency.
tgt: Es wäre für mich auch sehr wichtig, dass ich aus dieser heutigen Debatte einige Anregungen und Hinweise für die noch folgenden Gespräche mit der deutschen Präsidentschaft mitnehmen könnte.

previous_src: Europe's huge industrial assets need to be re-directed to seizing the first-mover advantage in tomorrow's markets.

tgt: Toutefois, l'Europe doit conserver une base industrielle solide, moderne et concurrentielle.

previous_src: With regard to the control of delegated acts, we are on an equal footing with the Council, and we also want to utilise our equal standing to the full.
src: That means, Commissioner, that when you argue that the urgency procedure is possible, then we will also need to receive information at as early a stage as possible.
tgt: Cela veut dire, Monsieur le Commissaire, que lorsque vous faites valoir que la procédure d'urgence est possible, alors il faut aussi que nous recevions des informations à un stade aussi précoce que possible.

previous_src: Expenditure on purchasing and renting buildings is one of the main administrative cost items of EU institutions.
src: Just over three years ago the institutions were using total space in excess of 2 million square metres.
tgt: Genau vor drei Jahren haben die Institutionen einen Gesamtbedarf an über 2 Millionen Quadratmetern Fläche gehabt.

previous_src: What we have here, then, is a paradigm shift, not only in the economy, but also in broad strata of society, not only through e-learning and the new opportunities provided by technology, but also through a change in consciousness.
src: I believe that this very change in consciousness shows that adults in all walks of life really do consider lifelong learning of this kind to be more and more important.
tgt: Ich glaube, gerade diese Bewusstseinsänderung zeigt, dass die Erwachsenen in allen Lebenslagen eigentlich dieses lebensbegleitende Lernen für immer wichtiger halten.

previous_src: If you look at the campaign in France, most of the websites on the Constitution were 'no' websites.
src: Where were those who wanted to argue for a 'yes' vote?
tgt: Wo waren die, die für "Ja" werben wollten?

previous_src: Her case is being raised by civil society, human rights organisations and churches across Scotland.

tgt: Es wurde sogar gestern in der Sendung "Thought for the Day" in Radio Scotland darüber berichtet.

previous_src: This type of research will only be developed if it really is a solution that is scientifically proven to be necessary.

tgt: Mit anderen Worten. es müssen zahlreiche Wissenschaftler, darunter auch diejenigen, die sich aus ethischen Gründen gegen die Forschung an überzähligen embryonalen Stammzellen aussprechen wie einige Professoren, die bei unseren Zusammenkünften zugegen waren & #160;, anerkennen, dass diese Methode nützlich ist, die Forschung an adulten Stammzellen ergänzt und nicht ausgeschlossen werden darf.

previous_src: That is the rule, but it was such a pleasure to listen to you that we took great delight in hearing what you had to say.
src: We now come to our rapporteur, Mrs Riera-Madurell.
tgt: Nous en revenons maintenant à notre rapporteure Mme Riera Madurell.

previous_src: This partnership has become necessary, bearing in mind not only Mexico's important role on the global political and economic stage, but also its very close economic ties with the European Union.
src: Mexico has a population of more than 100 million, is the tenth-largest economic power in the world and is a member of the G20 Group.
tgt: Mexiko hat mehr als 100 Millionen Einwohner, ist die zehntgrößte Wirtschaftsmacht der Welt und Mitglied der G20.

previous_src: on behalf of the PSE Group. - (PT) I would like to begin by congratulating the rapporteur for the excellent work done, for the ongoing dialogue with the shadow rapporteurs, and for the openness and receptivity to suggestions presented to him.
src: Many people took part in the process and I think that is quite exemplary.
tgt: An diesem Prozess waren viele beteiligt, und das halte ich für beispielhaft.

previous_src: This is what Jean Monnet said in 1954.
src: The words have lost none of their relevance, rather the contrary.
tgt: Und diese Worte haben nichts von ihrer Bedeutung eingebüßt, ganz im Gegenteil.

previous_src: It is interesting, however, that the Austrian Greens have all left the Chamber.
src: To accuse me of not seeking dialogue with the people seems to me to be a little unfair, for the Café d Europe ‘ ’ ’ was really an attempt to become involved with everyday life.
tgt: M accuser de ne pas chercher le dialogue me semble un peu injuste, car le « Café d Europe » était vraiment une tentative d implication dans la vie de tous les jours.
