src: The problem is not only confined to the steel industry.
tgt: Dieses Problem betrifft auch nicht speziell den Stahlsektor.

previous_src: The issue of the possible liberalisation of domestic services gave rise to much debate within the Committee on Transport and Tourism.
src: As a major compromise, we suggest that the possibility of liberalisation in the years 2017-2022 be considered, for the Fifteen and the EU as a whole respectively.
tgt: Als einen wichtigen Kompromiss schlagen wir vor, eine etwaige Liberalisierung im Zeitraum 2017-2022 sowohl für die EU der Fünfzehn als auch für die EU insgesamt in Erwägung zu ziehen.

previous_src: I want to put on record my thanks to members of the committee, in particular the shadows, Mr Wieland, who is here this evening, and Mrs Wallis, who cannot be here.
src: They have not only supported my approach but have made useful and constructive proposals for amendments at every stage of the procedure.
tgt: Sie haben nicht nur meinen Ansatz unterstützt, sondern auch in jeder Phase des Verfahrens nützliche und konstruktive Änderungsvorschläge unterbreitet.

previous_src: It needs the support of all of the European stakeholders.
src: Today we have achieved an important milestone.
tgt: Heute haben wir einen wichtigen Meilenstein erreicht.

previous_src: I should like to express my appreciation for their active cooperation and sensible comments.
src: These consultations enabled me to assess the existing system and also to familiarise myself with the wishes of these countries and organisations so as to incorporate them.
tgt: Diese Konsultationen ermöglichten mir, den bestehenden Regelungsrahmen zu bewerten und mich mit den Wünschen dieser Staaten und Verbände vertraut zu machen, um sie dann berücksichtigen zu können.

previous_src: A concentration of guarantees in a single system can only be achieved through a proliferation of regulations and agreements between states, something which fragments the system and makes it more vulnerable to an unacceptable accumulation of risk.
src: There are substantial questions marks over the aims of the deposit-guarantee scheme: harmonisation of levels of cover, risk-based contributions, utilisation of funds to provide liquidity, burden-sharing, handling of cross-border crises, liquidation of institutions and cooperation between authorities.
tgt: Die Ziele des Einlagensicherungssystems werfen substantielle Fragen auf: Harmonisierung der Deckungssummen, risikobasierte Beiträge, Einsatz von Mitteln zur Gewährleistung der Liquidität, Lastenteilung, grenzüberschreitendes Krisenmanagement, Abwicklung von Institutionen und Zusammenarbeit zwischen Behörden.

previous_src: (PL) Mr President, Ukraine stands today before a strategic decision: whether to make the divisions in the country permanent through the creation of an orange coalition, or to create an Our Ukraine coalition with the Party of Regions.
src: The decision taken in this regard will have a profound significance for future EU-Ukraine relations.
tgt: Die diesbezüglich zu treffende Entscheidung wird von großer Bedeutung für die künftigen Beziehungen zwischen der EU und der Ukraine sein.

previous_src: The North Sea's ecology must be considered holistically in North Sea terms.
src: The North Sea is not the Mediterranean.
tgt: Die Nordsee ist nicht das Mittelmeer.

previous_src: We are in favour of there actually being a general regulation on the transfer of passenger - essentially air passenger - data.
src: We have therefore asked the Commission to carry out a study and, if appropriate, to prepare a draft directive laying down a general regulation in that respect including - as Mrs in 't Veld's motion for a resolution states - a privacy impact assessment.
tgt: Wir haben deshalb die Kommission aufgefordert, eine Untersuchung durchzuführen und, falls dies angemessen scheint, einen Richtlinienentwurf vorzubereiten, der eine allgemeine Regelung in dieser Hinsicht festlegt, die - wie das in Frau in t 'Velds Entschließungsantrag festgelegt ist - eine Folgenabschätzung in Bezug auf die Privatsphäre umfasst.

previous_src: Let me say to Mr & # 160; Mitchell that, first of all, I do not feel qualified to make moral judgments here as to whether we are selfish or not, but, yes, it is very much in our interest to help those countries.
src: It is not only a matter of trade, it is also a matter of global security and it is a matter of migration, which we have talked about today and during the last month and will talk about again in the future.
tgt: Dabei geht es nicht nur um Handel, sondern auch um internationale Sicherheit und Migrationsfragen, über die wir heute und im vergangenen Monat gesprochen haben und auf die wir auch in Zukunft wieder eingehen werden.

previous_src: A very important point for us, as parliamentarians, was the protection of citizens and consumers from fraudulent practices.
src: This applies not only to consumers but also to small enterprises and tradespeople.
tgt: Das gilt nicht nur für Verbraucher, sondern auch für Kleinunternehmen und Gewerbetreibende.

previous_src: The Commission has examined your amendments in an open and constructive manner, and I can tell you that it will accept in full or in part 15 out of the 16 amendments tabled.
src: These will be included in a revised proposal which will be submitted to the Council in the next few days.
tgt: Die Kommission wird sie in einen überarbeiteten Vorschlag aufnehmen, der dem Rat in den nächsten Tagen vorgelegt wird.

previous_src: European leaders cannot ignore this important demonstration.
src: We therefore salute the General Confederation of Portuguese Workers and its members and express our commitment to the struggle to protect the dignity of working people.
tgt: Wir übermitteln dementsprechend unsere Grüße an den Allgemeinen Verband portugiesischer Arbeitnehmer und seine Mitglieder und verleihen unserer Verpflichtung im Kampf zum Schutz der Würde der Arbeitnehmer Ausdruck.

previous_src: At the moment, the UK is disproportionately providing assistance.
src: I hope that the London conference will encourage other countries to do more, including the European Union, and, I agree, other regional states.
tgt: Ich hoffe, dass die London-Konferenz andere Länder, einschließlich der Europäischen Union, und, da stimme ich zu, andere Regionalstaaten dazu ermutigen wird, mehr zu tun.

previous_src: That game is about the greedy division among themselves of the richly flowing oil funds and about playing senior party members and reformists off against one other.
src: European aloofness and a word of caution are really called for here, for the benefit of Azerbaijan s society ’.
tgt: Europa sollte hier zum Wohle der aserbaidschanischen Gesellschaft in der Tat Zurückhaltung üben, ein mahnendes Wort aber wäre angebracht.

previous_src: Commissioner Leonard Orban himself believes that fostering national minorities' mother tongues is a matter of strategic importance.
src: In this European Year of Intercultural Dialogue, it is lamentable and unacceptable that Slovakia is acting in a manner that runs counter to European practice.
tgt: In diesem Europäischen Jahr des interkulturellen Dialogs ist es bedauerlich und inakzeptabel, dass die Slowakei entgegen der europäischen Praxis handelt.

previous_src: I would suggest to Parliament that, possibly, if they split the price of tickets from mileage, there might be more support in the future.
src: I think citizens will watch this vote and will again be disappointed.
tgt: Ich denke, dass sich die Bürger diese Abstimmung ansehen und wieder einmal enttäuscht waren.

previous_src: Of course, the impact of enlargement within the Union will vary from one country to another and from one region to another.
src: Thanks to the single market, however, the benefits will be visible everywhere.
tgt: Toutefois, grâce au marché unique, ses avantages pourront être ressentis partout.

previous_src: An end - or at any rate the beginning of an end - is now put to the practice of paying a high price for meat that comes from animals that have been tortured, and we will soon have nice pink veal from happy animals.
src: That does not mean that the farmer's wife will no longer get white meat in her confinement, but that meat really will be from calves that have 'fasted'.
tgt: Das bedeutet nicht, dass die Bäuerin im Wochenbett kein weißes Fleisch mehr bekommt, aber dann ist dieses Fleisch eben tatsächlich von "nüchternen" Kälbern.

previous_src: The countries of the Andean Community and of Central America have in the past 20 years undergone a peaceful transition from authoritarian regimes to democracy.
src: In the 1980s, the European Union played an important role in this process.
tgt: Die Europäische Union hat in den 1980er Jahren eine wichtige Rolle in diesem Prozess gespielt.

previous_src: It is to be hoped that the Council will now take more of a listening approach.
src: We all have the same deadline to meet and that is 2012.
tgt: Wir alle müssen die gleiche Frist einhalten, und das ist 2012.

previous_src: From the point of view of what has come to be called cost / benefit, it is an excellent protocol which clearly demonstrates the viability of this type of agreement for the European Union.
src: In this case, the Community fleet, industry and market are ensured a stable supply of a raw material, tuna, of which we have a considerable deficit, by means of our own fleet, which means that many Community jobs will be retained, not only in the extractive sector, but also in the activities dependent on it.
tgt: In diesem Fall garantieren die Flotte, die Industrie und der Markt der Gemeinschaft die stabile Versorgung mit einem wichtigen Rohstoff, dem Thunfisch, bei dem wir hoch defizitär sind, durch ihre eigene Flotte, wodurch eine große Zahl an Arbeitsplätzen in der Gemeinschaft, nicht nur im Fangbereich, sondern auch in den damit im Zusammenhang stehenden Tätigkeiten, aufrecht erhalten werden kann.

previous_src: Another new item is the programme to restructure the Spanish and to some extent the Portuguese fishing fleets which up to now have been able to fish in Morocco's waters.
src: The Commission welcomes the fact that the budgetary authority accepts the Commission's proposal both with regard to the level of this special programme - EUR 197 million - and also concerning the specific shape of the programme and the proposal to finance it by mobilising the flexibility instrument.
tgt: La Commission se félicite que les autorités budgétaires aient suivi la proposition de la Commission tant en ce qui concerne le montant de ce programme spécial - 197 millions d'euros - qu'en ce qui concerne l'aménagement concret du programme et le financement par la réserve de flexibilité.

previous_src: In other words, trivial, anodyne, fragmentary proposals which, at best, are ingenuous, in that they are a long way from dealing with a problem which claims the health and lives of millions of minors.
src: Nowhere did we find any reference to the causes of the problem or any proposal to deal with the huge financial interests which use all means, fair and foul, to manufacture, market and promote alcohol to children and adolescents.
tgt: An keiner Stelle finden wir einen Hinweis auf die diesem Problem zugrunde liegenden Ursachen, wir lesen nicht einen einzigen Vorschlag, der gegen die immensen wirtschaftlichen Interessen gerichtet ist, derentwegen auf jede zulässige und unzulässige Weise Alkohol für Kinder und Jugendliche produziert, ausgegeben und gefördert wird.

previous_src: Mr President, first of all I would like to say how pleased I am that after all these years Women's Day has taken on a real importance; this is an important step forward from some time ago.
src: Remember the half smiles, the scepticism, the derision with which it was greeted back then.
tgt: Rappelez -vous les sourires en coin, le scepticisme, la dérision avec lesquels elle était considérée alors.

previous_src: I think that the Council too needs to hear that message very, very clearly, because they, the Council, are the governments that are responsible for fulfilling their obligations.
src: It is true that some Member States, such as Sweden, are very good at fulfilling their obligations.
tgt: Es stimmt, einige Mitgliedstaaten wie Schweden kommen ihren Verpflichtungen sehr gut nach.

previous_src: The amendments tabled clearly demonstrate the Parliament's interest in participating in this discussion on the future VAT strategy.
src: I welcome this sign of interest and hope to have a fruitful debate with you on this important issue at a later stage.
tgt: J'apprécie cette manifestation d'intérêt et j'espère avoir un débat fructueux avec vous sur cet important sujet à un stade ultérieur.

previous_src: I can assure you, however, that any decision will take the interests of all parties into account.
src: I am sure that you will understand that the Commission and the Council, when enacting trade protection measures, constantly consider the facts and the various interests involved - for example those of producers, users, importers and consumers - and try to keep them in balance in order to make it possible for a suitable level of protection to be guaranteed to the branch of industry in question.
tgt: Sie werden verstehen, dass die Kommission und der Rat beim Erlass handelspolitischer Schutzmaßnahmen stets die Tatsachen und die verschiedenen Interessen - beispielsweise der Erzeuger, der Nutzer, der Importeure und der Verbraucher - abwägen und sich um ein ausgewogenes Verhältnis bemühen, damit ein angemessenes Schutzniveau für den entsprechenden Wirtschaftszweig der Gemeinschaft gewährleistet werden kann.

previous_src: The Committee on Regional Policy once again stresses that the liberalization of public utility services, making them competitive on the market, cannot endanger the provision of recognized basic services anywhere in the union.
src: In peripheral regions subsidized and publicly provided services are often the only alternative, as, for example, with public transport.
tgt: Die in den Randregionen geförderten und öffentlich bereitgestellten Dienste sind für diese Regionen oft die einzige Alternative zum Beispiel für die Organisierung des öffentlichen Verkehrswesens.

previous_src: In the past, there was veal when the farmer's wife was in her confinement.
src: We used to call that 'fasted veal'.
tgt: Das war "nüchtern Kalb", wie man bei uns sagte.

previous_src: Let us be very clear: the present attacks by the PKK are, of course, directed at the Turkish state, but they are also an attack on the Kurdish DTP party in the Turkish Parliament, which is seeking a political solution to the problem.
src: That is why it is so important that this Parliament does indeed strongly condemn the PKK and its terrorist attacks, while at the same time expressing support for all those on the Kurdish side and on the Turkish side who are trying to find a peaceful political solution to this problem.
tgt: Deshalb ist es so wichtig, dass dieses Parlament die PKK und ihre Terroranschläge streng verurteilt und gleichzeitig die Unterstützung all jener auf der kurdischen und auf der türkischen Seite zum Ausdruck bringt, die versuchen, eine friedliche politische Lösung für dieses Problem zu finden.

previous_src: This makes quite a hole in the budget for the specific programmes which make up the fourth, and shortly the fifth, framework programme.
src: Parliament regularly points to the high costs of administering the programmes.
tgt: Das Parlament macht regelmäßig auf die hohen Verwaltungskosten der Programme aufmerksam.

previous_src: Mrs Green is right that we should bring pressure to bear on the Council.
src: But the European Commission must also do its duty and give specific answers to the questions placed before it.
tgt: Mais la Commission européenne doit également faire son devoir et fournir des réponses concrètes aux questions qui sont posées.

previous_src: This report is timely, as we have just finalised our consultation on future priorities for the Action Plan on Company Law and Corporate Governance.
src: Our detailed report on that consultation will be available on the Internet shortly.
tgt: In Kürze werden wir einen ausführlichen Bericht zu dieser Konsultation auf unserer Website veröffentlichen.

previous_src: Firstly, the scope of the directive must certainly be clarified and even extended.
src: As we have already heard, more and more consumers are putting together dynamic travel packages or booking separate travel services.
tgt: Comme cela a été dit précédemment, de plus en plus de consommateurs se constituent un forfait personnalisé ou réservent leur voyage séparément.

previous_src: When they draw attention to infringements of Community legislation, their complaints should be handled seriously and with respect.
src: I sincerely hope that this is not an attempt on the part of the Commission to put a stop to many of these complaints, as this would be bad practice.
tgt: J'espère sincèrement que ceci n'est pas une tentative de la Commission de mettre fin à de nombreuses réclamations, car cela constituerait une mauvaise pratique.

previous_src: Competition is not, as has already been said, an end in itself.
src: It must serve the interests of consumers, companies and local conditions.
tgt: Er hat Konsumenten, Unternehmen und dem Standort zu dienen.

previous_src: However, on behalf of my colleague Mr Busuttil I would say that some of us still remain to be convinced that the pressures on certain Member States are temporary rather than systemic, and therefore that the responses we make perhaps need to be more systemic - unless, of course, we foresee a rapid change in the world situation which would then have an effect on refugee flows.
src: So again I would like to thank the Commissioner and my colleagues for their warm words.
tgt: Ich möchte daher erneut dem Kommissar und meinen Kollegen für ihre freundlichen Worte danken.

previous_src: We therefore need clear and credible rules, not least in view of the financial turbulence, and Commissioner Barnier is going to rise to this challenge.
src: Balanced, reasonable and correct rules are good for consumers.
tgt: Ausgewogene, vernünftige und korrekte Regeln sind gut für die Verbraucher.

previous_src: Mr President, first of all may I thank Mrs Jackson and congratulate her on her report.
src: I would like, President, to make a few comments.
tgt: Lassen Sie mich, Herr Präsident, einige Gedanken dazu äußern.

previous_src: It seems to me a matter of extreme importance that we in this House should, at some point, spell out to the outside world that, as soon as we discover that a Commissioner has adopted a national stance, we then step in to remove them from their post.
src: Karel van Miert, from Belgium, once stated in his memoirs that the minute you are sworn in as Commissioner, you lose your nationality.
tgt: Der aus Belgien stammende Karel van Miert hat in seinen Memoiren einmal geschrieben, mit der Vereidigung als Kommissar verliere man unmittelbar seine Nationalität.

previous_src: It should be noted that last December the Commission adopted an action plan to modernise its accounting system.
src: This plan is due to come into force in 2005.
tgt: Dieser Plan soll 2005 in Kraft treten.

previous_src: (PL) Our debate is taking place literally two days before a meeting of ministers of the 27 Member States of the European Union on the same subject.
src: Therefore, and let us say it directly, our position is potentially a form of political pressure.
tgt: Daher stellt unsere Position, um es direkt zu sagen, gewissermaßen ein politisches Druckmittel dar.

previous_src: For instance, I hope that the EU-Tunisia sub-committee on human rights and democracy will soon be up and running.
src: Tunisia has already informally stated that individual cases will be raised, notably in the framework of its political dialogue meetings with the European Union.
tgt: Tunesien hat bereits inoffiziell erklärt, dass man einzelne Fälle behandeln werde, und zwar vor allem im Rahmen des politischen Dialogs mit der Europäischen Union.

previous_src: The line taken by the honourable Member makes sense.
src: I was indeed, earlier on, taking the line that cost is one of the issues.
tgt: Ich habe in der Tat zuvor die Meinung geäußert, dass Kosten eines der Probleme sind.

previous_src: However, on 10 April Italy made a request for technical experts who could support the country in analysing the stability of buildings damaged by the earthquake.
src: A team of eight national and Commission experts was selected.
tgt: Es wurde ein Team aus acht Experten der Mitgliedstaaten und der Kommission zusammengestellt.

previous_src: I myself was rapporteur for the accession of Slovakia for years and had a great deal to do with the Roma issue.
src: I always used to say: discrimination is inadmissible, it is quite simply prohibited: so say the rules and agreements of the European Union.
tgt: J'ai toujours eu l'habitude de dire : la discrimination est inadmissible et est tout simplement interdite en vertu des règles et des accords de l'Union européenne.

previous_src: The political persecution of Mr Rosales and many others is regrettable and should be condemned in the strongest possible terms.
src: We will call on the Government of that country in earnest to start behaving sensibly and democratically and to stop violating the human rights of its citizens.
tgt: Wir werden uns bei der Regierung dieses Landes ernsthaft dafür einsetzen, dass sie sich wieder vernünftig und demokratisch verhält und die Verletzung der Menschenrechte ihrer Bürger unterlässt.

previous_src: Parliament has also secured the establishment of an enhanced structured dialogue that will involve it in the formulation of strategic priorities.
src: We should have wanted it to feature in the body of the text, but the compromise arrangement is that parliamentary involvement is to be ensured through an exchange of letters.
tgt: Nous aurions souhaité qu'il figure dans le corps du texte mais le compromis obtenu est de le codifier par un échange de lettres.

previous_src: It is a very topical question, with the third High-Level Forum on Aid Effectiveness in Accra meeting as from today and with less than a month to go before the high-level meeting on the Millennium Development Goals, to be held in New York on 25 September.
src: Another major event will be the Follow-up International Conference on Financing for Development, to be held in Doha from 29 November to 2 December, which will review the implementation of the Monterrey Consensus.
tgt: Ein weiteres wichtiges Ereignis wird die Internationale Folgekonferenz zur Entwicklungsfinanzierung sein, die vom 29. November bis 2. Dezember in Doha stattfindet, um die Umsetzung des Monterrey-Konsenses zu überprüfen.

previous_src: Mr President, the Member States of the European Union have committed themselves to implementing the Special Recommendation VII of the FATF concerning money transfers at a European level, with the aim of successfully preventing the funding of terrorist activities.
src: Therefore in order to ensure an exchange of information concerning the person making the transfer at each stage of the transfer process, we have to introduce a system which obliges the financial services suppliers to include specific and accurate information about the person making the transfer in the financial transfer documents.
tgt: Par conséquent, pour garantir que les informations concernant le donneur d ordre soient transmises à chaque étape de la chaîne de paiement, nous devons mettre en place un système qui oblige le prestataire de services de paiement à communiquer des informations spécifiques et précises sur le donneur d ordre dans les documents qui accompagnent le virement de fonds.

previous_src: Mr President, Commissioner, it will be no surprise to you when I say that I would of course have preferred it if the three fine amendments adopted - admittedly by a small majority, but adopted nonetheless - in the Committee on the Environment, Public Health and Consumer Policy had been made use of.
src: Things being as they are, and politics being the art of the possible, I would, however, like to make it plain to you that this House cannot be expected to co-decide on a European directive that demands that winemakers and brewers should indicate on the bottle label that these beverages were produced using fish and eggs.
tgt: Weil die Dinge nun einmal sind, wie sie sind, und weil Politik die Kunst des Erreichbaren ist, möchte ich Ihnen trotzdem Folgendes klar machen: Es kann nicht sein, dass dieses Parlament über eine europäische Richtlinie mitentscheidet, die von den Wein- und Bierproduzenten verlangt, auf das Etikett der Flasche zu schreiben, diese Lebensmittel seien mit Fischen und Eiern hergestellt.

previous_src: In the 19th century in English law women had no capacity to enter into contracts and were classified along with minors and lunatics.
src: It was only this century that they were granted equality in divorce law.
tgt: Erst in diesem Jahrhundert wurde ihnen im Scheidungsrecht Gleichheit gewährt.

previous_src: The Danube must be given a higher priority within the Community's policies.
src: I propose setting up at the start of the next term of the European Parliament an intergroup for promoting the Danube.
tgt: Ich schlage daher vor, zu Beginn der nächsten Legislaturperiode des Europäischen Parlaments eine interfraktionelle Arbeitsgruppe zur Förderung der Donau einzurichten.

previous_src: It is difficult to understand his approach, since he is confusing a film with a provision by a government which intends to guarantee democracy.
src: And, furthermore, you say this as a representative of a political party which is illegal in Spain, which defends terrorists and kills those of us who defend our ideas.
tgt: Überdies sagen Sie dies als Vertreter einer in Spanien verbotenen Partei, die Terroristen in Schutz nimmt und Menschen, die unsere Ideen vertreten, töten lässt.

previous_src: ESMA will have the last word in connection with the registration and oversight of credit rating agencies and be responsible for ensuring that the credit rating agencies actually comply with the new regulations.
src: If it so wishes, ESMA can delegate this cross-border responsibility to national supervisory authorities if these supervisory authorities are small and only operate nationally.
tgt: ESMA kann, wenn es möchte, diese grenzüberschreitende Verantwortung an nationale Aufsichtsbehörden übertragen, wenn es sich um kleine und nur national tätige Aufsichtsbehörden handelt.

previous_src: (DE) Mr President, ladies and gentlemen, the Commission is proposing a fundamental amendment to the directive on preventing money laundering.
src: Since the 1991 directive was adopted many external factors have changed.
tgt: Seitdem die Richtlinie 1991 verabschiedet wurde, hat sich einiges in ihrem Umfeld geändert.

previous_src: The delegation of the Dutch People's Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD) to the European Parliament has today voted against the proposal for a directive extending (paid) maternity leave to 20 weeks.
src: We are of the opinion that the previously established minimum of 14 weeks is sufficient.
tgt: Wir sind der Meinung, dass die zuvor festgelegten 14 Wochen ausreichend sind.

previous_src: What worries me is that we are slowly learning in the European Union to live with problems rather than resolve them.
src: We need to become more pro-active on the fundamental issues that concern us.
tgt: Nous devons devenir proactifs sur les questions fondamentales qui nous concernent.

previous_src: I believe that the construction sector broadly reflects the economic situation.
src: In the second quarter of 2010, the Lithuanian construction sector shrank by up to 42.9%, one of the steepest declines in Europe.
tgt: Im zweiten Quartal 2010 schrumpfte der litauische Bausektor um bis zu 42,9%, was einen der stärksten Rückgänge in Europa darstellt.

previous_src: Here is a country that has not really moved forward in terms of political rights since the break-up of the Soviet Union.
src: There are just too many examples of lack of freedom - freedom of speech and freedom of the press, which are fundamental to any properly functioning democracy - as well as evidence of the torture of prisoners, court cases where illegally acquired evidence is always admitted, and so on.
tgt: Es gibt einfach viel zu viele Beispiele für fehlende Freiheiten - die Meinungsfreiheit und die Pressefreiheit, die für jede gut funktionierende Demokratie von entscheidender Bedeutung sind - sowie Beweise für Folter von Gefangenen, Gerichtsverhandlungen, in denen illegal beschaffte Beweise immer zugelassen werden, und so weiter.

previous_src: The conflict nevertheless continues and we still have considerable concerns.
src: In particular, we want to see much greater access for humanitarian aid agencies.
tgt: Nous voulons, en particulier, que les organisations d'aide humanitaire aient plus facilement accès à la région.

previous_src: This is a very important aim but it is important that all elements of the Water Framework Directive are workable and realistic.
src: Part of this is keeping the cost to a reasonable level and to bear in mind that the targets cannot be met without necessary technical ability.
tgt: Un des moyens d'y parvenir est de maintenir le coût à un niveau raisonnable et de ne pas oublier que les objectifs ne peuvent être réalisés sans l'aptitude technique nécessaire.

previous_src: The proposals for creating an internal market for developing, manufacturing and purchasing arms, a shared communication and media system and European civil defence mechanisms are among many that I consider to be steps in the right direction.
src: Europe needs a joint approach to the security risks and threats it faces and Mr von Wogau's report outlines such an approach in a way that is both realistic and outstanding.
tgt: Europa braucht einen gemeinsamen Ansatz für die Sicherheitsrisiken und -bedrohungen, und im Bericht von Wogau wird ein solcher Ansatz dargelegt, der sowohl realistisch als auch hervorragend ist.

previous_src: The objective of the Treaty of Lisbon is to prepare the European Union for the challenges of the 21st century.
src: We have to face up to the fears of our citizens about energy issues, rising unemployment, immigration and climate change.
tgt: Wir müssen uns den Sorgen unserer Bürger im Hinblick auf die Themen Energie, wachsende Arbeitslosigkeit, Einwanderung und Klimawandel stellen.

previous_src: It forgets the innocent victims in Baghdad, the inexorable siege of Basra and the rivers of blood, and talks instead about who will rule Iraq after the war, the USA or the UN.
src: In fact this is a step backwards, to the nineteenth and the beginning of the twentieth century, when France, Britain and Spain quarrelled and haggled over who would control Morocco, Libya and Egypt.
tgt: In Wirklichkeit ist dies ein Rückschritt, ein Rückschritt ins 19. und frühe 20. Jahrhundert, als Frankreich, Großbritannien und Spanien um die Kontrolle über Marokko, Libyen und Ägypten feilschten und sich stritten.

previous_src: The Tobin tax would not have been able to prevent the crises in the EEA in 1992 and 1993 or the crises in the south-east Asian currencies in 1997.
src: The initiators of this question do not propose a solution; instead they are calling for a new burden, they are calling for more bureaucracy, for a measure which runs counter to the market mechanisms and they are taking up plenary 's time with an intergroup opinion which excludes the competent parliamentary committee, contrary to several resolutions by Parliament.
tgt: Die Initiatoren dieser Anfrage schlagen keine Lösung vor, sondern sie rufen nach einer neuen Belastung, rufen nach mehr Bürokratie, nach einer Maßnahme wider die Marktmechanismen und befassen das Plenum mit einer intergroup-Auffassung unter Ausschaltung des zuständigen parlamentarischen Ausschusses im Widerspruch zu mehreren Beschlüssen des Parlaments.

previous_src: I hear Bertelsmann, a firm which benefits from book price fixing in Germany, saying that it wants to be number one in the world in selling books on the Internet.
src: I have no objection to that.
tgt: Je n'y vois aucune objection.

previous_src: If the EU really wants to make a difference, it should fund the building of nuclear power stations across the continent, to reduce our dependence on unstable regimes and overlong delivery lines.
src: Then, and only then, would we have the money available to help the poorer regions around the Black Sea.
tgt: Dann, und nur dann, hätten wir die finanziellen Mittel, um den ärmeren Regionen am Schwarzen Meer zu helfen.

previous_src: We do not need to be timid and reluctant when it comes to intervening in matters that are going on in the Member States.
src: I am therefore very happy to hear that the Council will speed up the work on the framework decision and the Agency on Fundamental Rights.
tgt: Daher freue ich mich ganz besonders über die Nachricht, dass der Rat die Arbeiten am Rahmenbeschluss und an der Agentur für Grundrechte beschleunigen wird.

previous_src: At any event, in this debate, our position, the socialist position, is very clear: we hold exactly the same position as the European Union.
src: In other words, we defend human rights and we also defend dialogue, meeting and agreement.
tgt: Das heißt, wir verteidigen die Menschenrechte und setzen uns für Dialog, Treffen und Vereinbarungen ein.

previous_src: The question may therefore justifiably be asked whether the hypothetically harmful tax competition which would be countered, and which nevertheless also has advantages, would ultimately not be a lesser evil than the federal uniformity which threatens to replace it.
src: May I remind you that large companies and capital are easily moved outside the European Union for tax purposes, an option not available to the average citizen.
tgt: Denn ich erinnere daran, daß die Großunternehmen und das große Kapital die Europäische Union vollkommen problemlos verlassen können, um in den Genuß von Steuervorteilen zu kommen, was der einfache Bürger natürlich nicht kann.

previous_src: The Commission also shares the opinion of the European Parliament that, for the data protection supervision of the IT application, the solution aiming to replace the Joint Supervisory Authority (JSA) with the European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS) is the most appropriate.
src: Combined supervision by JSA and EDPS would present some risks of possible duplication and overlapping of work.
tgt: Eine gemeinsame Kontrolle durch die GKI und den Europäischen Datenschutzbeauftragten würde das Risiko potenzieller Verdoppelung und Überschneidung der Arbeitsschritte beinhalten.

previous_src: There is certainly more of it than people in the various Member States want.
src: You are surely well aware of this too, ladies and gentlemen.
tgt: Ihnen, sehr verehrte Damen und Herren, ist das mit Sicherheit auch bewusst.

previous_src: Finally, the Commission is calling on the European Parliament to do what it does so well and play a still greater role in this new strategy.
src: During a crisis, we wish to send out clear messages to the Member States.
tgt: En période de crise, nous voulons envoyer des messages clairs aux États membres.

previous_src: Following a public consultation last year, the Commission is evaluating the comments about collective redress and intends to find a solution that meets European consumers' needs without importing US practices.
src: Alternative dispute resolution is going to be our key mover in this regard.
tgt: Alternative Streitbeilegungsverfahren werden in dieser Hinsicht unsere Hauptantriebskraft sein.

previous_src: I mean power that translates as legitimacy arising directly from the votes of European women and men.
src: I also mean power in the formal sense: codecision, budgetary power and democratic control over the European institutions.
tgt: Je parle aussi de pouvoir formel - codécision, pouvoir budgétaire, contrôle démocratique sur les institutions européennes.

previous_src: However, the decisive factor is not what we put on paper in Parliament's committees, in the Commission and in the Council, but what actually happens on the ground.
src: Belgium and Greece have recently been condemned by the European Court of Human Rights for not implementing and not adhering to existing legislation.
tgt: La Belgique et la Grèce ont été récemment condamnées par la Cour européenne des droits de l'homme pour ne pas respecter et ne pas mettre en œuvre les législations en vigueur.

previous_src: That makes nearly 1 700 questions from eight members.
src: We can observe that they are very hardworking, but it looks very much as if the EU system is being wantonly abused here, as in many other cases, by opponents of the EU.
tgt: Nun kann man sagen, dass sie sehr fleißig sind, aber es riecht doch danach, dass hier das EU-System wie in vielen anderen Fällen auch ganz sträflich von den Gegnern der EU missbraucht wird.

previous_src: We must prevent a ring of instability from being formed around the enlarged European Union; we should, instead, create a circle of friends.
src: We do not want any new division.
tgt: Dies ist eine ernste Frage, genauso wie die Frage, wo Europa aufhört.

previous_src: Food riots and sudden changes in the price of foodstuffs are constant indicators of the limits of agricultural market liberalisation.
src: Such liberalisation has always been to the detriment of fragile populations, fragile producers and fragile areas.
tgt: Cette libéralisation s'est toujours faite au détriment des populations fragiles, au détriment des producteurs fragiles et des territoires fragiles.

previous_src: I think it is most important to look at transport not just for the states immediately bordering on the Mediterranean but for the region as a whole, including the various Balkan states.
src: These countries must be included, and they must be included in a report of this kind.
tgt: Il faut impliquer ces pays comme il convient et les intégrer dans un rapport comme celui -ci.

previous_src: I will endeavour, with all my strength, to serve the citizens of the European Union, democracy and parliamentary government.
src: I wish to play my part in building a democratic European Union that is strong and effective at home and throughout the world.
tgt: Ich möchte meinen Beitrag für eine demokratische, starke und handlungsfähige Europäische Union in Europa und in der Welt leisten.

previous_src: I see announced in the paper today that a certain food processing company is now asking for protection against imports of sweetcorn from Thailand.
src: Is the Council - not the Commission - concerned at the growing tide of protectionism coming up from fellow Member States and is the Council under your Presidency going to provide any leadership to combat this?
tgt: Macht sich der Rat - nicht die Kommission - Sorgen über den zunehmenden Trend des Protektionismus aus anderen Mitgliedstaaten und wird der Rat unter Ihrer Präsidentschaft seinen Einfluss geltend machen, um dagegen vorzugehen?

previous_src: In addition we should work toward stabilising the situation in Afghanistan by strengthening local institutions and satisfying the basic living requirements of the population.
src: An important step on the path to the democratic reconstruction of the country is to achieve media independence and freedom.
tgt: Ein wichtiger Schritt auf dem Weg zu einem demokratischen Wiederaufbau des Landes ist es, die Unabhängigkeit und die Freiheit der Medien zu erreichen.

previous_src: The Commission has been actively developing policies to confront main security threats and to promote effective multilateralism.
src: Commission work has focused on, amongst other issues, the Neighbourhood Policy, the effectiveness of development assistance, humanitarian aid and civil protection.
tgt: Neben anderen Bereichen hat sich die Kommission bei ihrer Arbeit auf die Nachbarschaftspolitik, die Wirksamkeit der Entwicklungs-, der humanitären Hilfe und des Katastrophenschutzes konzentriert.

previous_src: I am confident that the process of ratification will be continued and will end with success in the two remaining Member States.
src: I have received an assurance from the President of Poland, that now, when the Irish referendum has returned a positive result, he will sign the Treaty of Lisbon without delay.
tgt: Ich habe von dem Präsidenten Polens eine Zusicherung erhalten, dass er nun, da das irische Referendum zu einem positiven Ergebnis geführt hat, den Vertrag von Lissabon ohne Verzögerung unterzeichnen wird.

previous_src: In the current context of the conflict between Russia and Georgia we will also try to develop the partnership with Ukraine and, as you know, yesterday we noted the need to strengthen relations with Georgia.
src: That is my update on ongoing relations.
tgt: Cela, c'est pour le point des négociations en cours.

previous_src: On the subject of this air traffic crisis, the events taking place are, all the same, odd.
src: I have seen today in the press - and not only in the Eurosceptic or Europhobe press, not only in the tabloids, but also in the quality press - that the European Union now admits that it was mistaken in deciding to suspend flights.
tgt: Ich habe heute in der Presse - und nicht nur in der euroskeptischen oder europhoben Presse, nicht nur in den Boulevardblättern, sondern auch in der Qualitätspresse - gesehen, dass die Europäische Union nun zugebe, sich in ihrer Entscheidung, Flüge zu streichen, geirrt zu haben.

previous_src: They wanted to build that new Europe through solidarity.
src: They chose the economy as the driving force behind their political vision and their objectives.
tgt: Ils ont choisi l'économie comme moteur de leur vision politique et de leurs objectifs.

previous_src: I congratulate the rapporteur, Mr Coelho, for the preparation of this report and also agree that it is important to ensure the free movement within the Schengen area of third-country nationals in possession of a long-stay visa who are lawfully present in a Member State as soon as possible.
src: According to the current practice of Member States, for various reasons, it takes rather a long time for third-country nationals to replace a long-stay visa with a residence permit.
tgt: Suivant la pratique courante des États membres, et ce pour diverses raisons, la procédure visant à remplacer un titre de long séjour par un permis de séjour est plutôt longue pour les ressortissants des pays tiers.

previous_src: As we have said, it does not solve all the political problems, but there are two major advances.
src: One is that now we recognise how the political institutions operate, an element of thought comes into our discussion.
tgt: Einer ist, dass wir jetzt erkennen, wie die politischen Einrichtungen funktionieren und uns daher bei der Diskussion mehr Gedanken machen.

previous_src: Let me make one point: the Council is so impertinent as to choose now, of all times, to call upon us urgently to extend this programme to Cyprus.
src: We are expected to whisk Cyprus on board in September.
tgt: Wir sollen im September noch ganz schnell Zypern mit reinnehmen.

previous_src: Around 20% of Belarusians watch EuroNews and 40% have access to the Internet.
src: These are opportunities we need to exploit.
tgt: Das sind Möglichkeiten, die wir nutzen sollten.

previous_src: It is also a worrying sign of inadequate planning that the disparity between commitment and payment appropriations is growing in the case of a large number of items.
src: Since we cannot incur a deficit, we push more and more commitments to the future.
tgt: Da wir kein Defizit auf uns nehmen können, verschieben wir immer mehr Verpflichtungen in die Zukunft.

previous_src: I therefore welcome the Commission's proposals to require high-seas fishing activities with bottom gears to be subject to a permit, and that the responsible authority will determine that there are no significant adverse impacts on ecosystems in the high seas before issuing the permits.
src: Action is long overdue in this area and I would like to thank Duarte Freitas for his report.
tgt: In diesem Bereich hätte man schon lange tätig werden müssen und ich danke Duarte Freitas für seinen Bericht.

previous_src: This may perhaps make sense in their eyes, but as members of the European Parliament, we have to serve the interests of Europeans.
src: This certainly does not include permanently supporting millions of economic migrants who, with a lack of training and qualifications suitable for our labour market, are simply not much use to us.
tgt: Diese liegen sicherlich nicht darin, Millionen Wirtschaftsflüchtlinge, die mangels Ausbildung und Qualifikation für unseren Arbeitsmarkt schlicht und einfach unbrauchbar sind, auf Dauer zu alimentieren.

previous_src: However, it is of the utmost importance that the candidate countries de facto meet the requirements laid down and are thereby fully democratic states governed by the rule of law on accession.
src: The Copenhagen criteria must be met, the legislation that we agree on must not only be introduced but also upheld in practice and legal certainty must be guaranteed.
tgt: Les critères de Copenhague doivent être respectés, la législation à propos de laquelle nous sommes d'accord doit non seulement être introduite, mais elle doit également être soutenue dans la pratique et la sécurité juridique doit être garantie.

previous_src: Martin Luther King once said "I have a dream ”.
src: I too have a dream; and that dream is that one day this Parliament has a single seat from which to operate and the Strasbourg circus will come to an end.
tgt: Ich habe auch einen Traum und der handelt davon, dass das Parlament eines Tages einen einzigen Sitz hat und dass der Straßburg-Zirkus ein Ende hat.

previous_src: I am therefore very pleased that this debate is taking place.
src: It is important for all of us that the demand for timber is satisfied in future, too.
tgt: Es ist für uns alle wichtig, dass der Bedarf an Holz auch in Zukunft sichergestellt ist.

previous_src: An example of this could be the toxic pollution in Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast).
src: I believe the issue of such registration should be discussed separately in Parliament.
tgt: Je pense que la question de ces enregistrements devrait être débattue séparément par le Parlement.

previous_src: I am pleased to see that in the Agriculture Council, you are making progress with the issue of improving the functioning of the food supply chain.
src: Food security cannot - and will not - be guaranteed unless our farmers can earn a fair and reasonably stable income.
tgt: Nahrungsmittelsicherheit kann nicht - und wird nicht - garantiert werden, sofern unsere Landwirte kein faires und einigermaßen stabiles Einkommen erzielen.

previous_src: I would like very warmly to thank Commissioner de Palacio for committing the Commission to becoming active in this area and to producing standards.
src: I think Parliament has already called for that in the Schwaiger Report on the accession of new states, which called for a code of nuclear safety even before the new Member States join.
tgt: Ich glaube, das hat auch das Europäische Parlament schon gefordert, und zwar im Bericht Schwaiger zum Beitritt, in dem ein Kodex für die nukleare Sicherheit gefordert wurde, und zwar noch vor dem Beitritt der neuen Mitgliedstaaten.

previous_src: Chancellor Gordon Brown was asked how much funding was to be allocated to the military action and his answer was' as much as it takes'.
src: I am afraid the financial allocation to the humanitarian support measures is shameful.
tgt: Ich befürchte, die Finanzmittel für humanitäre Hilfsmaßnahmen sind eine Schande.

previous_src: The Western Balkans, as a region, is a key and valuable partner for the EU.
src: The last Commission communication on the Western Balkans in March 2008 reiterates the EU's strong commitment to the European perspective of the region and confirms, among other things, the importance of the Central European Free Trade Agreement for the economic development of the region.
tgt: Die letzte Mitteilung der Kommission zu den westlichen Balkanstaaten im März 2008 wiederholt das ausdrückliche Engagement der EU in Hinblick auf die europäische Perspektive der Region und bestätigt unter anderem die Bedeutung des Mitteleuropäischen Freihandelsabkommens für die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung der Region.

previous_src: Clearly, global competition, as encouraged by the WTO, is the main reason for the widespread impoverishment and lack of dynamism of Europe.
src: The European Union urgently needs to put an end to this madness, and finally to set up Community protection and preference.
tgt: Es ist höchste Zeit, dass die Europäische Union diesem Wahnsinn ein Ende bereitet und endlich den Schutz der Gemeinschaft und die Gemeinschaftspräferenz einrichtet.

previous_src: in writing. - In April 2009, an earthquake occurred in Italy that caused a great deal of damage.
src: It is for this reason that the Commission proposed the mobilisation of the ESF in favour of Italy.
tgt: Daher hat die Kommission die Inanspruchnahme des ESF zugunsten Italiens vorgeschlagen.

previous_src: This attack was not, of course, against the Taliban; it was against 500 civilians.
src: The daily bloodbath, the organisation of violent and corrupt elections to put puppets of the Afghan occupation in place and the poverty and misery which are the scourge of the Afghan people reveal that the imperialist attacks by the United States of America, the European Union and ΝΑΤΟ in this occupied country - and in a series of other countries - on the pretext of combating terrorism have disastrous consequences for the people.
tgt: Le bain de sang quotidien, l'organisation d'élections violentes et corrompues en vue de placer au pouvoir des marionnettes de l'occupation afghane et le fléau de la pauvreté et de la misère qui s'abat sur le peuple afghan témoignent du fait que les attaques impérialistes des États-Unis d'Amérique, de l'Union européenne et de l'OTAN dans ce pays occupé - et dans une série d'autres pays -, sous prétexte de combattre le terrorisme, entraînent des conséquences désastreuses pour la population.

previous_src: It therefore seems important to me that Member States should be able, if necessary and in a proportionate and transparent fashion, to require the use of mandatory routes.
src: They must also be able to insist that carriers use one mode of transport rather than another if they believe that that will be safer for their citizens.
tgt: Sie müssen auch das Transportunternehmen verpflichten können, eine bestimmte Verkehrsart anstelle einer anderen zu verwenden, wenn sie der Auffassung sind, dass die Sicherheit ihrer Bürger auf diese Weise besser gewährleistet ist.

previous_src: on behalf of the GUE / NGL Group. - (DE) Mr President, the Greens appear to be learning.
src: The chairman of the security and defence sub-committee has produced a report on military policy in the EU.
tgt: Der Vorsitzende des Unterausschusses Sicherheit und Verteidigung hat einen Bericht zur EU-Militärpolitik vorgelegt.

previous_src: Elimination of discrimination requires a joint European effort.
src: Programmes such as the European Social Fund and Progress in partnership with local governments and authorities should allocate larger funds to support women in the rural environment.
tgt: In Partnerschaft mit örtlichen Gebietskörperschaften und Behörden umzusetzende Programme wie etwa der Europäische Sozialfonds und "Progress" sollten mehr Mittel zur Unterstützung von Frauen in ländlichen Gebieten bereitstellen.

previous_src: Your question, distinguished Member of Parliament, comes from an assumption that is not correct, namely that it is because Greece is in the euro area that it is having some problems.
src: In fact, we have countries outside the euro area that have similar problems - in some cases, even more serious ones - both in the European Union and outside the European Union.
tgt: En fait, il y a des pays situés hors de la zone euro qui ont des problèmes similaires - et dans certains cas, des problèmes plus graves - à la fois dans l'Union européenne et à l'extérieur de l'Union européenne.

previous_src: Indirectly, the fact of having uniform procedures would also share out the burden to a certain degree, as it would avoid people heading in larger numbers for countries where procedures are lax or based on incorrect information.
src: This should not be the case.
tgt: Das sollte nicht der Fall sein.

previous_src: This protocol does not allow the EU to become a party to it.
src: It thus falls to Member States to ratify this protocol so that it becomes applicable.
tgt: Daher obliegt es den Mitgliedstaaten, dieses Protokoll zu ratifizieren, damit es anwendbar wird.

previous_src: In Parliament, we frequently discuss the issues of public services and public transport.
src: In a series of reports, the latter has been confirmed as being part of the network for our citizens.
tgt: In einer Reihe von Berichten wurde dies als Teil der den Bürgern zur Verfügung stehenden Netze festgeschrieben.

previous_src: In the regional funds, together with the Cohesion Funds, we have an immense instrument in our hands in the European Union that we are not making use of.
src: In this field of energy efficiency, we could finally create European added value which we could put to use in an innovative way to get to grips with energy efficiency in a way that has not happened in the past.
tgt: Hier im Bereich der Energieeffizienz könnten wir endlich einmal einen europäischen Mehrwert schaffen, den wir innovativ einsetzen, für Energieeffizienz einsetzen, was wir in der Vergangenheit nicht getan haben.

previous_src: With regard to fisheries and given the much-discussed failure of the Fisheries Agreement with Morocco and the consequent need to restructure our fleets, we must make a careful assessment of how this will be funded.
src: In internal policies (category 3), the current margin is limited and the broad economic guidelines lay down clear priorities in this area, which must be respected.
tgt: Bei den internen Politiken (Kategorie 3) ist die vorhandene Marge eingeschränkt, und in den Leitlinien gibt es hierzu klare Prioritäten, die wir einhalten wollen.

previous_src: in writing. - I welcome the report on transparency in financial matters.
src: Any move to improve the quality and availability of information, especially on agricultural policy and Structural Funds (which has proved difficult for the public to obtain), is a positive step towards the EU assuming its democratic obligations.
tgt: Alles, was die Qualität und Verfügbarkeit von Informationen verbessert, und zwar insbesondere über die Agrarpolitik und die Strukturfonds (die für die Öffentlichkeit in der Vergangenheit nur schwer zugänglich waren), trägt dazu bei, dass die EU ihren demokratischen Pflichten besser nachkommt.

previous_src: This is important for two reasons.
src: Firstly, because of competition within the Union in the internal market; in other words, it must not be possible for one country to derive a competitive advantage as a result of the neglect of animals.
tgt: Premièrement, à cause de la concurrence qui règne sur le marché intérieur européen : aucun pays ne doit pouvoir obtenir d'avantage concurrentiel pour avoir négligé des animaux.

previous_src: As regards the equivalence decision, it is right to postpone it.
src: It is the most efficient way to promote the use of IFRS.
tgt: Dies ist der wirksamste Weg, um den Einsatz der IFRS zu fördern.

previous_src: On the basis of a preliminary filtering, the Commission has selected 13 substances it regards as giving cause for concern.
src: The compromise clearly stipulates that on the basis of scientific data the Commission will have 24 months to pronounce on the final classification and to propose the relevant limit values.
tgt: Le compromis stipule clairement que sur base de données scientifiques, la Commission aura 24 mois pour se prononcer sur la classification finale et proposer des valeurs limites pertinentes.

previous_src: I agree with much of what has been said today: firstly legislative measures and secondly implementation measures.
src: In addition, I can reiterate that the Commission already has programmes in place and is working on these matters.
tgt: Und ich kann Ihnen aus der Sicht der Kommission nochmals sagen, dass wir mit unseren Programmen bereits an diesen Dingen arbeiten.

previous_src: The message is that we do of course need a transatlantic partnership and that we are allies in the fight against terrorism.
src: Not only the refrain, but even the verse was the same across the board, namely that credibility, confidence and transparency are necessary where these issues are concerned.
tgt: Aber sogar die Melodie war die gleiche, dass nämlich in diesen Fragen Glaubwürdigkeit, Vertrauen und Transparenz notwendig sind.

previous_src: (LT) Government institutions must immediately resolve conflicts and misunderstandings regarding Polish minority organisations in Belarus and do this democratically, without the use of force or violence.
src: I would also like to support the Commissioner's view that we must continue cooperation and maintain people-to-people contacts.
tgt: Je partage également l'opinion de la commissaire qu'il faut poursuivre la coopération et maintenir des contacts entre les peuples.

previous_src: At present, the vast majority of defence equipment tenders are conducted outside Community rules.
src: Member States rely upon the derogation from the Treaty under Article 296.
tgt: Les États membres se prévalent de la dérogation au Traité visée à l'article 296.

previous_src: We now need to relinquish our old, ingrained opinions and look to the pan-European approach and what is best for everyone when it comes to asylum and migration.
src: Otherwise, the word 'solidarity' will soon become meaningless.
tgt: Dans le cas contraire, le mot "solidarité" n'aura bientôt plus de sens.

previous_src: Others are not.
src: This means that the actions that the Commission can take to support them in that - for example, the use of the UNHCR, and the idea of the Asylum Support Office - become very important, providing they are adequately resourced.
tgt: Cela signifie que les actions que peut prendre la Commission pour les soutenir - par exemple, l'utilisation du HCR, et l'idée d'un Bureau d'appui en matière d'asile - deviennent très importantes si elles disposent des ressources adéquates.

previous_src: It is the duty of the Council, the Commission and the European Parliament to support the efforts deployed at an international level, not only by the United States but also by our special envoy, and to seize this last chance.
src: Success is possible, if a security committee is first of all created.
tgt: Der Erfolg ist möglich, vorausgesetzt, daß zunächst der Sicherheitsausschuß geschaffen wird.

previous_src: That does not, however, in any way imply that there is no need for a fundamental revision of the common agricultural policy.
src: On the contrary!
tgt: Au contraire !

previous_src: I believe that we should aim to improve the situation in Eritrea itself and in other countries in the Horn of Africa, since improving the situation in African countries may reduce migratory pressure.
src: We will not solve the problem by combating the social ills which are themselves caused by migration.
tgt: Wir werden das Problem nicht lösen, indem wir soziale Missstände bekämpfen, die selbst durch Migration verursacht werden.

previous_src: One of them in my constituency will be faced with going out of business because there is no way he will be able to sell his components to the oil and gas industry in the United States.
src: They are not going to pull their drill up thousands of feet just to check a measurement - no way!
tgt: Ils ne remonteront pas leurs foreuses de milliers de pieds simplement pour contrôler une mesure - à aucun prix !

previous_src: Mr President, the Special Court for Sierra Leone has sentenced Issa Hassan Sesay, the Commanding Officer of the Revolutionary United Front, to 52 years' imprisonment.
src: It has also sentenced Morris Kallon, one of the commanders of the RUF, to 40 years' imprisonment, and Augustine Gbao, responsible for security in the RUF, to 25 years' imprisonment.
tgt: Es hat auch Morris Kallon, einen der Befehlshaber der RUF, zu 40 Jahren und Augustine Gbao, den Verantwortlichen für die Sicherheit der RUF, zu 25 Jahren Freiheitsstrafe verurteilt.

previous_src: Therefore, we must take action internationally to resolve the problem.
src: Of course the UN and Interpol should receive increased resources to be able to take action.
tgt: Es ist deshalb selbstverständlich, daß die UN und Interpol bessere Ressourcen bekommen, um handeln zu können.

previous_src: Thoughts of the past must be united with those for the future.
src: Had we not joined forces 50 years ago, we would probably not be living in peace and prosperity today.
tgt: Si nous ne nous étions pas unis voici 50 ans, nous ne vivrions probablement pas dans la paix et la prospérité aujourd'hui.

previous_src: This report is a vital contribution to the joint work by Parliament, the Council and the Commission to put in place the future European Consensus on Humanitarian Aid.
src: Our common objective is to formalise in a joint declaration by the three institutions our vision and our common approach to humanitarian aid policy.
tgt: Unser gemeinsames Ziel ist es, unsere Sichtweise und unser gemeinsames Herangehen an die Politik der humanitären Hilfe in einer gemeinsamen Erklärung der drei Institutionen festzuhalten.

previous_src: (PL) Mr President, the position of Parliament on the global division of obligations concerning CO2 reduction unfortunately lacks balance regarding the way the costs of this reduction are to be borne.
src: By adopting the resolution, we are undermining the climate package, which was so hard to negotiate, and the costs of which currently fall unequally on the Member States of Central Europe.
tgt: Durch die Annahme der Entschließung untergraben wir das Klimapaket, das so schwierig ausgehandelt wurde und dessen Kosten zurzeit die Mitgliedstaaten Mitteleuropas in unausgewogenem Ausmaß treffen.

previous_src: In 2002, following the conclusions of a study carried out jointly by Indonesian and European experts, the Commission mobilised funds from its Rapid Reaction Mechanism to support the implementation of this law by the Indonesian authorities, making available to them an expert on decentralisation issues and Indonesia.
src: I strongly support the fact that this initiative was based on the European Union's strict respect for the territorial integrity of Indonesia and that it had received the full support and collaboration of the Indonesian authorities.
tgt: Et je soutiens avec force que cette initiative se situait dans le strict respect, par l'Union européenne, de l'intégrité territoriale de l'Indonésie et qu'elle avait reçu le plein accord et la collaboration des autorités indonésiennes.

previous_src: Mr President, Commissioner, ladies and gentlemen, I should like to take this opportunity to extol the virtues of fish as a healthy food.

tgt: Eu égard aux multiples scandales alimentaires récents, il n'est certainement pas inutile de mettre en exergue les avantages d'une nourriture saine.

tgt: Vor allem bei einem so wichtigen Thema wie dem heute von uns diskutierten könnte eine fehlerhafte Umsetzung nachteilige Auswirkungen haben.

tgt: Vor nicht allzu langer Zeit erstreckte sich ein Eiserner Vorhang entlang der tschechisch-österreichischen und tschechisch-deutschen Grenze, der das frühere Ostdeutschland und die frühere Tschechoslowakei, die von totalitären kommunistischen Regimes beherrscht wurden, von der demokratischen Welt abschnitt.

tgt: In einer gemeinsamen Union mit gemeinsamen Werten und einer gemeinsamen Anwendung internationaler Normen und Konventionen, darf es nicht solche Unterschiede geben, wie es sie heute gibt.

tgt: Die Bürger Estlands haben ihre Ablehnung dieser Entscheidung in legitimer Weise zum Ausdruck gebracht, und ihre Aktionen wurden brutal unterdrückt.

tgt: On espère que ces autorités, à cette occasion, prendront très au sérieux ce que le Parlement européen leur dit.
