previous_src: The Council has also rightly decided to double the assistance package for financially distressed non-eurozone countries in eastern Europe, from EUR 25 billion to EUR 50 billion.
src: This measure will help stabilise countries like Hungary and Latvia.
tgt: Diese Maßnahme wird helfen, Länder wie Ungarn und Lettland zu stabilisieren.

previous_src: Firstly, we need to give our farmers the tools they need to do their job and this proposal will limit their ability greatly, especially for those farmers who work in damper and wetter climates and need to use pesticides to protect crops and their livelihood.
src: I am not aware of any farmer who wants to use pesticides, but they are an essential part of ensuring food for our population at an affordable price.
tgt: Ich kenne keinen einzigen Landwirt, der gerne Pestizide verwendet, aber sie sind nun einmal ein wesentliches Hilfsmittel, um für unsere Bevölkerung Nahrungsmittel zu einem erschwinglichen Preis anbieten zu können.

previous_src: It also prohibits aerial spraying (permitted in cases of absolute necessity and where there are no alternatives).
src: Another positive aspect is the possibility for each Member State to define protection areas and risk areas.
tgt: Un autre aspect positif est la possibilité pour chaque État membre de déterminer des zones protégées et des zones à risque.

previous_src: One important aim of the Commission's proposal for the participation rules was to simplify participation.
src: In this connection, Parliament's dynamic role has made it a lot easier for all researchers to participate fully in the Framework Programme.
tgt: Dabei hat die dynamische Rolle des Parlaments es für alle Forscher um ein Vielfaches leichter gemacht, sich umfassend an dem Rahmenprogramm beteiligen zu können.

previous_src: The Iraqi people are suffering a twin punishment: the punishment it suffers under Saddam Hussein, and the additional punishment of an unjust war.
src: In the face of this extremely serious situation, we once again call on the governments of the Member States of our Union and of its future members not to participate in a unilateral pre-emptive war which is morally and legally dubious and which is contrary to the wishes of the majority of Europeans.
tgt: Étant donné cette situation gravissime, nous demandons à nouveau aux gouvernements des États membres de notre Union et de ses futurs membres de ne pas participer à une guerre préventive unilatérale, moralement et légalement douteuse et contraire à l'opinion de la majorité des Européens.

previous_src: In this regard, Mr Elchlepp, I should like to add one point to your excellent report.
src: The people in these countries do not yet know enough about renewable energies.
tgt: Die Menschen dort wissen noch nicht genug über die erneuerbaren Energien.

previous_src: Including the true cost of transport also means giving the various modes of transport an equal chance, giving them optimum conditions for competition within the Union.
src: And this evolution must be taken into consideration in particular with regard to the liberalisation and the opening up of transport markets.
tgt: Und diese Entwicklung muß berücksichtigt werden, insbesondere mit Blick auf die Liberalisierung und die Öffnung der Transportmärkte.

previous_src: It has a highly negative impact on human beings, particularly on civilians.
src: The question is, therefore, very dear to me because things that affect human security are always very close to my heart.
tgt: Deshalb schätze ich diese Frage sehr, denn alles, was die Sicherheit der Menschen betrifft, liegt mir immer sehr am Herzen.

previous_src: I will not conceal the fact that I consider the opening of accession negotiations with Turkey to be in itself a fundamental mistake.
src: At the same time I am aware of and I respect the fact that not everyone in this House shares this view.
tgt: Gleichzeitig bin ich mir der Tatsache bewusst und respektiere sie, dass nicht jeder in diesem Hause diese Auffassung teilt.

previous_src: (NL) Mr President, Commissioner, yesterday this Chamber was full of mayors who signed up to the Covenant of Mayors in order to make a real commitment to a low-CO2 economy.
src: What I was struck by, throughout the debate, was that they are prepared to take concrete action for the benefit of our citizens and to follow through on that commitment.
tgt: Während der gesamten Debatte beeindruckte mich, dass sie wirklich bereit sind, konkrete Maßnahmen zum Nutzen unserer Bürgerinnen und Bürger zu ergreifen und dieses Engagement fortzuführen.

previous_src: We understand that the country has internal threats to its security and that there has to be a response to these, but democracy is not a threat to security.
src: Democracy is also precisely the answer in the struggle against talebanisation.
tgt: Demokratie ist zudem genau die richtige Antwort im Kampf gegen die Talibanisierung.

previous_src: We must let it be known that, as Europeans, as European politicians, we are equally concerned about refugees.
src: The refugee problem is probably one of the greatest embarrassments for those who started this war and for those who are pursuing it, even if they are acting with the best of intentions.
tgt: Das Flüchtlingsproblem dürfte denjenigen, die diesen Krieg begonnen haben, und diejenigen, die ihn fortsetzen, auch wenn sie in bester Absicht handeln, große Kopfschmerzen bereiten.

previous_src: These things have nothing to do with one another.
src: Anyone who comes up with this sort of argument merely demonstrates the fact that he has no interest in meaningful and effective regulation.
tgt: Wer so argumentiert, bringt doch damit nur zum Ausdruck, dass er kein Interesse an einer sinnvollen und wirksamen Regulierung hat.

previous_src: In relation to ongoing legal action, I cannot understand who the Commission is trying to protect.
src: If the Commission is taking legal action against Member States it would seem that the interests or the protection of Member States are given priority by the Commission and that we basically end up with a situation where citizens throughout the European Union are going to be accusing the Commission of being extremely secretive and protecting the interests of the Member States.
tgt: Si la Commission entame des poursuites à l encontre d États membres, il semblerait que la Commission donne priorité aux intérêts ou à la protection des États membres et que nous nous retrouverions finalement face à une situation où les citoyens de l ensemble de l Union européenne accuseront la Commission d être très secrète et de protéger les intérêts des États membres.

previous_src: In Ireland we add hydrofluorosylic acid to our drinking water as a so-called medicinal product in order to prevent dental decay.
src: It is illegal to force-medicate populations with this dangerous toxic waste substance, which has caused an increase in bone disorders.
tgt: Es ist jedoch rechtswidrig, eine Zwangsmedikation mit diesem gefährlichen und giftigen Abfallstoff durchzuführen, der für die Zunahme von Knochenkrankheiten verantwortlich ist.

previous_src: (PL) Madam President, I would like to agree with the evaluation of the situation presented by Mrs Ashton.
src: You are right, Mrs Ashton, that if we want to change the situation in Yemen, we need both humanitarian and, perhaps, military action.
tgt: Sie haben Recht damit, Frau Ashton, dass, wenn wir die Situation im Jemen verändern wollen, wir sowohl humanitäre als gegebenenfalls auch militärische Maßnahmen brauchen.

previous_src: Events which happened as a consequence of the volcanic eruption in Iceland are also going to have a very strong global dimension.
src: We do not usually think about the huge significance of air transport.
tgt: On ne s'interroge habituellement pas sur l 'importance considérable du transport aérien.

previous_src: There is no culture without agriculture!
src: If there is some other culture in America, then let them live with it, we do not want it!
tgt: Et si la culture américaine est différente, nous lui souhaitons bon vent, mais nous ne l'apprécions pas !

previous_src: Mr President, I rejected Paragraph 8 because for I believe that the quality of education has absolute priority.
src: Life-long education and continuing education are the basis for successful practice of a profession.
tgt: Des mesures de formation et de formation continue représentent la base d'une carrière professionnelle réussie.

previous_src: The problem is not one that can be resolved by the use of force - arrests, court rulings, incarcerations.
src: What is needed is a reconciliation between the warring factions.
tgt: Vonnöten ist vielmehr eine Annährung der beiden Konfliktparteien.

previous_src: (CS) Madam President, Mrs Figueiredo, honourable Members, I should first like to thank Parliament and the Council for their efforts in reaching agreement so quickly on this proposal.
src: I also welcome the Figueiredo report, which kick-started the constructive dialogue chaired by the Council, where the foundations were laid for the adoption of the proposed directive at first reading.
tgt: Außerdem begrüße ich den Bericht Figueiredo, der den Startschuss für den konstruktiven Dialog unter dem Vorsitz des Rates gab, wo der Grundstein für die Annahme der vorgeschlagenen Richtlinie in der ersten Lesung gelegt wurde.

previous_src: This must be a strategy of active diplomacy for Latin America.
src: It must certainly be on the side of social progress, in line with the many millions that we invest every year in development and cooperation, but it must be 100% on the side of democracy, 100% on the side of pluralism, and 100% on the side of fundamental freedoms.
tgt: Entsprechend den vielen Millionen, die wir jedes Jahr in Entwicklung und Zusammenarbeit investieren, muss es dabei sicherlich um sozialen Fortschritt gehen, es muss aber zu 100% um Demokratie, zu 100% um Pluralismus und zu 100% um Grundrechte gehen.

previous_src: The process through which these standards are developed should therefore be subject to robust governance.
src: It should be characterised by a high level of transparency and it should ensure a balanced consideration of stakeholder interests.
tgt: Charakterisiert sein sollte er durch ein hohes Maß an Transparenz, und er sollte eine ausgewogene Berücksichtigung der Interessen der Marktteilnehmer gewährleisten.

previous_src: At the same time, I believe that we should have a constructive attitude in this case.
src: This means that we should recognise the efforts undertaken by the Egyptian authorities for their release and, in particular, support this country in the fight against human trafficking.
tgt: Das bedeutet, dass wir die Bemühungen, die die ägyptischen Behörden zu ihrer Freilassung und insbesondere zur Unterstützung dieses Landes im Kampf gegen den Menschenschmuggel unternommen haben, anerkennen sollten.

previous_src: In order to win the battle against murders of women and against impunity we need to attack on a variety of fronts.
src: In the short term, we need to eliminate all discrimination in legislation, facilitate reporting of crimes and protection measures for victims, witnesses and family members, and improve the judicial and prison systems.
tgt: Auf kurze Sicht ist es notwendig, alle Diskriminierungen in der Gesetzgebung aufzuheben, die Anzeige von Straftaten und die Schutzmaßnahmen für die Opfer, Zeugen und Familienangehörigen zu erleichtern und die Rechts- und Gefängnissysteme zu verbessern.

previous_src: (PL) Mr President, I should like to draw attention to three issues in this debate.
src: Firstly, it is essential to maintain a geographical division with respect to financial aid from the EU budget for Mediterranean countries and the countries of Eastern Europe, in accordance with the provisions of the Financial Perspective for 2007-2013, and also to continue providing support to these countries in the form of European Investment Bank loans.
tgt: Premièrement, il est essentiel de maintenir une répartition géographique de l'aide financière à charge du budget communautaire entre pays méditerranéens et pays de l'est de l'Europe, conformément aux dispositions des perspectives financières pour la période 2007-2013, et de continuer à aider ces pays par le biais de prêts de la Banque européenne d'investissement.

previous_src: I hope that, together with the Finnish Presidency, we can sign off the European payment order and begin the process of putting it into law across all the Member States of the EU, so that businesses and citizens can be confident of operating in the internal market in the knowledge that the failure to pay a debt does not end up in endless court proceedings with no outcome.
src: Thanks to the European Union, there is now a simple and user-friendly system for speedy payment of debts which, I believe, will drive forward the internal market for SMEs and boost the EU economy.
tgt: Dank der Europäischen Union verfügen wir nun über ein einfaches und benutzerfreundliches System für die rasche Eintreibung von Forderungen, das meines Erachtens den Binnenmarkt für KMU vorantreiben und der EU-Wirtschaft einen neuen Impuls verleihen wird.

previous_src: According to the Spanish farmers who presented a petition to the European Parliament, underpriced imported Moroccan tomatoes pose a threat to European food producers.
src: They are referring to the underpriced minimum rate which was set at approximately EUR 46 per 100 kg in a preferential import-export agreement between the EU and Morocco.
tgt: Ils se réfèrent au tarif minimum trop faible, d'environ 46 euros pour 100 kg, repris dans l'accord d'import-export entre l'UE et le Maroc.

previous_src: Some say that Pakistan is on the brink of collapse.
src: We must prevent this by giving a strong response.
tgt: Dies müssen wir mit aller Macht verhindern.

previous_src: Mr President, Madam Commissioner, ladies and gentlemen, the High Level Panel has done an excellent piece of work.
src: As Mrs Schaffner said, this is of course a problem which we in this Parliament have been aware of for years.
tgt: Wie Frau Schaffner gesagt hat, geht es zwar um Probleme, die im Parlament schon seit Jahren bekannt sind.

previous_src: I believe this also means that it must be ensured that, when we reassemble in January, we at least know the names of the people involved before proceeding to the ballot.
src: This was not in fact the case at the start of this Parliamentary term.
tgt: Das war nämlich zu Beginn dieser Legislaturperiode nicht der Fall.

previous_src: They are not the same as ten years ago.
src: Secondly, according to the assessment of the agricultural sector, and this one in particular, it should be pointed out that there is much greater sensitivity towards environmental responsibility than there was ten years ago.
tgt: Zum zweiten besteht nach Einschätzung des Agrarsektors, und ganz besonders durch ihn, ein wesentlich höheres Verantwortungsgefühl für die Umwelt als vor zehn Jahren.

previous_src: At the same time, it is deplorable that acts of intimidation were carried out against EU observers, resulting in the mission having to end.
src: The political instability is already having a significant impact.
tgt: L'instabilité politique produit déjà un impact significatif.

previous_src: I would like to start by thanking Mrs Lambert for a very thorough report.
src: I also support the amendments tabled by Mrs Roure and Mrs Lefrançois.
tgt: Je soutiens également les amendements déposés par Mme Roure et Mme Lefrançois.

previous_src: An agreement offering not even the most minimal guarantee that the other parties would abandon the use of leghold traps within a speedy and specific timetable is not one that should even be put forward for serious consideration.
src: This House adopted this report by a large majority in 1997.
tgt: Cette Assemblée a adopté ce rapport à une large majorité en 1997.

previous_src: (IT) Mr President, Commissioner, ladies and gentlemen, I began working at the European Parliament as a political adviser in 1991 and at that time the conflict between northern and southern Sudan was already a recurring crisis.
src: Finally, after 20 years, it seems we are seeing a bit of light at the end of a long, arduous tunnel.
tgt: Schließlich, nach 20 Jahren, scheint es, als ob wir ein schwaches Licht am Ende eines langen, leidvollen Tunnels sehen.

previous_src: The Champalimaud Foundation inaugurated a centre for research into cancer and the neurosciences.
src: Mr Champalimaud was an entrepreneur who left one third of his personal fortune - EUR 500 million - to scientific research in these areas.
tgt: Herr Champalimaud war ein Unternehmer, der ein Drittel seines persönlichen Vermögens - 500 Mio. EUR - für wissenschaftliche Forschung in diesen Bereichen hinterließ und zur Verfügung gestellt hat.

previous_src: If we make a reasonably optimistic assumption, the new regulations could enter into force in the coming weeks and therefore make a swift impression on the operational programmes.
src: The advances, in particular, could be paid out in full at the start of May.
tgt: Insbesondere die Vorschüsse könnten Anfang Mai vollständig ausgezahlt werden.

previous_src: It touches matters of taxation law.
src: But I commend the report and hope that the Commissioner will be able to take it forward to a legislative instrument.
tgt: Doch ich befürworte den Bericht und hoffe, dass die Kommission aus dieser Vorlage ein Legislativinstrument machen kann.

previous_src: The final point which I should like to underline clearly once again, and which I would ask to be taken into account in the position we adopt at the talks in Rambouillet, is as follows: without military back-up, the whole initiative does not make any sense, and it will be years - as we have of course also seen in Bosnia - before a real solution is reached here.
src: Please, stand firm where the military back-up for peace is concerned!
tgt: Bitte, bleiben Sie hart, was die militärische Absicherung des Friedens betrifft!

previous_src: Regarding the accusation of racism, it is hard to find a more ethnically diverse and less racist county than Israel, which includes Arab, Armenian, Druze and other minorities in its society.
src: The image is still strong in my mind of the airlift of Ethiopian Jews to Israel in the 1980s.
tgt: Das Bild des Lufttransports äthiopischer Juden nach Israel in den 1980ern ist mir noch nachhaltig im Gedächtnis.

previous_src: I have read the statement of Mrs Járóka: 'Poverty threatens the new generation - not on account of their Roma origins, but on account of their parents' unemployment '.
src: I would like to add that this is also on account of social exclusion.
tgt: Je voudrais ajouter "également en raison de l'exclusion sociale".

previous_src: Mrs Lienemann referred to a news report a fortnight ago that showed that PCBs were bio-accumulated in fish and that man then ate those fish.
src: We can no longer accept such a situation, and I believe that the citizens of Europe may also expect Europe to send out a strong signal that it is protecting our environment, protecting our health.
tgt: Wir können solche Zustände nicht länger hinnehmen, und ich kann mir vorstellen, dass die Bürger Europas von Europa auch erwarten, dass es ein starkes Zeichen für den Schutz unserer Umwelt und unserer Gesundheit setzt.

previous_src: After the initial advisory role, in the early seventies you gained the first real competences in respect of the European budget, and at the end of the seventies you had the first direct elections.
src: With new agreements you obtained stronger competences in adopting legislation and appointing the top European political representatives.
tgt: Durch neue Abkommen wurden die gesetzgebenden Kompetenzen des Parlaments und sein Zustimmungsrecht bei der Ernennung der politischen Führungskräfte der EU gestärkt.

previous_src: I also repeat that the Commission cannot commit today on a date for the future legislative proposal on rates.
src: We will first need to have the debate on the future of VAT, which will give a clear idea on the priorities for the Commission.
tgt: Wir werden zuerst die Aussprache über die Zukunft des Mehrwertsteuersystems führen müssen, was eine klare Vorstellung über die Prioritäten für die Kommission vermitteln wird.

previous_src: Commissioner Frattini will need to join forces with Commissioner Barrot in this.
src: Money alone is not enough.
tgt: L'argent ne suffit pas.

previous_src: I would like to conclude by assuring Parliament that the Commission will continue to target illegal introductions which present the greatest risk to our high standards.
src: The Commission will also maintain its current proportional approach towards imports of beef from third countries, including Brazil.
tgt: La Commission maintiendra également son actuelle approche proportionnée à l'égard des importations de viande bovine des pays tiers, y compris le Brésil.

previous_src: Mr President, we are completing the consultation process launched by the Green Paper.
src: Creating cross-border opportunities for lenders and borrowers raises important, but also very difficult, policy questions.
tgt: Die Schaffung von grenzüberschreitenden Möglichkeiten für Kreditgeber und Kreditnehmer wirft wichtige, aber auch sehr schwierige Fragen auf.

previous_src: We are now at the stage where we have put forward a policy in response to this, which will put in place a high-level group which will guide the discussion on the appropriate response to healthcare and the delivery of healthcare at EU level.
src: The Commission will lead the debate in conjunction with the health ministers of the Member States of the 25 EU countries.
tgt: Die Kommission wird die Beratungen gemeinsam mit den Gesundheitsministern der 25 EU-Mitgliedstaaten leiten.

previous_src: That does not mean that we should oppose opening up the postal service to competition to some extent.
src: A certain amount of competition can certainly be in the interests of the users.
tgt: Une certaine concurrence peut très certainement favoriser les intérêts des utilisateurs.

previous_src: The country must have not only an effective government, but also one which demonstrates a political determination to address the problems.
src: After five elections in as many years, the population is understandably tired of all the political squabbling.
tgt: Nach fünf Wahlen in genauso vielen Jahren ist die Bevölkerung verständlicherweise der politischen Zänkereien überdrüssig.

previous_src: In this case, where there are many doubts about guilt, and seven witnesses have withdrawn their testimony, there is a need for the case to be re-heard.
src: A further matter, which those who have risen before me have mentioned, is the problem of the irreversibility of the death sentence.
tgt: Hinzu kommt die Endgültigkeit der Todesstrafe, wie viele meiner Vorredner bereits betont haben.

previous_src: We are trying to step up our political dialogue with the government in Khartoum.
src: My recent visit was intended to signal EU re-engagement following Khartoum's positive response to the outcome of the referendum.
tgt: Mit meinem jüngsten Besuch sollte signalisiert werden, dass die EU nach der positiven Reaktion Khartums auf das Ergebnis des Referendums zur Wiederaufnahme der Zusammenarbeit bereit ist.

previous_src: My thanks to Mr Patijn for his answer.
src: I accept everything he has said and I understand the reasons why he said what he said.
tgt: Ich kann alles akzeptieren, was er gesagt hat, und verstehe auch die Gründe, warum er es so gesagt hat.

previous_src: It boasts that it has achieved a compromise on the Services Directive.
src: Yet instead of guaranteeing genuine free movement of services within the EU, the regulation that has come into being is incomplete and imprecise.
tgt: Toutefois, au lieu de garantir véritablement la libre circulation des services au sein de l UE, le règlement entré en vigueur est incomplet et imprécis.

previous_src: Madam President, every year, 400 000 hectares of forest are destroyed in southern Europe.
src: This is a systemic disaster of massive proportions and will worsen over the next few decades.
tgt: Dies ist eine systemische Katastrophe in massivem Ausmaß, die sich in den nächsten Jahrzehnten noch verschlimmern wird.

previous_src: What I said was that we asked for indicative budgets.
src: I suggest, therefore, that I come back to Mr Burke later and the Council services will provide him with precise information on the 2009 budget as soon as they obtain it - I have been told that we only have incomplete information at present.
tgt: Ich schlage Herrn Burke daher vor, dass ich nochmals auf seine Frage zurückkomme und dass die Dienststellen des Rates ihm baldmöglichst präzise Angaben zum Haushalt 2009 übermitteln, sobald diese vorliegen, denn ich bin informiert worden, dass wir zurzeit nur über unvollständige Angaben verfügen.

previous_src: My colleague Mr Kusstatscher says that the Council's attitude during that dialogue was not exactly what we might have expected.
src: He is right, but in the end we had the trilogue, we had several meetings, and at the end of those meetings we signalled our agreement.
tgt: Er hat Recht, aber es gab ja einen Trilog, wir hatten mehrere Sitzungen, und am Ende dieser Sitzungen haben wir eine Einigung erzielt.

previous_src: I have to say that we have been pirouetting around the problem of political parties for several years because, of course, they are prospective rivals and competitors for the old national political parties, which, I sometimes think, will be the final citadel defended in the interests of national sovereignty.
src: So we should proceed fast to develop platforms at European level to support and promote post-national politics which truly reflect the paradigms of the 21st century.
tgt: Nous devrions donc nous mettre rapidement à développer des plates-formes au niveau européen pour soutenir et promouvoir une politique postnationale qui reflète véritablement les paradigmes du 21e siècle.

previous_src: Are the French quicker, or the Germans or the Spaniards?
src: We should all pull together and the Commission should certainly take the lead in this.
tgt: Wir sollten alle an einem Strang ziehen, und die Kommission sollte da durchaus vorangehen.

previous_src: The question arises as to whether the Commissioner and her fellow workers were seriously mistaken, or whether this was a planned strategy aimed at ensuring that certain countries became more profitable.
src: I should like to state unequivocally that, as it has been experienced by Polish voters, the common agricultural policy is exceedingly unbalanced and favours the old EU Member States.
tgt: Ich möchte unmissverständlich behaupten, dass die gemeinsame Agrarpolitik - so haben es polnische Wähler zu spüren bekommen - überdurchschnittlich unausgewogen ist und die alten EU-Mitgliedstaaten bevorteilt.

previous_src: Mr President, the gas crisis has left hundreds of thousands of households across 17 European countries without heating during freezing temperatures.
src: Eastern and central Europe have been affected the most by the dispute, which has shut down factories and schools.
tgt: Am stärksten von der Auseinandersetzung betroffen sind Mittel- und Osteuropa, wo Fabriken und Schulen vorübergehend geschlossen werden mussten.

previous_src: Why is it not even possible in a European Parliament report to refer to the main cause of the poverty, hunger, lack of security, social and economic problems in Africa?
src: The main cause is the bad governments on the continent.
tgt: Die Hauptursache sind die leidigen Regierungen auf dem Kontinent.

previous_src: It is not too late.
src: If we receive irreversible signals that there is a mutual willingness to use this European framework to gradually overcome the political stalemate and the recent crisis, then we will respond positively.
tgt: Wenn wir unwiderrufliche Signale empfangen, dass eine gegenseitige Bereitschaft für die Nutzung dieses europäischen Rahmens zur allmählichen Überwindung der politischen Pattsituation und der jüngsten Krise vorhanden ist, dann werden wir positiv reagieren.

previous_src: Last week, we were again shocked by the fact that people are drowning on their way to Europe.
src: Eleven people drowned near Lampedusa.
tgt: Onze personnes se sont noyées près de Lampedusa.

previous_src: For the sake of clarity, could I ask you once again whether we will really be able to count on you when we amend the directive to such an extent that we modify some of the architecture of the country of origin principle, when we clearly specify the exclusion of services of general interest, as well as public health and social services?
src: In particular, I would like to know whether we could count on your support if we were to launch the idea of working with a positive list when using the country of origin principle, possibly also in terms of the area of application.
tgt: Im Einzelnen möchte ich wissen, ob wir mit Ihrer Unterstützung rechnen könnten, wenn wir den Gedanken einbringen, bei der Anwendung des Herkunftslandsprinzips und eventuell auch bei dem Geltungsbereich mit einer Positivliste zu arbeiten.

previous_src: Yesterday we heard a speech by a leading European head of government who, as the host of the G20 summit next week, said the opposite of what you said here as President-in-Office of the Council.
src: What Gordon Brown said yesterday was the opposite of what you said here.
tgt: Ce que Gordon Brown a déclaré hier est le contraire de ce que vous avez déclaré ici.

previous_src: Rule upon rule, regulation upon regulation are generally made by people with no commercial experience at all.
src: I went through the list of over 700 MEPs just yesterday, and I could not find more than about 5 people who had bona fide business experience.
tgt: Ich bin erst gestern die Liste mit den mehr als 700 Abgeordneten des Europäischen Parlaments durchgegangen und habe lediglich fünf Personen gefunden, die über eigene unternehmerische Erfahrungen verfügen.

previous_src: Mr Stubb's report stresses that fact.
src: We still believe that the content of the Constitutional Treaty is necessary in order to make it possible for our home to receive further guests.
tgt: Wir sind weiter der Meinung, dass der Inhalt des Verfassungsvertrags notwendig ist, damit unser Haus weitere Gäste aufnehmen kann.

previous_src: This followed a period of intense pressure from the financial markets.
src: However, Portugal was also going through a period of political uncertainty which, as we know, led to the resignation of the government on 24 March.
tgt: Portugal durchlebte jedoch eine politisch unsichere Zeit, die, wie wir wissen, zum Rücktritt der Regierung am 24. März geführt hat.

previous_src: As there is no need for this, I would like an explanation as to why you encouraged the new Commissioner for Health to simply ignore the concerns of the World Health Organisation with regard to the feeding trials and why you did not wait until the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) had submitted the new guidelines that it has produced precisely for the purpose of assessing the overall risks to biodiversity and the biosphere posed by GMOs, and why, en passant, you also increased the contamination limit for feed and food potatoes to 0.9%.
src: I consider this to be a risky strategy that our citizens will not find at all acceptable.
tgt: Ich halte das für eine Risikostrategie, die bei unseren Bürgern überhaupt nicht auf Akzeptanz stößt.

previous_src: This view was reached on the basis of all the complaints received, including those which were outside the mandate.
src: I do not believe that this way of judging the results of an Ombudsman is really fair.
tgt: Ich denke nicht, daß diese Art der Beurteilung der Ergebnisse eines Bürgerbeauftragten wirklich fair ist.

previous_src: The EU can only achieve its objective by being active and organised on the world stage, and this is particularly true of migration.
src: I am grateful to see that a paragraph I drafted for the ALDE Group has survived almost unscathed into the final resolution.
tgt: Je suis ravie de constater que le paragraphe I produit par le groupe ALDE est resté quasiment indemne dans la résolution finale.

previous_src: As you well know, Parliament and the Council have to assess it at second reading, but the European Commission intends to seize back the policy initiative and reinvigorate it.
src: In other words, the Commissioner for Industry and Entrepreneurship intends to start work immediately on ensuring the protection of our products, for the sake of the competitiveness of our businesses and the health of our citizens.
tgt: Mit anderen Worten versucht der Kommissar für Industrie und Unternehmertum, die Arbeit zur Gewährleistung des Schutzes unserer Erzeugnisse um der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit unserer Unternehmen und der Gesundheit unserer Bürgerinnen und Bürger willen unverzüglich zu beginnen.

previous_src: I would just like to emphasise again how necessary it is to fight the counterfeiting of pharmaceuticals for these two reasons: to protect the safety of consumers and safeguard the pharmaceutical sector from any unfair competition that does not respect the environment or health and safety rules.
src: Only effective cooperation among all those concerned will guarantee the protection of consumers world-wide, and specifically those in Europe.
tgt: Nur eine wirksame Zusammenarbeit zwischen allen beteiligten Akteuren wird den Schutz der Verbraucher weltweit und speziell in Europa gewährleisten.

previous_src: I will give you an example: not all EU delegations at present comply with the seven human rights guidelines we have agreed on together.
src: Now we have the opportunity, through training programmes, for example, to raise the profile of these important matters.
tgt: Nun haben wir die Chance - beispielsweise durch Schulungsprogramme - das Profil dieser wichtigen Angelegenheiten zu verbessern.

previous_src: It is clear that this will create numerous, unnecessary problems at the external borders and this situation urgently needs to be changed.
src: In this connection, it makes little sense to discuss national visa alert lists if the EU alert system and the EU alert regulations are not even applied consistently.
tgt: In diesem Zusammenhang über nationale Visawarndateien zu diskutieren, macht wenig Sinn, wenn nicht einmal das EU-Warnsystem und die EU-Warnbestimmungen konsequent angewandt werden.

previous_src: This is an outward sign that all Member States are dealt with fairly in the treaties on which the Union is based.
src: We also advocate that each country should continue to have its own Commissioner on the European Commission in future.
tgt: Wir plädieren überdies dafür, dass jedes Land auch künftig einen Kommissar als Vertreter in der Europäischen Kommission hat.

previous_src: Credit rating agencies play a very important role as they have a direct impact on the operation of the financial system, its soundness and stability.
src: I feel that one major problem is the fact that the EU financial supervisory authorities being set up do not yet have real powers which would enable them to have a direct impact and to take binding decisions.
tgt: Meiner Meinung nach ist eines der größeren Probleme in der Tatsache zu suchen, dass die eingerichteten Finanzaufsichtsbehörden noch keine echte Macht haben, die es ihnen ermöglichen würde, direkt Einfluss zu nehmen und verbindliche Entscheidungen zu treffen.

previous_src: We also need to urge European national parliaments to scrutinise the European Development Fund.
src: They can help us in that way.
tgt: Damit können sie uns helfen.

previous_src: I am, of course, in favour of measures that would genuinely enhance security.
src: However, the directive is a further step in the EU's attempts to extend its reach into the security and defence sphere.
tgt: Cependant, la directive est un pas supplémentaire dans les tentatives de l'UE pour étendre son influence dans la sphère de la défense et de la sécurité.

previous_src: I would like to ask: what are the reasons for continuing to play down the true scale of this human tragedy?
src: This way, it seems as though we are always starting from square one.
tgt: Cela nous donne l'impression d'être renvoyés systématiquement à la case départ.

previous_src: (DA) Mr President, a reform of our fisheries policy is long overdue.
src: However, I would have liked it to be more ambitious - particularly as it concerns the future existence of viable fish stocks in our seas.
tgt: Allerdings hätte ich gerne eine ehrgeizigere Reform gesehen - insbesondere im Hinblick auf die zukünftige Existenz lebensfähiger Fischbestände in unseren Meeren.

previous_src: European public health policy only comes into play if there is a cross-border issue involved or if Member States cannot implement a particular task in isolation.
src: Relevant examples include legislation concerning cross-border trade in human organs, tissue and blood, and the programme for orphan drugs.
tgt: Beispiele hierfür sind die Rechtsvorschriften zum grenzüberschreitenden Handel mit Organen, Gewebe und Blut menschlichen Ursprungs sowie das Programm für Orphan-Medikamente.

previous_src: Thus, completion of the European Standardisation System, which needs to be empowered, has been fundamental to establishing the single market, namely through its ability to respond to the growing need for standards that are capable of ensuring product safety for consumers, ease of access, protection of the environment, or innovation.
src: I believe that European standardisation is an important means of promoting innovation, research and development, thus contributing to the Union's ability to compete.
tgt: Ich denke, dass die europäische Normung ein wichtiges Mittel zur Förderung von Innovation, Forschung und Entwicklung ist und daher einen Beitrag zur Wettbewerbsfähigkeit der EU leistet.

previous_src: I have a question for Commissioner Dimas, who is here this evening: how would you feel if individual Member States wanted to go further and adopt more extensive measures than are stipulated in this Directive?
src: If individual Member States wanted to classify more substances than those listed under this compromise, would you let them go ahead and thus adopt more stringent legislation?
tgt: Würden Sie es akzeptieren, wenn einzelne Mitgliedstaaten mehr Stoffe als die in diesem Kompromiss aufgeführten Stoffe als gefährlich einstufen und somit strengere Rechtsvorschriften einführen wollten?

previous_src: When we talk about disability, we must remember that we are talking about all forms of disability: people with mobility problems, hearing impairments, visual impairments, mental health problems, learning disabilities, chronic illnesses and other, hidden, disabilities.
src: That is why I called in my report for a definition of disability.
tgt: Deshalb habe ich in meinem Bericht gefordert, dass der Begriff "Behinderung" klar definiert werden sollte.

previous_src: The key issues in the problematic situation over the negotiations at the moment are the failure to resolve the occupation of Cyprus, inactivity over the UN resolution on Famagusta and a failure to fulfil the 'tasks' arising from previous reports.
src: The reduced role of the army is positive, but only if secular forces remain in power.
tgt: Die eingeschränkte Rolle der Armee ist positiv, jedoch nur, wenn säkulare Kräfte an der Macht bleiben.

previous_src: Non-governmental organizations fulfill an important function, particularly in the environmental and social sectors.
src: Some have become a sort of political conscience - and I am thinking here particularly of Greenpeace or the WWF - and so carry out a public function.
tgt: Certaines d'entre elles, par leur qualité - et je voudrais ici citer tout spécialement Greenpeace ou le WWF - sont devenues une sorte de conscience politique et assument ainsi aussi une fonction publique.

previous_src: Agriculture is enormously important for global food security and we therefore need to take action.
src: Securing the incomes of farmers and an adequate supply of good quality food must therefore be key goals of the common agricultural policy.
tgt: Die Sicherung der Einkommen der Landwirte und die Versorgung mit ausreichend Qualitätslebensmitteln müssen deshalb Kernziele der Gemeinsamen Europäischen Agrarpolitik sein.

previous_src: What will we remember about the role of Europe in this historic situation?
src: I must say that I have not heard any comments this morning on the fundamental issue.
tgt: Ich muss zugeben, ich habe heute Morgen nichts vernommen, was das Wesentliche anbelangt.

previous_src: However, like Mr Wieland, I take the view that this refers to other articles, all of which I have read and which have nothing to do with the procedure adopted this morning.
src: Then there is the option of a proposal by the President.
tgt: Il existe par ailleurs la possibilité d'une proposition du président.

previous_src: As the coordinator of the parliamentary committee that reached an agreement on simplification of legislation (this interinstitutional agreement), I must say something about the importance of the debate that went on in my committee, the Committee on Legal Affairs and the Internal Market, on the report by Mr & # 160; Medina Ortega.
src: This debate began before we worked on the interinstitutional agreement and continued afterwards.
tgt: Diese Debatte begann, bevor wir uns mit der Interinstitutionellen Vereinbarung befassten, und wurde anschließend fortgesetzt.

previous_src: The instrument for pre-accession assistance is important for addressing the region's long term development needs.
src: The total funding for the current financial framework for 2007-2013 is EUR 11.5 billion.
tgt: Die gesamte Finanzierung für das gegenwärtige finanzielle Rahmenwerk für die Jahre 2007 bis 2013 beläuft sich auf 11,5 Milliarden Euro.

previous_src: On this particular occasion, there are two problems that must be solved methodically and purposefully.
src: The first is fishing quotas and the second is the exchange of knowledge and experience of the processing and conservation technologies for the catch and Pacific Ocean production.
tgt: Le premier est celui des quotas de pêche, le second concerne l'échange de connaissances et d'expériences relatives aux techniques de transformation et de conservation du poisson et de la production du Pacifique.

previous_src: In that context, I am convinced that we must create a real link between Parliament and the agencies.
src: Similarly, the new regulation aims to formalise the hearings of the Director of the Foundation before the parliamentary committees.
tgt: In diesem Sinne ist die neue Verordnung darauf gerichtet, den Anhörungen des Direktors der Stiftung vor den Parlamentsausschüssen eine förmliche Grundlage zu geben.

previous_src: This is why I support the Commission proposal to set the autonomous tariff quota at 353 000 tonnes in connection with the expansion of the EU.
src: I also accept the duty of ECU 300 per tonne for this autonomous tariff quota, assuming that this will not give rise to new WTO difficulties.
tgt: Ich akzeptiere auch den Zollsatz von 300 ECU pro Tonne für dieses autonome Kontingent, in der Annahme, daß dies nicht zu neuen Problemen mit der WTO führend wird.

previous_src: Most of the latter were actually penalised by a designation that applied to a product, veal, whose physiological development resulted in great differences within a few months because of its rapidity.
src: A veal calf develops, within a few weeks, from being a monogastric mammal, during the time that it feeds almost entirely on milk, to being a ruminant mammal with four stomachs as soon as it moves on to fibrous foods such as grass, hay and cereals.
tgt: Le veau passe, en effet, en quelques semaines, de l'état de mammifère monogastrique, à l'époque où il se nourrit presque exclusivement de lait, à l'état de mammifère ruminant à quatre estomacs dès qu'il passe aux aliments fibreux tels que l'herbe, le foin et les céréales.

previous_src: Madam President, scientists in the fishing industry now know that the deep and high seas are teeming with life, most of which remains undiscovered.
src: In fact, about 50% of the animals or flora collected from areas deeper than 3 000 metres are a new species.
tgt: En fait, environ 50 % des animaux ou de la flore collectés dans des zones situées à plus de 3 000 mètres de profondeur sont de nouvelles espèces.

previous_src: Energy retail market issues are becoming increasingly important, as markets move closer to consumers, to the introduction of new technology and systems in the form of smart meters and smart grids.
src: Work with the Commission's Smart Grids Task Force is also advancing.
tgt: Auch die Arbeit der Task Force der Kommission für intelligente Stromnetze macht Fortschritte.

previous_src: We are therefore very pleased that the requirement for there to be no residues of hazardous substances in our textiles that could give rise to allergies was successfully voted through - and, as the Commissioner has just said, that we are to have a study carried out to ensure that this is the case.
src: This is absolutely vital and it is something that we in the S & D Group are very pleased about.
tgt: Dies ist absolut notwendig, und wir in der S & D-Fraktion begrüßen dies sehr.

previous_src: I would like to draw attention to the inequalities emphasised by the Commissioner in the detection and treatment of cancer, which are so apparent when we compare the old and the new Union.
src: Statistics point to a higher survival rate and lower mortality in the old EU, and I therefore appeal to the European Commission to apply special monitoring to the implementation of the EU programme 'Europe Against Cancer' in Central and Eastern Europe in particular.
tgt: Die Statistiken belegen eine höhere Überlebensrate und eine geringere Sterblichkeit in der alten EU, und aus diesem Grund appelliere ich an die Europäische Kommission, ein spezielles Monitoring zur Umsetzung des Programms "Europa gegen Krebs" gerade in Mittel- und Osteuropa einzuführen.

previous_src: In particular, I call on the Irish Government to contact the Commission urgently with a view to submitting an application.
src: It is vital that the EU and Parliament extend their support to various communities in Ireland who are suffering horrendous damage.
tgt: Es ist entscheidend, dass die EU und das Parlament ihre Unterstützung auf verschiedene Gemeinden in Irland, die mit furchtbaren Schäden fertig werden müssen, ausweiten.

previous_src: This barbaric act of terrorism has once again torn a family apart and brought with it unimaginable suffering.
src: Yesterday, at least ten people died in a suicide bomb attack in southern Sri Lanka and more than twenty were seriously injured.
tgt: Und erst gestern sind mindestens zehn Menschen durch einen Selbstmordanschlag im südlichen Sri Lanka ums Leben gekommen, mehr als zwanzig Menschen schweben noch in Lebensgefahr.

previous_src: We cannot act just because we have a feeling, because we are persuaded something is wrong.
src: We have to have the legal proof and that is why we have asked the French Government to supply us with the dossiers on the individuals.
tgt: Nous devons avoir la preuve juridique ; c'est pourquoi nous avons demandé au gouvernement français de nous fournir les dossiers sur les personnes.

previous_src: This is why I believe that it is essential for Europe and Balkan countries, like Bulgaria, to follow the example of Slovakia and make the decision to restart blocks I, II, III and IV at the Kozloduy nuclear power plant.
src: At the moment, this is the only option Bulgaria has, enabling it to gain a modicum of independence and reduce both the direct damage and the damage that will be caused by using fuel oil at the moment as a substitute for gas.
tgt: À l'heure actuelle, c'est la seule option dont dispose la Bulgarie, et cela lui permettrait d'acquérir un minimum d'indépendance et de réduire les dommages directs et les dommages qui seront causés par l'utilisation actuelle de mazout comme substitut au gaz.

previous_src: I supported the resolution on Estonia, which showed solidarity with the country in the face of interference by the Russian authorities in the internal affairs of Estonia.
src: In particular, I support the call on the Russian Government to respect the Vienna Convention on the protection of diplomats.
tgt: Insbesondere unterstütze ich die an die russische Regierung gerichtete Forderung, die Wiener Konvention über den Schutz von Diplomaten zu achten.

previous_src: We also consider it important for the treatments to be voluntary and that they should take place within the boundaries established by national governments.
src: If these conditions are met, we are in favour of the amendment and call on everyone to support it, but the reference to the eradication of illnesses should be deleted.
tgt: Wenn diesen Bedingungen entsprochen wird, sind wir für den Änderungsantrag, und rufen jeden dazu auf, diesen zu unterstützen, aber der Bezug auf die Ausrottung von Krankheiten sollte gestrichen werden.

previous_src: Mr Grosch has already pointed out that the technology for stopping a train automatically when it passes a red signal has been in existence for more than 20 years.
src: The question is: why was it not installed?
tgt: Die Frage ist: Warum wurde das nicht installiert?

previous_src: Why do we not have the nerve to indicate what we believe we are able to succeed with by saying 'no'?
src: Why are we once again leaving precisely those who we should be representing in the lurch - in other words, with regard to private equity and the undermining of companies?
tgt: Warum lassen wir genau diejenigen, die von uns vertreten werden sollten, wiederum im Stich - Stichwort Private Equity, Aushöhlung von Unternehmen?

previous_src: Madam President, every year, 400 000 hectares of forest are destroyed in southern Europe.
src: This is a systemic disaster of massive proportions and will worsen over the next few decades.
tgt: Ce désastre systémique d'une ampleur considérable s'aggravera dans les décennies à venir.

previous_src: Finally, transferability of social security rights within the Union is seriously lacking.
src: Therefore, we call upon the European Commission to revise Regulation 19 / 71 on the coordination of regulations in the field of social security for people moving to another Member State within the Union.
tgt: Pour cette raison, nous demandons à la Commission de réexaminer le règlement 19/ 71 sur la coordination des règlements dans le domaine de la sécurité sociale pour les gens qui, au sein de l'Union, s'installent dans un autre État membre.

previous_src: It is not about ideology; it is about the universality of human rights.
src: This universality of human rights transcends ideological differences.
tgt: Und diese Universalität der Menschenrechte gilt jenseits der weltanschaulichen Frontlinien.

previous_src: Mr President, I know you share our concerns about the appalling situation in Zimbabwe.
src: Can I ask you to do two things: first of all, to convey yet again the strong feelings of this House that Mugabe should not be invited to Lisbon in December, and secondly, to respect the wishes of this House and not attend any EU summit to which Mugabe or any other banned Zimbabwean politicians are invited?
tgt: Darf ich Sie um zwei Dinge bitten: Erstens, ein weiteres Mal die starke Überzeugung dieses Hauses zu übermitteln, dass Mugabe im Dezember nicht nach Lissabon eingeladen werden soll, und zweitens, die Wünsche dieses Hauses zu respektieren und nicht an einem EU-Gipfel teilzunehmen, zu dem Mugabe oder andere simbabwische Politiker mit Einreiseverbot eingeladen sind?

previous_src: This is not simply a competition.
src: It is about an engagement of the European Union.
tgt: Il s'agit d'un engagement de l'Union européenne.

previous_src: Only well-informed Europeans can make use of the opportunities offered to them and take part in an active dialogue on Europe.
src: We have all witnessed the consequences resulting from the problems with ensuring people are kept informed: 'No' votes in referendums and the blocking of European development.
tgt: Wir haben alle erlebt, welche Folgen sich aus einem Informationsdefizit der Menschen ergeben können: "Nein"Stimmen in Referenden und die Blockierung der europäischen Weiterentwicklung.

previous_src: Albania is awaiting the local elections of May this year.
src: This will be another check on democracy in the country.
tgt: Dies wird eine weitere Prüfung der Demokratie in dem Land sein.

previous_src: We turn ourselves into supplicants, and these demands become requests in the new report.
src: Anyone who votes in favour of granting discharge to the Council now will be giving their support to precisely this situation, where Parliament stands before the Council making meek requests.
tgt: Tous ceux qui votent maintenant pour l'octroi de la décharge au Conseil cautionnent précisément cette situation, où le Parlement ne fait qu'adresser de gentilles requêtes au Conseil.

previous_src: Here, we come to the fundamental political problem of expansion of the EU to the east.
src: The neighbourhood process does not, of course, replace accession, but it cannot be separated from the perspective of membership in the case of European countries.
tgt: Il est évident que l'instrument de partenariat ne remplace pas l'adhésion, mais, dans le cas de pays européens, il est impossible de le dissocier de la perspective d'une adhésion.

previous_src: A concentration of guarantees in a single system can only be achieved through a proliferation of regulations and agreements between states, something which fragments the system and makes it more vulnerable to an unacceptable accumulation of risk.
src: There are substantial questions marks over the aims of the deposit-guarantee scheme: harmonisation of levels of cover, risk-based contributions, utilisation of funds to provide liquidity, burden-sharing, handling of cross-border crises, liquidation of institutions and cooperation between authorities.
tgt: Les objectifs du système de garantie des dépôts contiennent pas mal de points d'interrogation : harmonisation des niveaux de couverture, cotisations basées sur les risques, utilisation de fonds pour offrir des liquidités, partage du fardeau, traitement des crises transfrontalières, liquidation des institutions et coopération entre les autorités.

previous_src: As regards Amendment No 9, as I said at first reading, the Commission has carefully examined all the questions concerning the budget and is of the opinion that the original proposal for EUR 70 million is an appropriate one.
src: I cannot accept at this stage an increase in the budget.
tgt: À ce stade, je ne peux accepter une augmentation du budget.

previous_src: They maintained that the proportion of GDP is above 50% which is even higher.
src: I am reluctant to provide explanations, but at least 10% of the population of Afghanistan lives off drug production and trade.
tgt: Es widerstrebt mir, dies zu erläutern, aber mindestens 10% der Bevölkerung Afghanistans lebt von der Drogenproduktion und dem Drogenhandel.

previous_src: (SK) Madam President, after the independence which is due to arrive in precisely one month, South Sudan will immediately have to confront a number of humanitarian and socio-economic problems.
src: In view of these circumstances, external assistance to support South Sudan in the fight against extreme poverty, to strengthen local organisations, and to speed up the benefits of peace for its inhabitants, will be more important than ever for a long time to come.
tgt: Compte tenu de ces circonstances, une aide externe destinée à soutenir le Sud-Soudan dans sa lutte contre une pauvreté extrême, à renforcer les organisations locales et à accélérer les bénéfices de la paix pour ses habitants sera plus importante que jamais, et cela pour de longues années.

previous_src: On two occasions already, the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy has reminded the warring parties to show restraint.
src: Even a state of emergency cannot be allowed to result in excessive measures when it comes to fundamental rights and the right to freedom of expression.
tgt: Auch ein Ausnahmezustand darf nicht in übertriebene Maßnahmen in Bezug auf Grundrechte und das Recht auf freie Meinungsäußerung ausarten.

previous_src: The European Youth Pact, adopted last year, is one of the special tools for integration and provides some answers for the youth of Europe, young people who have many difficulties or are in vulnerable situations in individual countries.
src: Social inclusion is one of the most important parts of social policy.
tgt: L inclusion sociale est l un des aspects les plus importants de la politique sociale.

previous_src: (SV) Mr President, Commissioner, the EU enlargement process has been a great success, with the number of Member States having increased from 6 to 27.
src: We have been able to see a whole new Europe take shape.
tgt: Wir konnten sehen, wie ein ganz neues Europa Form angenommen hat.

previous_src: The European Security Strategy should focus on the most important aims in terms of creating a common Security and Defence Policy for the European Union.
src: Above all, we should call for a new generation of satellite systems to be integrated into the European system and for the data gathered to be made available to the military and the police, as well as for the purposes of disaster management, using the satellite centre in Torrejón.
tgt: Nous devons par-dessus tout appeler à ce qu'une nouvelle génération de systèmes satellitaires soit intégrée dans le système européen et à ce que les données collectées soient mises à la disposition des forces militaires et policières, ainsi qu'aux fins de la gestion des catastrophes, à l'aide du centre de satellites de Torrejòn.

previous_src: Citizens of all Member States surely want these things but, over the course of the 20 years since the fall of communism, it has repeatedly been confirmed that they are wanted more and cared about more by those people who have experienced tyranny for a large part of the twentieth century and who have suffered the effects of a dysfunctional, centrally planned, state-run economy.
src: Those people are quite legitimately more sensitive and more aware of manifestations or tendencies pointing to ends other than freedom and prosperity.
tgt: Ces personnes sont légitimement plus sensibles et plus conscientes des phénomènes ou des tendances qui s'opposent à la liberté et à la prospérité.

previous_src: I do not believe that we can continue to stand back in the face of this very serious threat to their lives.
src: The British newspaper, The Guardian, reported in October that some Afghan refugees expelled from Australia had been killed upon their arrival in their country.
tgt: Le Guardian, le quotidien britannique, rapportait au mois d'octobre dernier que des réfugiés afghans expulsés d'Australie avaient été tués en arrivant dans leur pays.

previous_src: The regulation, as proposed, will thus apply to EU flagged vessels operating in non-RFMO areas of the high seas.
src: We currently have a sizeable fleet operating in the South West Atlantic, which is one such area.
tgt: Derzeit ist eine recht große Flotte im Südwestatlantik aktiv, einem ebensolchen Gebiet.

previous_src: Secondly, because they remove the reference to the Commission's White and Green Papers, and those provide the basis for the approach explaining the connection between the needs of the labour market and society in general.
src: And thirdly, because they propose a summary presentation of the different stages of evaluation and of those involved in the individual stages, instead of the detailed, analytical presentation which the Commission has used.
tgt: Drittens, weil sie eine kurze Darlegung der einzelnen Etappen der Bewertung sowie der Akteure enthalten, anstelle der von der Kommission beschlossenen, detaillierten und analytischen Darlegung.

previous_src: They do not refer back to the illegal Soviet occupation of Latvia, nor indeed to the Hitler-Stalin or Ribbentrop-Molotov Pact.
src: I believe that the comments were politically motivated, ignoring the very great diversity within Russian-speaking Latvians.
tgt: Ich denke, diese Kommentare waren politisch motiviert, wobei die äußerst große Vielfalt unter den Russisch sprechenden Letten außer Acht gelassen wurde.

previous_src: My group will not accept this Commission cop-out.
src: We intend to join with the mayors, the Committee of the Regions, the Economic and Social Committee and the trade unions in a political struggle for a Europe with a stronger social dimension, in which public services have priority.
tgt: De concert avec les maires, le Comité des régions, le Comité économique et social, les syndicats, nous allons engager la lutte politique pour une Europe plus sociale, donnant priorité aux services publics.

previous_src: Bioethanol and biodiesel are the biofuels most in use at present.
src: Whilst the two of them are virtually equally profitable, they cannot compete with fuels derived from oil.
tgt: Die Rentabilität dieser beiden Stoffe ist sehr ähnlich, sie können jedoch noch nicht mit den aus Erdöl gewonnenen Kraftstoffen konkurrieren.

previous_src: The Commission can accept Amendment 25 in part, as amended by Amendment 43.
src: The Commission cannot accept any other amendments.
tgt: La Commission ne peut accepter aucun autre amendement.

previous_src: It is actually in the European Community Treaties.
src: Article 2 of the Protocol on cooperation with the Council of Europe, an annex to the ECSC Treaty says the European Parliament of the Communities shall forward each year to the Consultative Assembly of the Council of Europe a report on its activities.
tgt: In Artikel 2 des Protokolls über die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Europarat, einem Anhang zu m Vertrag der Europäischen Gemeinschaft für Kohle und Stahl, steht, daß das Europäische Parlament der Gemeinschaften jedes Jahr der Parlamentarischen Versammlung des Europarats einen Bericht über seine Tätigkeit zu übermitteln hat.

previous_src: For all these reasons, the Athisaari Plan failed.
src: Asking for the status quo ante is not a solution either - one should move further.
tgt: Den Status quo ante zu fordern, ist ebenfalls keine Lösung: Man sollte sich weiterbewegen.

previous_src: So we all, whether we live in rural or urban areas, have a common interest in ensuring a successful conclusion to the World Trade talks.
src: A spur to greater global trade is a spur to greater global prosperity.
tgt: Ein Ansporn für mehr globalen Handel ist ein Ansporn für mehr globalen Wohlstand.

previous_src: What sort of message is it supposed to send out when ballot papers and election material arrive too late or not at all?
src: How, then, are the people of Nigeria supposed to feel that they are being taken seriously?
tgt: Comment le peuple nigérian pourrait -il avoir le sentiment d'être pris au sérieux ?

previous_src: In conclusion I would like to say something about social impacts.
src: Here I must return to the Tripartite and applaud the role of both social partners.
tgt: Hier muss ich wieder zum dreigliedrigen Gipfel zurückkommen und der Rolle beider Sozialpartner Beifall spenden.

previous_src: As the Committee on the Internal Market and Consumer Protection, we are responsible for the narrow area of customs, internal market and consumer protection.
src: We have tried very hard to pay careful attention to the figures and to put in only what is really necessary.
tgt: Wir haben uns wirklich bemüht, hier genau auf die Zahlen zu achten und nur das einzusetzen, was wirklich notwendig ist.

previous_src: In the case of the sports shoes, these are excluded from the investigation because they are not produced in Europe in sufficient quantity to qualify as being potentially harmed by dumping.
src: There is therefore no injury to European producers because they barely exist in the case of these sports shoes.
