previous_src: The Commission agrees with the rapporteur that the perspective of EU membership can act as a catalyst for sustainable economic development and for securing peace and stability within the region.
src: The Commission also agrees that the individual fulfilment of the Copenhagen criteria is of the utmost importance when judging the readiness of countries in the region to join the EU.
tgt: Die Kommission stimmt auch darin zu, dass die individuelle Erfüllung der Kopenhagen-Kriterien bei der Bewertung der Bereitschaft der Länder in der Region, der EU beizutreten, von zentraler Bedeutung ist.

previous_src: I take the view that now is just the right time to renew the European Union's support for Tibet.
src: We must do something about the fact that nine rounds of negotiations between China and the Tibetan Governmentinexile have not led to any outcome, and I completely agree with Mr Rinaldi here.
tgt: Wir müssen etwas dagegen tun, dass die neuen Verhandlungsrunden zwischen China und der tibetischen Exilregierung nicht zu einem Ergebnis geführt haben, und ich stimme hierbei völlig mit Herrn Rinaldi überein.

previous_src: On the contrary, we have nothing but praise for the prompt and positive use of the funds in the LIFE programme.
src: The Commission has succeeded in spending the additional funding that we granted and in doing so usefully.
tgt: Im Gegenteil, wir konnten den guten und zügigen Einsatz der Mittel des Programms LIFE nur loben.

previous_src: I hope that it will not come to this and that we will use all the institutional resources available to us to ensure this summit goes ahead.
src: This will mark not only an occasion for reflection, but also an institutional success because the Union for the Mediterranean needs to overcome political impasses and institutional difficulties in the process of implementing the six strategic projects which embody the institution's very essence.
tgt: Il marquera non seulement une occasion de réflexion, mais aussi un succès institutionnel, car l'Union pour la Méditerranée doit surmonter les impasses politiques et les difficultés institutionnelles dans le processus de mise en œuvre des six projets stratégiques qui incarnent l'essence même de cette institution.

previous_src: Mr President, Mr Cunha's report is characterised by honesty and courage.
src: It is an impartial demonstration of the anti-agricultural line taken by the common agricultural policy.
tgt: Er weist auf objektive Weise die bauernfeindliche Ausrichtung der Gemeinsamen Agrarpolitik nach.

previous_src: You tell us on page 6: 'A new international approach focusing on regulatory cooperation, convergence of standards and equivalence of rules is emerging as a result of sectoral bilateral discussions with third countries.'
src: Well, Mr Vice-President, I should like to know exactly what that implies for the preservation of European environmental standards.
tgt: Moi, je voudrais savoir de façon précise, Monsieur le Vice-président, qu'est -ce que cela signifie pour la préservation des normes européennes en matière d'environnement ?

previous_src: The situation in which Albania finds itself is best described as a cold civil war.
src: Political parties play the role of warring sides and are pulling the country into a downward spiral.
tgt: Politische Parteien spielen die Rolle von Kriegsseiten und ziehen das Land in eine Abwärtsspirale hinab.

previous_src: There are other ways to market products without advertising them in the media: product promotion for instance.
src: That is very bad for media pluralism, because most of all the written press - the newspapers and the magazines - do not get enough income in order to continue to be published.
tgt: Das wirkt sich sehr nachteilig auf den Medienpluralismus aus, da vor allem Printmedien - Tageszeitungen und Zeitschriften - zu geringe Einnahmen haben und ihr Fortbestand dadurch gefährdet ist.

previous_src: In the first place, we will not in any way entertain the suggestion that the date for abolition of these sales should be postponed.
src: On 19 May, let me say again, the Ecofin Council gave no indication to that effect, not did it even agree that the debate should be re-opened.
tgt: Am 19. Mai hat der ECOFIN-Rat, ich wiederhole, kein diesbezügliches Signal gesetzt und hat nicht einmal eine Einigung über die Wiederaufnahme dieser Debatte erzielt.

previous_src: It will answer those questions which were raised by Mr Lungren, that is, it will help to bolster the whole euro area, because the procedures for euro transactions will be strengthened.
src: As a representative of a country, which is not in the euro zone, I am delighted that this regulation can also be applied, if non-euro zone Member States wish, to payments in national currency, which in Lithuania would be the litas.
tgt: Als Vertreterin eines Landes, das nicht in der Eurozone ist, freue ich mich, dass diese Verordnung auch auf Zahlungen in den nationalen Währungen der anderen Länder angewandt werden kann, also in Litauen auf Zahlungen mit dem Litas, wenn Mitgliedstaaten, die nicht in der Eurozone sind, dies wünschen.

previous_src: But such efficiency has to be seen as an instrumental good.
src: As the report states, it is valuable insofar as it promotes the objectives of the CFP.
tgt: So heißt es im Bericht, dass die Effizienz insofern von Nutzen ist, als sie zu den Zielen der GFP beiträgt.

previous_src: The policeman who was killed was married and had children.
src: This barbaric act of terrorism has once again torn a family apart and brought with it unimaginable suffering.
tgt: Cet acte de terrorisme barbare a une fois de plus déchiré une famille et provoqué des souffrances indicibles.

previous_src: Welcome though these freedoms may be, they have also occasionally been abused for purposes such as tax evasion.
src: The instruments we have today to protect ourselves against such abuses are not effective enough.
tgt: Instrumente, die wir heute haben, um uns vor solchen Mißbräuchen zu schützen, sind nicht wirksam genug.

previous_src: Above all, this is a human tragedy.
src: A man of great courage and principle has lost his life and we as democrats honour his name and salute his life's achievements today in this debate.
tgt: Un homme de grand courage et de principes a perdu la vie et, dans ce débat, en tant que démocrates, nous honorons son nom et nous rendons hommage au travail qu'il a réalisé au cours de sa vie.

previous_src: The Committee on Constitutional Affairs did not wish to express its opinion on Article 308.
src: By a very narrow margin, it voted against explicit reference to that article, but by another very slim margin - and our thanks are due here to Mr Duff - it decided against formally ruling out recourse to Article 308, if you still follow the reasoning.
tgt: Mit äußerst knappem Ergebnis stimmte er gegen den ausdrücklichen Verweis auf diesen Artikel, aber mit einem ähnlich knappen Abstimmungsergebnis - unser Dank gilt hier Andrew Duff - hat er beschlossen, den Rückgriff auf Artikel 308 förmlich zu streichen, verstehe dies, wer wolle.

previous_src: In relation to the globalization of the economy, the information society and demographic developments, we are facing enormous reforms of our system as regards working methods.
src: To permit these reforms, policy measures will have to be supportive, and in this context I would like to point to our social security systems, in particular pension schemes.
tgt: Um das zu ermöglichen, müssen die politischen Maßnahmen unterstützend wirken, und in diesem Zusammenhang möchte ich auf unsere Systeme der sozialen Sicherheit hinweisen und vor allem auf die Altersvorsorgesysteme.

previous_src: However, with FLEGT, we are definitely not taking a wrong step.
src: It is a step in the right direction: we are not increasing the risk.
tgt: Es ist ein Schritt in die richtige Richtung: Wir erhöhen das Risiko nicht.

previous_src: It should also encourage fair and non-discriminatory network access as its most important item.
src: The directive should also contain mechanisms to discourage, as we have already heard, the Member States from their market distorting subsidies to traditional forms of energy, particularly fossil fuels and nuclear.
tgt: Die Richtlinie sollte zudem Mechanismen enthalten, die, wie wir schon gehört haben, die Mitgliedstaaten von der Zahlung marktverzerrender Subventionen für herkömmliche Energieformen, insbesondere fossile Brennstoffe und Atomkraft, Abstand nehmen läßt.

previous_src: I cannot conclude without indicating once again my personal satisfaction, as well as the Commission's satisfaction, with the vote that took place earlier today on the proposal for a regulation establishing the new European Instrument for Democracy and Human Rights.
src: This instrument will make it easier for the Commission to establish priorities when implementing the objectives contained in the regulation and in keeping with its scope.
tgt: Mithilfe dieses Instruments wird es für die Kommission leichter sein, bei der Durchsetzung der in dieser Verordnung festgelegten Ziele entsprechend ihres Geltungsbereichs Prioritäten zu setzen.

previous_src: Ten years ago next month, the EU set the goal of a common asylum system and coordinated migration policies.
src: Despite some considerable efforts, especially by the European Commission with the support of MEPs, we are clearly a long way from that.
tgt: Trotz beträchtlicher Anstrengungen, insbesondere durch die Europäische Kommission mit Unterstützung der Abgeordneten, ist es ganz eindeutig noch ein weiter Weg bis dahin.

previous_src: To cite an example, Mr Altmaier: the maritime area that Malta is responsible for monitoring is about two thirds the size of Germany or almost three quarters the size of Italy.
src: We are responsible for the whole of that area.
tgt: Wir sind für dieses gesamte Gebiet zuständig.

previous_src: When we look at the forecasts for growth for next year, we see that the European Union is expected to have an average growth of 0.7%, and Latin America of 5%.
src: This means that the next summit is not going to be a North-South summit, like the previous summits, but a summit between equals.
tgt: Cela signifie que le prochain sommet ne sera pas un sommet Nord - Sud comme les précédents, mais un sommet entre partenaires égaux.

previous_src: It pains me that due to lack of time I am unable to go into this in any more detail.
src: Afghanistan and its people have deserved our fullest commitment.
tgt: L'Afghanistan et son peuple méritent un engagement total de notre part.

previous_src: Use your many means and your sensory mechanisms to find out what the European public really wants.
src: The answer will presumably be security, justice, accountability and democracy.
tgt: La réponse sera probablement : la sécurité, la justice, la responsabilité et la démocratie.

previous_src: And if so, was a directive the right way to go about it?
src: Should it be approached in the limited way proposed by the Commission?
tgt: War eine Richtlinie in der begrenzten Form, wie sie uns von der Kommission vorgeschlagen wurde, erforderlich?

previous_src: It is clear to everyone that this is essential to guaranteeing security in the area and to cooperating in the development which is needed to heal the serious social differences which exist.
src: But this also serves to make a claim, on the part of the European Union, for a degree of political participation in the process which is consistent with its economic contribution - we do not have aspirations to be bankers - and which will be suitably visible to the public.
tgt: Mais il s'agit également d'un appel à ce que l'on accorde à l'Union européenne une participation politique dans le processus, reflétant sa contribution économique ­ nous n'avons pas non plus d'aspirations de banquiers ­ et ce de manière publique.

previous_src: As a fireman myself, I would also be happy to create contacts with the regional and national voluntary fire authorities.
src: In such cases, it is also interesting to do something yourself and if this is seen as desirable, I can offer to carry out a pilot project with our Greek friends on the establishment of a voluntary fire brigade in a selected region or municipality.
tgt: In solchen Fällen ist es auch interessant, selbst etwas zu tun, und wenn dies gewünscht ist, kann ich den griechischen Freunden anbieten, ein Pilotprojekt zum Aufbau einer freiwilligen Feuerwehr in einer ausgewählten Region oder Kommune durchzuführen.

previous_src: In taking power in December last year, President Camara promised to tackle corruption and anarchy and then to hand over power in democratic elections.
src: Today, the military junta continues to rule the country with no respect for the basic principles of the rule of law or fundamental rights.
tgt: Aujourd'hui, la junte militaire continue à diriger le pays au mépris des principes de base de l'État de droit ou des droits fondamentaux.

previous_src: A greater level of cross-border cooperation is required on the part of the market supervisory authorities and customs.
src: That requires political will and requires financial resources.
tgt: Dazu sind politischer Willen und finanzielle Mittel notwendig.

previous_src: There are books that are aimed only at a specialist audience or a special interest group.
src: Money cannot be made from a small number of copies.
tgt: Avec des tirages limités, on ne peut pas gagner d'argent.

previous_src: Mr President, maybe we should question whether or not we might have achieved more if this measure had been introduced to improve the fuel efficiency of commercial vehicles rather than to reduce CO2.
src: In practice, of course, it is the same, but one is seen as a cost to business, and the other as a saving.
tgt: In der Praxis ist das natürlich dasselbe, aber eines wird als Kostenfaktor für Unternehmen angesehen und das andere als eine Einsparung.

previous_src: In taking up this issue, the European Union has shown itself in a different light.
src: The aforementioned subject is very close to my heart, because of my origins, my professional interest and also my activity as a Member of Parliament.
tgt: Aufgrund meiner Herkunft, meines beruflichen Interesses und auch meiner Arbeit als Mitglied des Parlaments liegt mir dieser Punkt sehr am Herzen.

previous_src: On 28 September 2009, the Commission released a communication entitled 'GDP and beyond: Measuring progress in a changing world', proposing measures for the creation of a database of EU environmental accounts, with a view to better public debate and better-supported decision making.
src: By the end of 2013, the Commission should table a report addressing issues such as the situation of our forests and how depleted our fisheries resources are.
tgt: Ende 2013 sollte die Kommission einen Bericht vorlegen, der sich mit Fragen zur Situation der Wälder beschäftigt, und wie erschöpft unsere Fischereiressourcen sind.

previous_src: I would like to see how that turns out.
src: Tomorrow will be the first day of your probation.
tgt: Morgen wird der erste Tag Deiner Bewährung sein.

previous_src: They effectively yielded to pressure from a number of countries.
src: In the report, I suggest that this practice be abandoned, so that the Joint Parliamentary Assembly can function as a genuine joint assembly in which the democratic principle alone prevails.
tgt: In dem Bericht schlage ich vor, diese Praxis aufzugeben, damit die Paritätische Parlamentarische Versammlung als eine wirkliche paritätische Versammlung arbeiten kann, in der ausschließlich demokratische Regeln herrschen.

previous_src: - (PL) Madam President, we are following the situation in the Caucasus with great concern and interest.
src: Armenia and Georgia are countries that are very close to Europe, not only geographically, but also in terms of civilisation.
tgt: L'Arménie et la Géorgie sont des pays qui sont très proches de l'Europe, non seulement géographiquement, mais aussi sur le plan de la civilisation.

previous_src: The three sentences at the beginning are not enough, we asked for a specific chapter, so that we could monitor this area of EU policy separately and effectively.
src: Equality of opportunities is not just the remit of the ESF, it is the remit of all the Structural Funds.
tgt: Chancengleichheit ist nicht nur eine Aufgabe des ESF, es ist eine Aufgabe aller Strukturfonds.

previous_src: Any trial will, inevitably, have to be confined to a very small area.
src: It will need support from a range of partner organisations if it is going to work.
tgt: Es wird der Unterstützung durch eine Reihe von Partnerorganisationen bedürfen, wenn es gelingen soll.

previous_src: The new agreement must also ensure stricter guarantees for the transfer of data to third countries.
src: Are we going to allow the US to transfer information to any country or are we going to set out some clear criteria for that?
tgt: Wollen wir den USA erlauben, Daten an beliebige Staaten zu übermitteln, oder legen wir hierfür klare Kriterien fest?

previous_src: The occupation of the disputed Abyei region by Sudanese government forces on 21 May and the violence which continued yesterday, as well in Kadugli, show us that the civil war between north and south can reignite at any time.
src: This must, of course, be avoided at all costs and our message must be loud and clear.
tgt: C'est une situation qui doit, bien sûr, être évitée à tout prix et notre message doit être clair et puissant.

previous_src: That is not necessarily the fault only of the Cambodians.
src: The Cambodians have slowly started to move.
tgt: Ils ont commencé à bouger lentement.

previous_src: The results of that policy can now be seen in our cities: wholesale unemployment, crime, the development of parallel societies.
src: Instead of learning from the mistakes of the past, we are stubbornly continuing on the same path.
tgt: Statt aus den Fehlern der Vergangenheit zu lernen, schlägt man stur den gleichen Weg ein.

previous_src: Mr President, how fortunate that you anticipated my question.
src: First of all, allow me, as a Greek MEP, to tell you that Greece will make it.
tgt: Lassen Sie mich als griechisches Mitglied des Europäischen Parlaments zunächst anmerken, dass Griechenland es schaffen wird.

previous_src: The expansive policy advocated by the report is in contrast to the EU currency policy which is why the currency policy must be changed and the notion of a European currency must be given up.
src: Currency union ought to take other forms, compatible with an aggressive policy against social unrest and unemployment.
tgt: Die Währungszusammenarbeit muß andere Formen annehmen, die mit einer offensiven Politik gegen Krise und Arbeitslosigkeit vereinbar sind.

previous_src: I think that improving the broadband infrastructure should be a priority and that significant funds should be earmarked for this purpose.
src: I am also sure that European Union funds should be used to modernise or replace broadband networks that do not provide access with a sufficient traffic volume.
tgt: Ich bin außerdem der Meinung, dass die EU-Mittel für die Erneuerung oder die Ersetzung von Breitbandnetzen verwendet werden sollten, die nicht über Verbindungen mit hinreichender funktionaler Leistungsfähigkeit verfügen.

previous_src: Ladies and gentlemen, Mr President, it was your wish to address the European Parliament.
src: We have gladly granted this wish.
tgt: C'est avec plaisir que nous avons répondu à votre souhait.

previous_src: Since the September 11 attack, we have realised that making at-risk areas secure depends on how much we are prepared to gamble on better living conditions.
src: Baroness Ashton, democracy starts from here, from the ability to close the gaps between the rich countries and the poorest countries.
tgt: Baronin Ashton, Demokratie beginnt genau hier, und zwar mit der Fähigkeit, das Gefälle zwischen reichen und den ärmsten Ländern zu überwinden.

previous_src: I agree with Mr Buzek: Russia has a responsibility here.
src: This is a post-colonial and pre-colonial situation and we should no longer accept it.
tgt: Das ist eine postkoloniale und präkoloniale Situation, und das dürfen wir nicht länger akzeptieren!

previous_src: In reality, this only confirms what is already complied with and applied by the vast majority of Member States.
src: The absolute demand for compliance with the objective of maximum maritime safety has again prevailed in this matter, in the same way as the demand for a reduction in the risks of pollution by hydrocarbons.
tgt: Die absolute Forderung der Einhaltung des Ziels der maximalen Sicherheit auf See war in diesem Dossier erneut maßgebend, ebenso wie die geforderte Reduktion der Risiken der Umweltverschmutzung durch Kohlenwasserstoff.

previous_src: I believe that closer cooperation will also aid real development in Turkey.
src: I believe that will mean that, in Turkey, improved human rights, democracy and political climate will be seen as absolutely vital steps to take.
tgt: Je crois qu 'il aura pour conséquence qu' en Turquie on considérera comme indispensable d 'améliorer les droits de l' homme, la démocratie et les conditions politiques.

previous_src: This is the strongest possible argument for a free-trade agreement that is deep rather than quick and light.
src: I do not believe in FTAs as quick, political fixes.
tgt: Je ne crois pas que les ALE sont des remèdes rapides et politiques.

previous_src: I come from a country where we had famine, literally in recent history - I spoke to somebody who spoke to somebody who lived through the last Great Famine in Ireland: it is that recent.
src: One of the things that made a great change in Ireland, as in the United States, was property ownership.
tgt: L'une des choses qui ont amené un grand changement en Irlande, comme aux États-Unis d'ailleurs, c'est la propriété terrienne.

previous_src: The Commission and Council must show more resolve in providing the necessary funding for FRONTEX.
src: To protect our borders effectively, it should have its own equipment and assets, and operate on a year round basis.
tgt: Um unsere Grenzen effektiv zu schützen, müsste die Agentur ihre eigene Ausstattung und ihre eigenen Mittel haben und ganzjährig tätig sein.

previous_src: I am pleased that Parliament will now adopt this report.
src: It is regrettable that the Council has not approved the correlation tables, but I welcome the fact that we are pressing on with the reports that are to be included in the common European asylum system.
tgt: Es ist bedauerlich, dass der Rat die Korrelationstabellen nicht angenommen hat, aber ich begrüße die Tatsache, dass wir die Berichte, die in die gemeinsame europäische Asylregelung aufgenommen werden sollen, weiter vorantreiben.

previous_src: We are now four or five months down the line, and this period has been marked by a deafening silence from the Council, while the estimated fraud involved is between EUR 60 and 100 billion annually.
src: The Council must act.
tgt: Le Conseil doit répondre.

previous_src: The EU needs a new, integrated foreign policy which will allow it to confront the world's problems effectively.
src: The External Action Service must enable the EU to implement comprehensive, integrated political strategies and campaigns.
tgt: Le service pour l'action extérieure doit permettre à l'UE de mettre en œuvre des stratégies et des campagnes politiques qui soient intégrées et globales.

previous_src: In other words, the aim is to impose the liberal choices of big business by fire and sword.
src: It is, to say the least, unacceptable, under pressure from monopoly interests, to persist with such unsuccessful measures, which lead the workers into impoverishment and marginalisation, in order to support the unaccountable profiteering of big business.
tgt: Es ist, gelinde gesagt, unannehmbar, unter dem Druck monopolistischer Interessen solche erfolglosen Maßnahmen weiter voranzutreiben, die die Arbeitnehmer in die Armut und in die Marginalisierung treiben, nur um der maßlosen Profitgier der Großunternehmen Rechnung zu tragen.

previous_src: In exactly 2564 hours, the reactor at Ignalina nuclear power plant in Lithuania - the last remaining independent energy source in Lithuania - will be shut down.
src: Europe has already invested EUR 200 million in the safety of this power plant.
tgt: Europa hat bereits 200 Mio. EUR in die Sicherheit dieses Kraftwerkes investiert.

previous_src: I am confident that the process of ratification will be continued and will end with success in the two remaining Member States.
src: I have received an assurance from the President of Poland, that now, when the Irish referendum has returned a positive result, he will sign the Treaty of Lisbon without delay.
tgt: J'ai obtenu du président de la Pologne, maintenant que le référendum irlandais a donné un résultat positif, la garantie qu'il va signer le traité de Lisbonne sans tarder.

previous_src: The EU's humanitarian aid must be accompanied by political and diplomatic activity that makes compliance with international law, especially international humanitarian law, a priority for the so-called recipient state.
src: The principles of humanity, neutrality, impartiality and independence must be safeguarded and kept distinct from any active military intervention in the field of humanitarian aid.
tgt: Die Grundsätze der Menschlichkeit, Neutralität, Unparteilichkeit und Unabhängigkeit müssen gewahrt und deutlich von jedweder aktiven militärischen Intervention auf dem Gebiet der humanitären Hilfe getrennt werden.

previous_src: You held a great many meetings on this topic.
src: It is a very complex issue and I would like to thank you particularly for being so consistently transparent throughout these negotiations and for making it possible for us to look at the project from a holistic perspective.
tgt: C'est une question très complexe et j'aimerais particulièrement vous remercier pour avoir été en permanence si transparent tout au long des négociations et pour nous avoir permis d'examiner le projet d'un point de vue holistique.

previous_src: That is why the whole area of the prudential supervision of issuing companies is actually a key element without which the realm of electronic money cannot develop in an accountable way.
src: I should also like to remind the House of our urgent need to act in the field of banking supervision too.
tgt: Je rappelle enfin qu'une action urgente est également attendue en matière de contrôle bancaire.

previous_src: In the case of Mexico, for example, the association agreement has resulted in a spectacular increase in trade and investment.
src: The fight against organised crime and drug trafficking and cooperation in the field of energy are other areas where joint cooperation is necessary, as well as greater coordination in multilateral forums.
tgt: La lutte contre le crime organisé et le trafic de drogues et la coopération en matière d'énergie sont d'autres domaines nécessitant une coopération commune ainsi qu'une plus grande coordination au sein de forums multilatéraux.

previous_src: Yet not one of these four grounds for refusing to grant discharge has really been cleared up or satisfied.
src: The representatives of the Council still refuse to have any kind of formal meeting with Parliament.
tgt: Die Vertreter des Rates weigern sich weiterhin, an irgendeinem formellen Treffen mit dem Parlament teilzunehmen.

previous_src: The horizontal guidelines have, since 2000, provided for a positive assessment for this type of cooperation up to certain limits of market share.
src: Following its review process, the Commission is proposing that for purchasing agreements, as long as the market share of participants is 20% or less, it will be presumed to be in line with the competition rules.
tgt: Infolge ihres Überprüfungsverfahrens schlägt die Kommission vor, dass von der Einhaltung der Wettbewerbsregeln für Einkaufsgenossenschaften ausgegangen wird, solange der Marktanteil der Teilnehmer 20% nicht übersteigt.

previous_src: The River Raba of course merely act as a kind of litmus paper, showing that something is amiss with the current legislation, because if everyone is adhering to all the legal limits and there is still thick foam on the river, then something must be wrong with the legislation in this regard.
src: This is why we must change it, and I therefore ask you all to cast your vote tomorrow in support of the compromise package.
tgt: Deshalb sind Änderungen erforderlich, und ich bitte Sie alle, morgen mit Ihrer Stimme das Kompromisspaket zu unterstützen.

previous_src: Here only one alternative exists and those who dare consider other alternatives are labelled enemies of European integration.
src: In my part of Europe, we lived until relatively recently under a political system where no alternatives were allowed and where no parliamentary opposition therefore existed.
tgt: Jener Teil Europas, in dem ich lebe, war bis vor nicht allzu langer Zeit von einem politischen System beherrscht, das keine Alternativen zuließ und in dem folglich auch keine parlamentarische Opposition existierte.

previous_src: The increase in cross-border consolidation in the banking sector raises questions about supervisory jurisdiction, the appropriate coverage level of deposit-guarantee schemes and cross-border cooperation between these schemes.
src: As we know, the European minimum coverage level is set at EUR 20 000, but of course it is actually far higher in many Member States.
tgt: Seit 1994 ist das Mindestschutzniveau auf europäischer Ebene, wie wir wissen, auf 20 000 Euro festgelegt, in Wirklichkeit ist es in vielen Staaten natürlich sehr viel höher.

previous_src: Without proper financing, however, the project will not succeed.
src: In that case, all this will end after the strategy has been adopted.
tgt: Dans ce cas, une fois la stratégie adoptée il ne se passera plus rien.

previous_src: Yet what is behind this phrase?
src: Does it, first of all, mean ensuring people's physical and mental well-being in relation to all areas of human sexuality and reproduction, for example, by combating sexual violence and genital mutilation?
tgt: Bedeutet die Formulierung in erster Linie, dass die körperliche und geistige Gesundheit von Menschen in allen Bereichen der menschlichen Sexualität und Reproduktion, beispielsweise durch Bekämpfung sexueller Gewalt und Genitalverstümmelung, gewährleistet werden soll?

previous_src: The European Security Strategy should focus on the most important aims in terms of creating a common Security and Defence Policy for the European Union.
src: Above all, we should call for a new generation of satellite systems to be integrated into the European system and for the data gathered to be made available to the military and the police, as well as for the purposes of disaster management, using the satellite centre in Torrejón.
tgt: Notwendig ist vor allem, dass eine neue Generation von Satellitensystemen in ein Europäisches System integriert wird und die gesammelten Daten für militärische, polizeiliche und für Maßnahmen des Katastrophenschutzes zur Verfügung stehen, wofür das Satellitenzentrum in Torrejón genutzt werden sollte.

previous_src: Here, we come to the fundamental political problem of expansion of the EU to the east.

src: If he is transferred to another country, a very difficult phase in this man's life in the European Union begins.
tgt: Wenn er in ein anderes Land versetzt wird, beginnt für diesen Mann in der Europäischen Union eine ganz schwierige Phase seines Lebens.

previous_src: Thirdly, I see that the report calls for more resources.
src: Clearly, more resources improve our leverage - that is true.
tgt: Il est vrai que disposer de plus de moyens procurera à nos actions plus de poids.

previous_src: However, I would also say that I do not agree that we should allow unlimited bottom fishing until we have identified vulnerable ecosystems, because once the harm is done, it is done, and then it is too late.
src: This is why we insist on the precautionary approach.
tgt: Deshalb beharren wir mit solchem Nachdruck auf dem Vorsorgeprinzip.

previous_src: As a part of this process, there must also be educational opportunities.
src: I am sorry that, nowadays, the discussion is about increasingly closing the doors of universities to older people, charging fees and ensuring that older people can no longer take an active part in the life of universities.
tgt: Ich bedaure, dass man heute diskutiert, Universitäten zunehmend für ältere Menschen zu schließen, Gebühren zu erheben und dafür zu sorgen, dass ältere Menschen nicht mehr an den Universitäten tätig sein können.

previous_src: Irish Lieutenant General Pat Nash has been appointed to front this mission, and he will therefore be calling the shots - excuse the pun - concerning troop activities on the ground.
src: This operation is going to go ahead, and such remarks are simply not helpful when it comes to aiding this mission's perception and eventual reception among the local population in Chad and among the rebel groups.
tgt: Diese Operation wird stattfinden, und solche Bemerkungen sind nicht sonderlich hilfreich für die Wahrnehmung der Mission, besonders die Wahrnehmung unter der Bevölkerung im Tschad und unter den Rebellengruppen.

previous_src: Mr President, Commissioner, ladies and gentlemen, there are only a few of us here this evening to talk about anti-dumping, which is, however, an issue we speak about a great deal in our own countries.
src: I believe that there is no issue in international trade that business people, small and medium-sized enterprises, trade unions and consumers care more about than dumping.
tgt: Ich glaube, es gibt kein Thema im internationalen Handel, welches für Geschäftsleute, Klein- und Mittelbetriebe, Gewerkschaften und Verbraucher wichtiger ist, als Dumping.

previous_src: My Group's amendments tried to refocus the report on the essential element: the fight against opium production in Afghanistan which is affecting not only Afghanistan but also neighbouring countries.
src: The drugs illegally produced from this opium constitute what some call the true weapons of mass destruction, particularly in Europe.
tgt: Les drogues produites illégalement à partir de cet opium constituent ce que certains appellent les véritables armes de destruction massive, en particulier en Europe.

previous_src: We must make it possible for European citizens to have a more effective voice in shaping European Union policies.
src: To do so, appropriate education is needed, for there is greater opposition to integration among those with low levels of education.
tgt: Um dieses Ziel zu erreichen, ist ein angemessener Bildungsstand erforderlich, denn unter den Bürgern mit niedrigem Bildungsniveau ist die Abneigung gegenüber der europäischen Integration höher ausgeprägt.

previous_src: This will allow consumers to make price comparisons much more easily.
src: Teleshopping, cross-border mail ordering and Internet selling could all profit from this.
tgt: Teleshopping, grenzüberschreitender Versandhandel, das Internet-Angebot könnten davon profitieren.

previous_src: All the same, I regret the absence of concrete measures and of a genuine development strategy.
src: After Copenhagen, the Committee on Development had called on the EU to take notice of innovative projects in Latin America, such as those presented at the Cochabamba Summit this week or the Yasuni ITT project in Ecuador.
tgt: Nach Kopenhagen forderte der Entwicklungsausschuss die EU dazu auf, den innovativen Projekten in Lateinamerika mehr Beachtung zu schenken, wie zum Beispiel denen, die auf dem Gipfel in Cochabamba in dieser Woche vorgestellt wurden oder dem Yasuni-ITT-Projekt in Ecuador.

previous_src: Or are people's expectations so high and the pressure of the global challenges so great that we need to be quicker and to act more quickly?
src: For this reason, I do not regard the issue of time as a problem, but we do need to provide answers.
tgt: C'est pourquoi je ne pense pas que nous soyons face à un problème de temps, mais nous devons apporter des réponses.

previous_src: Madam President, I think it is relevant when making an explanation of vote actually to say how we voted.
src: In my case I voted in favour of this measure, again as a loyal Conservative, again following the whip and again, had I been left to make my own decision, I would have voted against it, for the reasons very clearly set out by some of my colleagues, particularly Mr Hannon's reference to free markets requiring diversity.
tgt: In meinem Fall ist es so, dass ich für diese Maßnahme gestimmt habe, wiederum mit meiner Fraktion und als loyaler Konservativer, aber auch hier hätte ich dagegen gestimmt, wäre ich meiner eigenen Entscheidung gefolgt, und zwar aus den Gründen, die einige meiner Kollegen bereits sehr deutlich ausgeführt haben, insbesondere Herr Hannan mit seinem Verweis auf die Notwendigkeit der Vielfalt für freie Märkte.

previous_src: (PL) Mr President, I would like to speak about Moldova.
src: Moldova is a country whose problems are due to historical factors, its geopolitical position and its current situation, which has arisen as a result of the balance of power within the country as well as external influences.
tgt: Die Probleme dieses Landes sind den historischen Voraussetzungen, seiner geopolitischen Lage und der gegenwärtigen Situation geschuldet, die das Ergebnis des Kräfteverhältnisses im Lande selbst wie auch äußerer Einflüsse ist.

previous_src: For Mr Schulz to be able to withdraw his amendment 1, you must understand that this implies that he has our Assembly's commitment that it accepts the oral amendment to amendment 11.
src: I am therefore asking the Assembly, in slight anticipation, whether it has any objection to there being an oral amendment to amendment 11.
tgt: Als kleiner Vorgriff frage ich somit die Versammlung, ob sie Einwände dagegen hat, daß ein mündlich formulierter Änderungsantrag zum Änderungsantrag 11 gemacht wird.

previous_src: We must also explain that everybody is at risk; we cannot start saying to some groups that it is their problem and that those not in the risk group do not have to worry about it.
src: We still have to stress that simple preventative measures do protect.
tgt: Nous devons toujours souligner que les moyens de prévention les plus simples offrent une protection réelle.

previous_src: It cannot be compared with agriculture in countries which have existed only two or three hundred years.
src: We are going to destroy the rural world by copying them and we will destabilize the regional balance of the whole of the territory of the Member States of the European Union.
tgt: Wir werden den ländlichen Raum zerstören, wenn wir sie hier nachahmen wollen, und wir werden die territoriale Ausgewogenheit überall in allen Mitgliedstaaten der Europäischen Union aus dem Gleichgewicht bringen.

previous_src: I would like to thank the rapporteur Ms Sophia in 't Veld and the other political groups for their constructive approach on these files, under which the agreements with the US and Australia remain provisionally applicable until their renegotiation.
src: I will, in the meantime, propose a set of three recommendations for negotiation directives to the Council as a part of a PNR package.
tgt: Je proposerai, entre-temps, une série de trois recommandations pour les directives de négociation au Conseil dans le cadre du paquet PNR.

previous_src: (PL) Mr President, in Central America, the term 'European Union' is gradually being consigned to the dictionary of rare expressions.
src: European political influence in the region is diminishing, even though in the 1980s those same European countries were instrumental in the democratisation of the region.
tgt: Der politische Einfluss Europas in der Region schwindet, obwohl es gerade die europäischen Länder waren, die in den 1980er Jahren den Demokratisierungsprozess in der Region unterstützt haben.

previous_src: I have to tell the House that the Commission does not share the view that a new legal basis of the kind suggested is necessary.
src: Instead, in our communication on services of general interest, we advocated that a reference should be inserted in Article 3 of the present Treaty to the effect that a specific activity of the Community should be a contribution to the promotion of services of general interest.
tgt: In unserer Mitteilung zu Dienstleistungen von allgemeinem Interesse sprachen wir uns statt dessen dafür aus, daß ein Hinweis in Artikel 3 des jetzigen Vertrags dahingehend eingefügt werden sollte, daß eine spezifische Tätigkeit der Gemeinschaft einen Beitrag zur Förderung der Dienstleistungen von allgemeinem Interesse leisten soll.

previous_src: Madam President, ladies and gentlemen, this evening's debate is concerned with citizenship of the Union.
src: We all know what that means and what a key role citizenship of the Union occupies for the citizens of Europe, and above all in European integration.
tgt: Wir alle wissen, was das bedeutet und welche Schlüsselfunktion diese Unionsbürgerschaft für die Bürger Europas hat, aber vor allen Dingen auch für die europäische Integration.

previous_src: Women's organisations play an essential role in the fight against violence.
src: They reach out to those at risk and are active in raising awareness among the public.
tgt: Elles touchent les catégories à risques et s'attachent à conscientiser le public.

previous_src: Mr President, the first point I would like to make with regard to combating fraud is that there is one problem that requires urgent attention.
src: There is currently no legal institution competent to carry out enquiries within the Community bodies, due to the latters' privileged status.
tgt: Es besteht heute keine Gerichtsinstanz, die befugt ist, Ermittlungen in den Gemeinschaftsverwaltungen durchzuführen, und zwar aufgrund der Privilegien, die diese genießen.

previous_src: Energy security, Commissioner, is undoubtedly one of the greatest challenges facing the European Union in the 21st century.
src: It can be achieved only by diversifying our energy supply sources so as to free EU Member States from dependence on companies controlled by the Russian security services.
tgt: Sie ist nur durch eine Diversifizierung unserer Versorgungsquellen zu erreichen, um die EU-Mitgliedstaaten von ihrer Abhängigkeit von Unternehmen zu befreien, die vom russischen Geheimdienst kontrolliert werden.

previous_src: This proposal is therefore nothing more than an adaptation of the regulation of April 2009 to the new circumstances, but it strengthens the role of ESMA.
src: It gives the new supervisory authority more powers and - something that is completely new - it gives ESMA the power to punish non-application of the regulation.
tgt: Er gibt der neuen Aufsichtsbehörde mehr Macht und Befugnisse, und - was ganz neu ist - er stattet ESMA auch mit Sanktionsmöglichkeiten aus.

previous_src: author. - (PT) Mr President, the text that we are submitting today for Parliament's approval very much reflects the fact that this situation can only be described as a human tragedy of massive proportions.
src: I should like to thank the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees, Mr António Guterres, for drawing attention to this disaster, which took place on 7 February.
tgt: Ich möchte dem Hochkommissar der Vereinten Nationen, Herrn António Guterres, dafür danken, dass er am 7. Februar auf diese Katastrophe aufmerksam gemacht hat.

previous_src: Cyanide is an extremely dangerous chemical used by the mining industry, despite the risks that it poses to the environment and human health.
src: Ten years ago, more than 100 000 cubic metres of cyanide-contaminated water were accidentally discharged into the river system from a gold mine reservoir in Romania.
tgt: Il y a dix ans, plus de 100 000 mètres cubes d'eau polluée au cyanure ont été déversés accidentellement d'un réservoir d'une mine d'or en Roumanie dans le réseau fluvial.

previous_src: Mr President, I voted for this important document, and its importance has been stressed by all the speakers, particularly by Mrs Echerer who said: 'You are never too old to learn', by Mr Posselt, who is so eager to support the elderly that I could give him a Pensioners' Party membership card, and by Commissioner Barnier himself, who has assured us of his strong commitment in this area.
src: However, Mr President, as representative of the Pensioners' Party to the European Parliament, I call for words to be translated into action.
tgt: Trotzdem würde ich mir als Vertreter der Rentnerpartei im Europäischen Parlament wünschen, dass den Worten nun Taten folgen mögen.

previous_src: on behalf of the IND / DEM Group. - (PL) Mr President, despite the report's many positive aspects in drawing attention to the negative influence of media, marketing and advertising that caricature and objectify human beings, discriminate against them and deprive them of their dignity, I must nevertheless protest at some of its arguments, which are manipulative and aimed at the creation of a modern egalitarian society devoid of ethical models.
src: It is true that various hormonal and psychological therapies make it possible to experiment on people, but such experimentation causes serious trauma and should be banned, just as experiments on animals are restricted.
tgt: Es ist richtig, dass verschiedene Hormontherapien und psychologische Behandlungen Versuche an Menschen möglich machen, aber solche Experimente verursachen schwere Traumata und sollten verboten werden, so wie auch Tierversuche nur eingeschränkt zulässig sind.

previous_src: At the same time, it is hardly imaginable that this deal could have been concluded without the knowledge of the governments concerned.
src: Therefore, we can say that the unexpected transaction is clear proof of ambivalence among Member States, and is at the same time a new warning.
tgt: Nous pouvons donc dire que cette transaction imprévue est une preuve évidente de l'ambivalence régnant parmi les États membres et constitue parallèlement un nouvel avertissement.

previous_src: The report voices dissatisfaction regarding the inability of the international community to reach a consensus at the Non-Proliferation Treaty Review Conference held in New York in May this year.
src: This is seen as a serious blow for multilateralism.
tgt: Ce fut un coup sérieux porté au multilatéralisme.

previous_src: The mechanism created is indeed only a limited solution to the problem of inadequate access to medicines in poor countries.
src: The EU must help developing countries find a long-term solution in terms of obtaining the most essential medicines at affordable price, and must stimulate investment in local production facilities.
tgt: Die EU muss Entwicklungsländer bei der Suche nach langfristigen Lösungen in Bezug auf den Erwerb der grundlegendsten Arzneimittel zu einem erschwinglichen Preis unterstützen und Investitionen in Produktionsmöglichkeiten vor Ort fördern.

previous_src: on behalf of the PPE-DE Group. -Mr President, it behoves Mr Watson, if he is making a suggestion that we should consider the recast implications, to explain to us now what the recast implications are.
src: He might like to have a word with Mr Corbett before answering.
tgt: Vielleicht möchte er sich mit Richard Corbett beraten, bevor er antwortet.

previous_src: Countries are not racist: people are racist.
src: There are many people in Iran, I am sure, who do not share the views of their President and I think it was in fact a missed opportunity that Europe was weak, silent, divided and absent and did not speak on behalf of those people in Iran and that it left the podium to the likes of Mr Ahmadinejad to speak his racist language.
tgt: Ich bin mir sicher, dass es viele Menschen im Iran gibt, die die Ansichten ihres Präsidenten nicht teilen, und ich denke, dass es in der Tat eine verpasste Gelegenheit war, dass sich Europa schwach, still, geteilt und abwesend gezeigt hat, dass es nicht im Namen der Menschen im Iran gesprochen hat, und dass es das Podium Menschen wie Herrn Ahmadinejad und seinen rassistischen Aussagen überlassen hat.

previous_src: Explanations of vote may refer only to the European Strategy for the Danube Region.
src: I am sorry, but this was not my decision.
tgt: Je suis désolé, mais ce n'est pas moi qui l'ai décidé.

previous_src: That is a very specific question.
src: We prefer general questions about the crisis and how to overcome it.
tgt: Nous préférons des questions générales sur la crise et les solutions pour la surmonter.

previous_src: All of you are going through that every time you vote in this Parliament, I suspect.
src: The longer we are without an agreement on the Terrorist Finance Tracking Programme, the greater the risk of a terrorist attack that could have been prevented.
tgt: Plus nous tarderons à nous mettre d'accord sur le Programme de surveillance du financement du terrorisme et plus nous risquerons d'être victimes d'une attaque que nous aurions pu empêcher.

previous_src: The European Union proposals for Kyoto are not unilateral reductions but proposals in support of our position at the Kyoto negotiations.
src: So our objective at Kyoto must be to obtain an ambitious agreement on this point, and I agree with everyone in recognizing that the United States has a very important role to play in this respect.
tgt: Es muß also unser Ziel sein, in Kyoto eine ehrgeizige Vereinbarung zu diesem Punkt zu erreichen, und ich bin mit jedem einverstanden, um anzuerkennen, daß die Vereinigten Staaten in dieser Beziehung eine sehr wichtige Rolle spielen.

previous_src: Now, what we are saying needs to be heard.
src: We talk about producing better legislation, and the scope of such legislation is vast.
tgt: Es geht um eine bessere Rechtsetzung, und das ist ein weites Feld.

previous_src: I am also a little sceptical about what Mr Souchet said regarding the national level.
src: We could talk instead about regional cooperation between several countries.
tgt: On pourrait plutôt parler d'une collaboration régionale entre plusieurs pays.

previous_src: We are overcoming the Council's aversion to working with Parliament.
src: I think this is going to happen not only in this area of our work, but that it is also going to happen in other areas of our work, including the parliamentary committees.
tgt: Ich denke, dass dies nicht nur in diesem Arbeitsbereich geschehen wird, sondern auch in anderen Arbeitsbereichen, einschließlich der parlamentarischen Ausschüsse.

previous_src: The annual motion for a resolution on racism, as prepared by the Committee on Civil Liberties and Citizens' Rights of our Assembly, and as presented this morning, seemed to show an improvement on texts of previous years.
src: Indeed, for once, the usual amalgam of 'racism' and 'control of immigration' was carefully avoided.
tgt: Endlich einmal wurde nämlich sorgfältig vermieden, "Rassismus" und "Eindämmung der Zuwanderung" in einen Topf zu werfen.

previous_src: The need for Community solutions is obviously justified by the cross-border nature of satellite communications.
src: We must not, however, forget the particular significance of this solution, which requires us to maintain due care during the subsequent procedure.
tgt: Wir dürfen dabei jedoch die besondere Bedeutung dieser Lösung nicht außer Acht lassen, die uns angemessene Sorgfalt während des Folgeverfahrens abverlangt.

previous_src: In the past, I have pressed the European Commission to help develop a kind of Kimberley Process for resources other than just diamonds to ensure that the activities of mining companies do not support civil war or ruthless dictators such as Captain Camara in Guinea.
src: I am therefore especially concerned about the massive deal struck between Guinea and Chinese companies, and I hope that the Commission and Council will express to Beijing our expectations that its business activities there should neither provoke internal strife nor further undermine human rights in Guinea.
tgt: Ich bin daher vor allem hinsichtlich des bedeutenden Geschäftsabschlusses zwischen Guinea und verschiedenen chinesischen Gesellschaften besorgt, und ich hoffe, dass die Kommission und der Rat Peking mitteilen, dass wir erwarten, dass Chinas Geschäftstätigkeit in Guinea weder interne Konflikte hervorruft noch weiter zur Untergrabung der Menschenrechte beiträgt.

previous_src: I have strongly welcomed the campaign launched by German women, showing the red card to forced prostitution and calling for cross-border cooperation in the promotion of the red card campaign, putting forward the idea of zero tolerance of trafficking throughout Europe.
src: On the eve of the World Cup I handed over the final list of signatures to the anti-trafficking campaign to Commissioner Frattini.
tgt: À la veille de la Coupe du monde, j ai transmis la liste finale des signatures au commissaire Frattini.

previous_src: Regarding agricultural products, at the moment we are deeply worried about the cost of production, supply and security of food.
src: Yet the actual costs of fertiliser - because you have put in place anti-dumping legislation - have risen by 173%.
tgt: Dennoch sind die Kosten für Düngemittel um 173% gestiegen, weil Sie die Antidumping-Rechtsvorschriften auf den Weg gebracht haben.

previous_src: The UfM is the only possible response we have at our disposal for speeding up development in the southern countries, strengthening links between them and improving dialogue on both sides of the Mediterranean.
src: The region needs to increase its economic development and cultural exchange agreements.
tgt: Die Region muss ihre wirtschaftliche Entwicklung und Kulturaustauschabkommen ausweiten.

previous_src: With the price of oil at almost USD 100 per barrel, this Europe that we live in faces an emergency.
src: We need a European energy policy to guarantee us security of supply and sustainable growth in this sector.
tgt: Wir brauchen eine europäische Energiepolitik, die unsere Versorgungssicherheit sowie ein dauerhaftes Wachstum dieses Sektors gewährleistet.

previous_src: Nevertheless, after the fall of the Wall, the German question, it has to be said, was a major concern.
src: What path would reunited Germany choose?
tgt: Welchen Weg würde das wiedervereinte Deutschland wählen?

previous_src: The dumping price of Norwegian salmon is also forcing fishermen in other countries to make ends meet by overfishing.
src: Reports like the one before us today are also needed for our northern waters.
tgt: Des rapports comme celui qui est à l'examen maintenant, il nous en faudrait aussi sur les eaux de pêche des zones septentrionales de l'Union européenne.

previous_src: On the other hand, the European Regional Development Fund, the ERDF, also contributes as part of its role to promoting social and economic cohesion, by redressing the main regional imbalances and encouraging rural areas to take part in development and conversion.
src: In this regard, we should bear in mind that the ERDF also contributes to promoting sustainable rural development and to creating sustainable employment in rural areas.
tgt: In dieser Hinsicht sei daran erinnert, daß der EFRE auch zur Förderung einer nachhaltigen Entwicklung und zur ebenfalls nachhaltigen Schaffung von Arbeitsplätzen im ländlichen Raum beiträgt.

previous_src: An international instrument promoting high standards of responsibility is clearly desirable and, for this enterprise to be successful, we need to build the broadest possible consensus and encourage all states to support this initiative.
src: We would wish it to be a legally binding, separate and self-standing initiative that would cover all conventional arms transfers, set out the principles defining illegal transfers, include monitoring and be broadly based.
tgt: Nous voudrions qu'elle soit juridiquement contraignante, distincte et autonome, et qu'elle couvre tous les transferts d'armes classiques, fixe les principes définissant les transferts illégaux, inclue le contrôle et ait une base large.

previous_src: However, most of all we must go further in assessing and studying the situation so that we can quickly identify the measures that, in the short term, can be adopted in the immediate future.
src: We naturally place our trust in the sensitivity of the Commissioner and the Commission in following up this concern of ours.
tgt: Natürlich setzen wir unser Vertrauen in die Sensibilität des Kommissars und der Kommission, dass sie auf unsere Bedenken reagieren.

previous_src: This does not mean that the commercial aspects are the most important, naturally.
src: As the Commissioner said a moment ago, this association provides the foundations for the relationship in terms of political dialogue, respect for human rights, for democratic values, respect for the rule of law, and the fight against corruption.
tgt: Wie der Kommissar vor ein paar Minuten sagte, legt diese Partnerschaft die Grundlagen für die Beziehungen in Fragen des politischen Dialogs, der Achtung der Menschenrechte, der demokratischen Werte, der Respektierung der Rechtsstaatlichkeit und der Bekämpfung der Korruption.

previous_src: We are stuck with our own procedures and agreements and this is a missed opportunity indeed.
src: Hopefully, the evaluation will provide an opportunity for improvement.
tgt: Espérons que l'évaluation donnera une occasion d'amélioration.

previous_src: The European Parliament report on the development of the civilian-military capabilities of the EU highlights the repulsive imperialist face of the EU and of the political representatives of capital.
src: It is a macabre manual for implementing the imperialist interventions of the EU and committing crimes against humanity.
tgt: Es handelt sich dabei um eine makabre Gebrauchsanleitung für die imperialistischen Eingriffe der EU und für Verbrechen gegen die Menschlichkeit.

previous_src: However, because each disease is rare, it is impossible for each Member State to have the expertise needed to diagnose it and treat the patients.
src: This is therefore an excellent example in the health sector where Europe can add particular value, which is why the Commission has approved the strategic action.
tgt: Dies ist daher ein ausgezeichnetes Beispiel für den Gesundheitssektor, wo Europa einen besonderen Wert beifügen kann, weshalb die Kommission die strategische Maßnahme angenommen hat.

previous_src: Mr President, the story of Guinea-Conakry follows a depressingly familiar African script: a dictatorial ruler; a military coup; one authoritarian regime replaced by another; and most of the people still living in abject poverty.
src: Substantial mineral and oil resources could make Guinea one of Africa's most prosperous nations.
tgt: Des ressources minérales et pétrolières substantielles font de la Guinée l'une des nations d'Afrique les plus prospères.

previous_src: The EU's EGNOS and Galileo projects can contribute to competitiveness in every area of this sector of services, because they are markedly better and more accurate than the GPS system while also being compatible with it.
src: Unfortunately, the countries in the east and south of the Union are still not covered by the EGNOS system.
tgt: Malheureusement, les pays de l'est et du sud de l'Union ne sont pas encore couverts par le système EGNOS.

previous_src: In light of the latest reports of successful experiments and even treatments using stem cells from cord blood, how can the Commission defend the morally unacceptable production of human embryos for research purposes?
src: Also, why has Commissioner Dalli not presented us today with a concrete plan for the Commission to increase the percentage of cord blood collected at birth, instead of a meaningless opinion?
tgt: En outre, pourquoi le commissaire Dalli ne nous a -t-il aujourd'hui pas présenté de plan concret visant à permettre à la Commission d'accroître le pourcentage de sang de cordon collecté à la naissance, au lieu d'un avis insignifiant ?

previous_src: In recent months, however, the Chinese authorities have been allowing themselves to violate freedom of expression more frequently than usual.
src: They have also repressed journalists and activists.
tgt: Elles ont également exercé une répression à l'encontre de journalistes et d'activistes.

previous_src: It is therefore not a question of some sort of cancerous growth on European parliamentary order, as he has claimed.
src: In my opinion Mr Posselt's organisation resembles a cancerous growth as it acts in direct opposition to the aims of modern European integration pursued by the EU.
tgt: À mon avis, c'est l'organisation de M. Posselt qui ressemble à une tumeur cancéreuse, car il agit en opposition directe aux objectifs de l'intégration européenne moderne menée par l'UE.

previous_src: Please allow me to say that the present report can be judged very positively.
src: I, too, would like to congratulate Mrs Graenitz on it, though I would also like to clarify one particular point of her report, namely paragraph 59, in which Directive 79 / 112 / EEC is addressed.
tgt: Auch ich möchte Frau Graenitz dazu gratulieren, möchte aber doch zu einem Punkt ihres Berichtes eine Klarstellung vornehmen, und zwar zu Punkt 59, in dem die Richtlinie 79/ 112/ EWG angesprochen wird.

previous_src: My own personal viewpoint, which I have tried to make clear, has to do with the interests of a people who have lived through 30 years of war.
src: I think that much of this is in the report and for this I would again thank all those persons and all those groups involved.
tgt: Ich denke, dass da viel im Bericht enthalten ist, dafür noch mal meinen Dank an alle Beteiligten und an alle Fraktionen.

previous_src: Mr President, I do not doubt Commissioner Frattini's own personal good faith and commitment to data protection.
src: But I think the Commission, as well as the Council, are being as feeble about SWIFT privacy abuses as they have been over PNR over the last four years.
tgt: Je pense cependant que la Commission et le Conseil se montrent aussi frileux vis-à-vis des atteintes à la vie privée imputables à la société SWIFT qu'ils l'ont été pour les données PNR au cours des quatre dernières années.

previous_src: It will not have a negative impact on world trade either.
src: That is why we cannot allow promotion and information action to be sidelined.
tgt: Daher dürfen wir nicht zulassen, dass Absatzförderung und Information vernachlässigt werden.

previous_src: I would like very warmly to thank Commissioner de Palacio for committing the Commission to becoming active in this area and to producing standards.
src: I think Parliament has already called for that in the Schwaiger Report on the accession of new states, which called for a code of nuclear safety even before the new Member States join.
tgt: Je crois que le Parlement européen l'a déjà exigé dans le rapport Schwaiger sur l'adhésion, dans lequel un code d'honneur pour la sécurité nucléaire avait été demandé, avant même l'adhésion des nouveaux États membres.

previous_src: First, although it does not depend directly on us, is the long-awaited decision on the European Constitution.
src: I am confident it will be adopted; this will send out a strong message for the future of the Union and will put the machinery in place for the Union to work effectively.

tgt: À mon sens, ces nouvelles règles en matière de coopération horizontale entre les entreprises aideront, en partie au moins, les entreprises à ne pas payer un prix excessif pour utiliser des brevets.

tgt: Die heutige Lage im Tschad beweist ebenfalls, so es denn noch eines Beweises bedurfte, dass ein Großteil Afrikas noch weit davon entfernt ist, dieser "Wertegemeinschaft" anzugehören.

previous_src: I would still like to emphasise the significance of the civil society that is developing in Afghanistan for strengthening the rule of law and democracy and for defeating the culture of violence.

tgt: Bei dieser Arbeit sind die Entwicklung und Handlungsfreiheit unabhängiger, pluralistischer Medien ausgesprochen wichtig.

src: Europe remains silent.

tgt: Wären wir heute nicht so einflussreich, wären wir heute nicht in 75 Prozent der Fälle der Gesetzgeber, und wären wir nicht mit dem Vertrag von Lissabon in nahezu 100 Prozent der Fälle der Mitgesetzgeber, dann wäre es in der Tat so, dass die Bürokratie in Europa entscheiden würde.

tgt: Ce sommet a confirmé la nécessité de poursuivre le travail visant à créer des institutions et des instruments de suivi et de contrôle dans divers secteurs du marché mondial.

tgt: Diese horizontalen Vereinbarungen - wir nennen sie horizontal, weil die zusammenarbeitenden Unternehmen auf derselben Ebene der Lieferkette aktiv sind - können es Unternehmen ermöglichen, auf durch Globalisierung bedingten steigenden Konkurrenzdruck und sich verändernde Märkte zu reagieren.

tgt: Ich wollte anfänglich nicht glauben, dass der 160 Jahre literarische Essay Realität wurde, doch genau das ist geschehen.

tgt: Armut und soziale Ausgrenzung ist das Los der Frauen, wie auch Gewalt, psychologische und physische Gewalt und extreme, zum Tod führende Gewalt.

tgt: Deshalb gibt es zahlreiche Maßnahmen, mit denen dieser Prozess überwacht wird und Abweichungen ausgeschaltet werden.

tgt: Die innere Lage im Land ist von Chaos und Anarchie geprägt.

previous_src: He is one of nearly 7 000 people who are executed in that country every year.

tgt: Sie wissen, dass Sie die Unterstützung des Parlaments haben: Sie sagten das selbst.

previous_src: (FR) I voted in favour of the excellent report by Mrs del Castillo Vera on the subject of entrepreneurship and growth.

tgt: Mit diesem Bericht wird ein wichtiger Beitrag zur Umsetzung der in der geänderten Lissabon-Strategie festgelegten Ziele geleistet, die den Schwerpunkt auf Wachstum und Beschäftigung bei gleichzeitiger Wahrung des Gleichgewichts zwischen den drei Säulen des Prozesses Wirtschaft, Soziales und Umwelt legt.

tgt: Prozesse scheitern in den anderen Bereichen nicht an mangelndem Interesse nationaler Staatsanwälte, wie das in dem Fall des finanziellen Schutzes der Europäischen Union der Fall ist, sondern zumeist an Sprachbarrieren und Rechtsproblemen.

tgt: In Gefahr sind nicht nur diejenigen, die das archaische Gesetz kritisieren, nach dem auf Gotteslästerung die Todesstrafe steht, sondern auch wer öffentlich für die Opfer von Intoleranz eintritt, wie Herr Bhatti.

previous_src: Gérard has worked quickly but he has not been sloppy or careless.

tgt: Nous avons été en mesure de faire passer des points importants malgré un travail rapide.

src: Close commercial links between a number of prominent EU Member States - I need not name any names as you, too, must be aware of who they are - and the Islamic Republic could always pose major obstacles to seriously tackling the nuclear issue.
tgt: Les relations commerciales étroites entre plusieurs États membres de l'UE de premier plan - inutile que je dise lesquels, car vous n'ignorez sans doute pas desquels il s'agit - et la République islamique pourraient toujours dresser des obstacles majeurs sur la voie d'un règlement sérieux de la question nucléaire.

previous_src: Under my proposal, our President, the President of Parliament, should judge this.
