src: Allow me to focus on some points highlighted in your report.
tgt: Ich möchte mich gerne auf einige der in Ihrem Bericht hervorgehobenen Punkte konzentrieren.

previous_src: The reality is that landmines are still being used.
src: It is a barbaric practice; 2 000 people die or are maimed every single month and we really need to get to grips with this issue comprehensively and on an international basis.
tgt: Es ist eine Barbarei: 2 000 Menschen kommen pro Monat dadurch ums Leben oder werden verstümmelt, und wir müssen dieses Problem umfassend und auf internationaler Ebene in den Griff bekommen.

previous_src: However, I must admit that this arrangement does have the advantage of being much quicker.
src: If we approve the set-aside rate today, the farmers will know before harvest-time what lies in store for them next year, and how much land they will have to take out of production.
tgt: Si nous adoptons aujourd'hui le taux de gel des terres, les agriculteurs seront informés avant la récolte de ce qui les attend pour l'année prochaine et connaîtront le taux de surface à mettre en jachère.

previous_src: The question really is, what can we do about it?
src: Just because North Korea has decided to be the Greta Garbo of the international community - 'we want to be alone' - it does not mean we should leave them alone.
tgt: Nur weil sich Nordkorea dazu entschlossen hat, die Greta Garbo der internationalen Gemeinschaft zu sein - "wir wollen unsere Ruhe haben" - bedeutet das nicht, dass wir sie auch in Ruhe lassen sollten.

previous_src: No-one in this Chamber doubts the vital importance of the fight against international terrorism, nor will or should any of us ever forget the horrible tragedy which we saw on our television screens when those planes crashed into the twin towers in New York on 11 September 2001.
src: But we all understand the essential need to combat this evil in a way which strengthens the cause of freedom and human rights.
tgt: Doch uns allen ist klar, dass wir dieses Übel in einer Weise bekämpfen müssen, die die Sache der Freiheit und der Menschenrechte stärkt.

previous_src: I await with curiosity the Commission's answer to a number of comments made by Mr Bart Staes in his excellent report.
src: My group fully endorses his conclusions.
tgt: Mon groupe soutient sans réserve ses conclusions.

previous_src: (DA) Mr Barroso, the financial crisis has given rise to an economic crisis on an historic scale and, at this moment, unemployment is rising dramatically in Europe.
src: Unemployment amongst young people - those under 25 - in Europe is 19.8%, as you yourself said, and in Spain more than one in three of those under 25 are unemployed.
tgt: Wie Sie selbst sagten, beläuft sich die Arbeitslosigkeit unter jungen Menschen - unter 25 Jahren - in Europa auf 19,8%, und in Spanien ist jeder Dritte unter 25 Jahren arbeitslos.

previous_src: I take the view that now is just the right time to renew the European Union's support for Tibet.
src: We must do something about the fact that nine rounds of negotiations between China and the Tibetan Governmentinexile have not led to any outcome, and I completely agree with Mr Rinaldi here.
tgt: Nous devons réagir au fait que neuf tours de négociations entre la Chine et le gouvernement tibétain en exil n'aient donné aucun résultat et je suis complètement d'accord avec M. Rinaldi sur ce point.

previous_src: I abstained from the vote on this final version of the telecoms package because it is unsatisfactory.
src: It is, however, better than nothing.
tgt: Es ist jedoch besser als gar nichts.

previous_src: Member of the Commission. - (CS) Mr President, ladies and gentlemen, I should like to thank Parliament and in particular the rapporteur, Mrs Lynne, for including this important issue on the agenda of today's plenary session.
src: I am pleased that Parliament and the Commission have very similar opinions on the issue of disability.
tgt: Ich freue mich festzustellen, dass das Parlament und die Kommission zum Thema Behinderungen sehr ähnliche Ansichten vertreten.

previous_src: It is even more important that questions of research in Europe should no longer be decided by the Commission alone, but by elected representatives of the scientific community.
src: I therefore propose the creation of a representative assembly of all researchers at the European Parliament.
tgt: Ich schlage daher die Schaffung einer für die Gesamtheit der Wissenschaftler repräsentativen Versammlung im Europäischen Parlament vor.

previous_src: The report considers these issues thoroughly and I support its recommendations to include stronger provisions on the human rights front and to tackle corruption, and particularly important, its recommendations for the use of sanctions.
src: I support the strategy outlined in this report, I congratulate the rapporteur and I hope Parliament overwhelmingly approves it.
tgt: Ich unterstütze die in diesem Bericht entwickelte Strategie, ich beglückwünsche den Berichterstatter und hoffe, das Parlament billigt den Bericht mit großer Mehrheit.

previous_src: Mr President, as we have decided to vote, maybe you could indicate why so many amendments were ruled to be inadmissible.
src: That is the problem, and that is the point originally raised in relation to the recast versions under review.
tgt: Hier liegt das Problem, und dies ist die Angelegenheit, um die es ursprünglich im Zusammenhang mit den betreffenden Neufassungen ging.

previous_src: I believe that Mr Solana's proposal has much to commend it.
src: It does not generalise, it concerns specific issues and correctly identifies the dangers.
tgt: Er verallgemeinert nicht, er betrifft konkrete Themen und weist korrekt auf die Gefahren hin.

previous_src: It is an odd situation.
src: No, those are the Minutes, Mr Martens.
tgt: Non, ce sont les procèsverbaux, Monsieur Martens.

previous_src: I am fully in favour of European job-creation projects, and I hope that the Commission will continue them - whether in the United Kingdom, Poland or elsewhere - but money from the European Union is for job creation and not job relocation.
src: I hope the point will be made very clearly to the Commission that we do not expect it to pay for these job losses.
tgt: Ich hoffe, der Kommission wird unsere eindeutige Erwartung übermittelt werden, dass für diese Arbeitsplatzverluste nicht gezahlt wird.

previous_src: I do not see why there is such a drama about this.
src: It is not an attempt to create a power of censorship over questions.
tgt: Il ne s'agit nullement d'une tentative pour créer une censure sur les questions.

previous_src: & # 160; & # 160; – Mr President, Commissioner, ladies and gentlemen, the new Member States have undergone complex economic transformation over the last ten years, which has had a negative impact on various areas.
src: The main factors contributing to social exclusion in many of the new EU Member States are high unemployment, almost no labour force mobility and problems relating to the social inclusion of people entering the labour market, women, older people, those suffering ill health, disabled persons and ethnic and linguistic minorities.
tgt: Les principaux facteurs contribuant à l exclusion sociale dans bon nombre de nouveaux États membres de l UE sont le chômage élevé, la mobilité quasi inexistante de la main-d œuvre et les problèmes liés à l inclusion sociale des nouveaux entrants sur le marché du travail, des femmes, des personnes âgées, malades ou handicapées, ainsi que des minorités ethniques et linguistiques.

previous_src: Mrs Banotti, the European Commission has made an enormous effort with the hospital in Gaza.
src: The thing is, you have to render unto Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and render unto the Commission what belongs to the Commission.
tgt: Selon moi, il faut rendre à César ce qui est à César et à la Commission ce qui est à la Commission.

previous_src: The Gendarmerie has announced that it has been deleted.
src: Yet if you read the report by the CNIL carefully, Commissioner, you will see that the inspections carried out by the CNIL referred to ethnic origin.
tgt: Mais lisez attentivement ce que dit l'avis de la CNIL et vous y verrez, Madame la Commissaire, qu'il est fait mention de l'origine ethnique dans les contrôles qu'a effectués la CNIL.

previous_src: That means that the old European economic and social model will not work to deliver prosperity, social justice and jobs in the way it used to.
src: This is a big challenge, especially, if I may say so, for the country you represent, and for a number of others on the continent.
tgt: C est un grand défi, en particulier - & #160 ; si je puis m exprimer ainsi & #160 ; - pour le pays que vous représentez, et pour bien d autres sur le continent.

previous_src: I hope that the Commission will design a good communication strategy.
src: Go to the City of London, go to Frankfurt, go to Paris, go to Zurich, because the bankers have to be informed about this vehicle.
tgt: Allez à la City de Londres, à Francfort, à Paris, à Zurich : les banquiers doivent être informés de ce mécanisme.

previous_src: It is the firm opinion of the Group of the European People's Party that in the process of regulating this area, we need to bear in mind social, cultural and political considerations, in order to advance the expression of cultural and linguistic diversity.
src: In the process of drafting the report, I mentioned time and again the various specialties of the new Member States, which will have to be taken into account when regulations are drawn up.
tgt: Ich habe bei der Erstellung des Berichts immer wieder auf die Besonderheiten der neuen Mitgliedstaaten verwiesen, die bei der Erarbeitung der Regelungen berücksichtigt werden müssen.

previous_src: The EU has mobilised all available policy instruments to support the countries of the Western Balkans in their endeavours for reforms and regional cooperation.
src: The instrument for pre-accession assistance is important for addressing the region's long term development needs.
tgt: L'instrument d'assistance à la préadhésion est important pour répondre aux besoins à long terme de la région en matière de développement.

previous_src: Fishermen have seen their incomes go down, which is particularly serious as the sector is mainly concentrated in regions with fragile economies.
src: Various studies warn of the risk of thousands of fishing businesses and thousands of jobs disappearing on account of fuel price rises.
tgt: Mehrere Untersuchungen weisen auf die Gefahr hin, dass wegen der steigenden Kraftstoffpreise Tausende Fangbetriebe und Tausende Arbeitsplätze verschwinden könnten.

previous_src: I have been shadow rapporteur for the Socialist Group in the European Parliament, and we have been through some tough negotiations with the Council, but I believe that we have arrived at a good compromise proposal.
src: Although the work of this foundation is aimed at countries that are not members of the EU and have therefore not adopted the Lisbon objectives, it is nonetheless meaningful to talk about the objectives in this context.
tgt: Bien que le travail de cette fondation s'adresse à des pays qui ne font pas partie de l'Union européenne et qui n'ont donc pas adopté les objectifs de Lisbonne, il est cependant opportun de parler de ces objectifs dans ce contexte.

previous_src: This measure, however, will help allow small businesses to fight back.
src: Creditors will be entitled to charge a statutory interest rate of 7% on their debts, encouraging debtors to pay early.
tgt: Gläubiger können nun Verzugszinsen in Höhe von 7% in Rechnung stellen, und dies wird die Zahlungsmoral der Schuldner verbessern.

previous_src: It is vital to improve the conceptual framework of standards, and to bear in mind that they are neither neutral nor academic and can produce both winners and losers.
src: Likewise it is important to assess their effects and ensure their compatibility with European strategy, to learn from financial upheavals and to regulate the accounting standards of administrative concessions in a balanced way.
tgt: De même, il est important d'estimer leurs effets et de garantir leur compatibilité avec la stratégie européenne, de tirer les leçons des turbulences financières et de réglementer les normes comptables de concessions administratives de manière équilibrée.

previous_src: It is no accident that we have already returned several times since then.
src: The United States needs Europe, and I respectfully submit that Europe needs the United States.
tgt: Die Vereinigten Staaten brauchen Europa, und bei allem Respekt wage ich zu sagen, dass dies auch umgekehrt der Fall ist.

previous_src: Now let us consider the hypotheses.
src: One hypothesis is that the global temperature will continue to rise.
tgt: Eine erste Hypothese ist, dass die weltweite Temperatur weiter ansteigt.

previous_src: That the intention is to involve NGOs more closely in the working of the Instrument for Stability and to make full use of the even more groundbreaking body of instruments for peacebuilding.
src: If that becomes a reality, you will be able to count on the full support of our group.
tgt: Wenn das Realität wird, können Sie auf die volle Unterstützung unserer Fraktion zählen.

previous_src: Lastly, before the end of the week, the Laeken European Council will take the decision to set up a Convention, which will do the groundwork for the reform of the Treaties and, for the first time, bring together representatives of governments, national parliaments, the European Commission and this House.
src: This greater Europe which is taking shape is a united, democratic, forward-looking Europe.
tgt: La grande Europe qui prend forme est une Europe unie, démocratique et orientée vers l'avenir.

previous_src: This legal correction should not imply any increase in the budget, and it is necessary to ensure greater complementarity with action in the context of cooperation with Europol and Eurojust by granting the same level of access for these agencies to the Customs Information System (CIS), including its customs files identification database (FIDE).
src: That being so, the Commission cannot support Parliament's amendment aiming to grant a different level of access to CIS / FIDE for Europol and Eurojust.
tgt: Par conséquent, la Commission ne peut soutenir l'amendement du Parlement visant à accorder à Europol et Eurojust un niveau d'accès différent au SID/ FIDE.

previous_src: No more are we even pretending to respect the verdict of the people.
src: We are back in our own little world where we pretend that the voters do not exist and we continue with what we were doing anyway.
tgt: Nous sommes revenus dans notre propre petit monde où, ignorant l'existence des électeurs, nous poursuivons ce que nous avions commencé quoi qu'il en soit.

previous_src: Parliament has now completed its agenda.
src: The Minutes of today's sitting will be submitted to Parliament for its approval at the beginning of the next sitting.
tgt: Das Protokoll dieser Sitzung wird dem Parlament zu Beginn der nächsten Sitzung zur Genehmigung vorgelegt.

previous_src: The energy policy that is being advocated must ensure low carbon emissions and be based on solidarity and sustainability.
src: The reliability of the system is important, as operation must be continuous.
tgt: Die Zuverlässigkeit des Systems ist wichtig, da es durchgängig funktionieren muss.

previous_src: The principle of solidarity must provide the platform for devising the European Union's energy policies.
src: If Member States work together, they can ensure a more secure, cheaper and more efficient supply of energy resources to citizens and companies.
tgt: Si les États membres travaillent ensemble, ils peuvent garantir un approvisionnement plus sûr, moins cher et plus efficace de ressources énergétiques aux citoyens et aux entreprises.

previous_src: Drought, like desertification, is also a serious cause for concern.
src: The Council is firmly convinced that these threats - drought and desertification - can be tackled effectively only through close international cooperation.
tgt: Der Rat ist der festen Überzeugung, dass diese Gefahren - Dürre und Wüstenbildung - nur durch eine enge internationale Zusammenarbeit wirksam bekämpft werden können.

previous_src: Since the manner of producing and marketing the meat of bovine animals aged 12 months or less varies from one country to the next, therefore the finished manufactured products can also differ significantly amongst each other.
src: As a result, they come to market under different names and their selling prices can also differ significantly among each other.
tgt: Das hat zur Folge, dass sie unter unterschiedlichen Bezeichnungen auf den Markt kommen und auch ihre Verkaufspreise stark variieren können.

previous_src: They must also have full rights: human rights in the proper sense of the word.
src: That also means that they can participate in the decision making of societies and in the European decisionmaking process.
tgt: Das bedeutet ferner, dass sie innerhalb der Gesellschaften und innerhalb der Europäischen Union an den Entscheidungsprozessen teilnehmen können.

previous_src: This bill would criminalise homosexuality, leading to punishment by imprisonment and even the death penalty.
src: This would not only apply to these alleged criminals but also to those who failed to report these so-called crimes, or who support human rights and other work in Uganda.
tgt: Cela ne s'appliquerait pas seulement aux "coupables" d'homosexualité, mais également à ceux qui ne dénoncent pas ces prétendus crimes et à ceux qui soutiennent les droits de l'homme et les autres actions sur ce thème en Ouganda.

previous_src: In that regard, the very issue of whether it is possible to arrive at regulations for the respective readmission agreements is always included in discussions on visa provisions.
src: This is also the case in the talks with African Union countries, for example.
tgt: Das ist aber auch in den Gesprächen beispielsweise mit Ländern aus der Afrikanischen Union der Fall.

previous_src: We all have a feeling of uncertainty, and so this Berlin Declaration needs to do something that may be possible with a very short text, namely send out a message of hope, that what we have tackled successfully in the last 50 years will continue to be possible in future.
src: One thing is certain, however, and that is that we shall no longer be able to content ourselves with describing the successes of the last 50 years.
tgt: Aber eines geht sicher nicht mehr: Wir werden uns nicht mit dem Beschreiben der Erfolge der letzten fünfzig Jahre begnügen können.

previous_src: The strategic partnership should be accompanied by regular yearly summits.
src: We have held them with Brazil since 2007, and the Salafranca report rightly calls for them in relation to Mexico, in view of the Council's somewhat ambiguous conclusions of October 2008.
tgt: Wir halten seit 2007 solche Gipfeltreffen mit Brasilien ab, und der Salafranca-Bericht fordert - angesichts der etwas unklaren Beschlüsse des Rates vom Oktober 2008 - zurecht solche Gipfeltreffen auch in Bezug auf Mexiko.

previous_src: The company concerned (Option NV) has now informed the Commission that it has asked the Belgian Government to withdraw the request for the imposition of safeguard measures, but the Belgian Government has not yet informed the Commission whether it will comply with Option's request, so we are waiting for the Belgian Government to take a decision on its position.
src: That is precisely what has happened in this case.
tgt: C'est précisément ce qui s'est passé dans cette affaire.

previous_src: There are two quick points I want to make.
src: Of course I have kept in touch with Ban Ki-moon throughout.
tgt: Natürlich war ich die ganze Zeit mit Ban Ki-moon in Kontakt.

previous_src: This is sad but true.
src: We are talking about human trafficking, sometimes of young children, and also about all kinds of financial malpractice.
tgt: Nous parlons de traite d'êtres humains, parfois de jeunes enfants, et également de toutes sortes d'irrégularités financières.

previous_src: The text upon which we are going to vote in this plenary session is the result of the negotiations which continued under the Swedish and Spanish presidencies.
src: This resulted in an agreement at first reading, hence allowing this regulation to be adopted before the entry into force of the Visa Code.
tgt: Diese mündeten in eine Einigung in erster Lesung und ermöglichen damit die Annahme dieser Verordnung vor Inkrafttreten des Visakodexes.

previous_src: Mr President, I would like to ask Mr Gualtieri whether it has occurred to him that intergovernmental cooperation would be a much better path for the peoples of Europe and the unemployed in Europe than the European superstate which he seems to be advocating?
src: Has that occurred to him?
tgt: Ist ihm dieser Gedanke schon einmal gekommen?

previous_src: The same applies to substances that may pose a risk to the environment; we included this feature of Austrian law too.
src: It is absolutely not the case, i.e. it is incorrect to say that we paid no regard at all to that.
tgt: Il est donc absolument faux que nous n'y avons prêté aucune attention.

previous_src: The third part of the report examines risk and crisis management.
src: The internal market and the increasing degree of cross-border interdependence require us to examine whether cross-border risk and crisis management works smoothly.
tgt: Der Binnenmarkt und die zunehmende grenzüberschreitende Verflechtung erfordern es, dass wir untersuchen, ob das Risiko- und Krisenmanagement im grenzüberschreitenden Bedarfsfall reibungslos funktioniert.

previous_src: Decisions will not save people's lives; only practical measures can save lives.
src: That is why I am calling quite specifically for this humanitarian disaster to be one of the main items on the agenda at next week's meeting of the Council.
tgt: Deswegen fordere ich ganz konkret, dass bei der kommende Woche stattfindenden Ratstagung diese humanitäre Katastrophe zu einem der Topthemen werden muss.

previous_src: Her murderers have still not been brought to justice.
src: Anna is not, however, the only victim.
tgt: Anna ist jedoch nicht das einzige Opfer.

previous_src: However, there are several essential conditions for achieving this objective.
src: The first is to accompany the partnership with genuine technical support measures in order to attain the objectives that have been set.
tgt: Zunächst muß die Partnerschaft durch technische Unterstützung begleitet werden, damit die festgelegten Ziele erreicht werden können.

previous_src: Every day, the headlines in the press are of increasingly grim solutions and unlikely situations, and I can tell you that, on Friday, when I was out in the field, as we say in politics, I saw nearly 100 to 150 people.
src: They all asked me the same question: what is going to happen with the euro?
tgt: Sie alle stellten mir dieselbe Frage: Was wird aus dem Euro?

previous_src: On another point made by Mr Stevenson concerning the studying of factors other than over-fishing, such as pollution and global warming – a point also raised by other honourable Members of Parliament – we are certainly willing to do this and we are doing so.
src: The problem exists independently of the problem of depleted stocks, and we need to address it if we want to regain sustainable fisheries in the long-term interests of the fishermen themselves.
tgt: Le problème existe, indépendamment du problème des stocks épuisés, et nous devons le régler si nous voulons rétablir une pêche durable dans l intérêt durable des pêcheurs eux-mêmes.

previous_src: It is important for Turkey to retain this understanding.
src: A peaceful solution is, of course, our highest objective.
tgt: Eine friedliche Lösung ist selbstverständlich unser oberstes Ziel.

previous_src: We are looking for ways of improving the credibility of the pact in a fair way, so that the measures can be implemented objectively, irrespective of the country's status as one the richest or poorest Member States.
src: I believe it is in the interests of all of us to have a more credible way of implementing the Stability and Growth Pact.
tgt: Je pense qu'il est dans l'intérêt de chacun d'entre nous d'améliorer la crédibilité de la mise en œuvre du pacte de stabilité et de croissance.

previous_src: This security of energy supply depends upon investments that are already clearly inadequate.
src: They will, however, have to increase significantly in order to meet our future needs whether for gas or electricity.
tgt: Ceux -ci devront pourtant augmenter considérablement pour répondre à nos besoins futurs, qu'il s'agisse du gaz ou de l'électricité.

previous_src: It sets minimum requirements for seafarers, with provisions on employment conditions and recruitment, working hours, wage protection, leave and repatriation, accommodation, recreation, food and catering, health and medical care, welfare and social security.
src: It will immeasurably improve the conditions of the millions of workers in this sector worldwide.
tgt: Elle améliorera considérablement les conditions de millions de travailleurs du secteur dans le monde.

previous_src: Indeed, to do that at this stage might even hinder its future progress.
src: That is why it is important that the human rights community continues to support the Human Rights Council, albeit with a critical eye.
tgt: Deshalb muss die Menschenrechtsgemeinschaft den Menschenrechtsrat unbedingt weiterhin unterstützen, wenn auch aus einem kritischen Blickwinkel.

previous_src: After four months of 2003, total outstanding commitments - known as RAL - had increased to EUR 126 billion, compared with EUR 110 billion at the same time last year.
src: Even though we do not have all the facts concerning the causes of this and concerning what are in actual fact abnormal outstanding commitments, the trend is clearly worrying.
tgt: Auch wenn noch nicht alle Informationen über die Gründe dafür und über den außergewöhnlichen Teil dieser RAL vorliegen, ist dieser Trend natürlich beunruhigend.

previous_src: However, we are still waiting for some further justification, possibly of a technical nature, that the specialists we heard were not able to pin point, but I think that what the Commissioner has said up to now does not present sufficient grounds for us to suppose that the 1 000 metre proposal would be valid.
src: Nevertheless, we shall keep on waiting and we do in fact hope that the European Parliament's proposal may be taken into consideration following tomorrow's vote.
tgt: Trotzdem werden wir weiter warten, und wir hoffen wirklich, dass der Vorschlag des Europäischen Parlaments nach der morgigen Abstimmung berücksichtigt werden kann.

previous_src: The matter at hand here, after all, is healing people.
src: This one element represents a complete wrong turn for a report that otherwise takes a sound approach, and it is a turn that is morally perilous.
tgt: Hier wird ein Bericht mit einem guten Ansatz in eine total falsche Richtung gelenkt, die auch moralisch gefährlich ist.

previous_src: That Treaty does not introduce a specific legal basis, but gives the value of a European policy to the strategy we are discussing here today and which hitherto was based on a common political resolve.
src: With the Lisbon Treaty, we can now regard the strategy for the protection of children as truly European, which is a quite extraordinary step forward.
tgt: Avec le traité de Lisbonne, nous pouvons désormais considérer la stratégie relative à la protection des enfants comme véritablement européenne, ce qui est un extraordinaire pas en avant.

previous_src: Moreover, we must ensure that parents are able to decide that the cord blood should not simply be thrown away, as it may possibly be valuable in future for other children, or even for their own child.
src: We should organise ourselves with that in mind, within the sphere of our competences, as I say, but there is much that we can already do in this area.
tgt: Nous devrions nous organiser en gardant cela à l'esprit, dans les limites de nos compétences, comme je l'ai dit, mais il y a déjà beaucoup de choses que nous pouvons faire dans ce domaine.

previous_src: The fact is that these errors mean that taxpayers' money has been abused.
src: But, to be honest, nobody cares about this.
tgt: Mais à vrai dire, personne ne s'en soucie.

previous_src: Second, the West has to recognise that on occasion our actions or inaction in the Middle East, in Palestine and elsewhere contributes to rising hostility and terrorism towards ourselves.
src: Sometimes we can be our own worst enemies.
tgt: Manchmal können wir selbst unsere ärgsten Feinde sein.

previous_src: I have actually seen how attached the Americans are to their privacy laws, which are very good, and how critical they are when the public authorities do not respect the rules on privacy.
src: So I think we should take their critical attitude as an example.
tgt: Deshalb bin ich der Meinung, dass wir uns ihre kritische Einstellung zum Vorbild nehmen sollten.

src: Rape, sexual abuse of girls, trafficking in women for the purpose of sexual or labour exploitation, domestic violence, workplace harassment, and also traditional or disfiguring practices - such as, for example, mutilation of the sex organs - impair the health, freedom, dignity and physical and emotional inviolability of women.
tgt: Le viol, la maltraitance sexuelle des jeunes filles, le trafic de femmes en vue de leur exploitation sexuelle ou d'un travail forcé, la violence domestique, le harcèlement sur le lieu du travail, mais aussi les pratiques traditionnelles ou mutilantes (comme par exemple la mutilation des organes sexuels) nuisent à la santé, à la liberté, à la dignité et à l'intégrité physique et émotionnelle des femmes.

previous_src: In fact, the Western world, which stretches far beyond the borders of the European Union, has a right to expect from us a real contribution towards cooperation and synergy in terms of our joint activities.
src: The report presented this in a well-balanced manner, and that is why we will gladly support it in tomorrow's vote.
tgt: Das wurde in dem Bericht in ausgewogener Form herausgearbeitet, und deshalb werden wir ihn bei der morgigen Abstimmung mit Freude unterstützen.

previous_src: The proposal limits the concentration of chemical substances, hazardous groups including heavy metals, some pesticides and other hazardous chemicals in surface water.
src: It is based very much on the principle of preventative actions.
tgt: Er beruht weitestgehend auf dem Grundsatz der Vorbeugung.

src: For the most part, national public prosecutors cannot cope.
tgt: Le plus souvent, les ministères publics nationaux sont impuissants.

src: This appears to be the case with the events which Mr Lomas reports in his question.
tgt: Das scheint mir bei den von Herrn Lomas in seiner Anfrage zur Sprache gebrachten Tatbeständen der Fall zu sein.

src: If this is the case, such support can contribute to innovation, increase safety and improve environmental performance and efficiencies in air transportation.
tgt: Wenn das der Fall ist, kann eine solche Beihilfe zu Innovationen, einer Steigerung der Sicherheit und einer Verbesserung des Umweltverhaltens sowie der Effizienz des Luftverkehrs beitragen.

previous_src: Moldova is a divided country.

tgt: Daher werden wir den Entschließungsantrag in seiner jetzigen Form nicht unterstützen.

tgt: Ce paquet de mesures devrait également concerner ceux qui proposent la création de petites ou moyennes entreprises.

tgt: Toutefois, compte tenu des raisons que nous connaissons déjà, cela m'est impossible.

tgt: Die wichtigste Aussage für mich ist jedoch, dass wir, wenn der Vertrag von Lissabon in Kraft tritt, eine Vereinfachung zustande bringen müssen, um bessere Bedingungen für unsere Ausgaben auf lokaler Ebene zu schaffen und das Geld rechtzeitig jenen in unseren Ländern zuzuleiten, die es brauchen, egal, ob dies kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, Wissenschaftler oder Landwirte sind.

tgt: Le Conseil de l'Union européenne considère que la désertification, le changement climatique et la biodiversité représentent des défis complémentaires et doivent être traités de façon coordonnée à l'aide de politiques appropriées afin de mettre au point des synergies et de les traiter plus efficacement.

tgt: Ich möchte Frau Mazzoni dafür danken, dass sie diese Anfrage vorgebracht hat, sodass wir unseren Standpunkt bezüglich dieser Angelegenheit klarstellen können.

previous_src: These are obviously clear obstacles for any institution that wishes to have that type of relationship between both shores of the Mediterranean.

tgt: Nous devrons agir ensemble, tout comme nous l'avons fait de nombreuses fois dans le passé, et nous ne devons pas oublier que la clef de la réussite est le principe de solidarité européenne.

tgt: On pourrait en effet intituler de cette façon le budget de cette année.

tgt: Aus diesem Grund kann die Europäische Union den betroffenen Mitgliedstaaten - womit ich Litauen, die Slowakei und Bulgarien meine - Finanzhilfe bereitstellen.

tgt: Das ist auch der logische und normale Weg.

tgt: Er räumt ihnen Rechte ein, welche Drittstaatsangehörige, die sich seit fünf Jahren rechtmäßig in einem Land der Europäischen Union aufhalten, bereits haben.
